tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 6 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang /gtso sgrig pa/karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/mun sel/thub bstan nyi ma/bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/dpal ldan rgya mtsho/phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/thub bstan nyi ma/bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/tshe ring chos sgron/shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'khrug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa/'i nga pe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe tī na /spang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rking po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i snyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom ba'ang ru/ te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yis/ dang/ rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas spegs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul da spu sa pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe chegs chen mo 'di nyid par skun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon sa 'a chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba 1ga pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig ༈gas bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas ku na 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe sgrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lhe gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu skrungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a ri sogs su grags wo gyi slob grwa rṣa mo —1—

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen ngo/ yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang sko ba ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon bron mi bai ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs ji zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /'es gsungs pa lta ra/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len chul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhi myo dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'gyung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'gyung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nams/ pa rnams gsos / 'brugs nga/ rlams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su nga/ra du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyetshon mche/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zho re las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhon/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyam/sa po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi bandi dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras spungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams /ba tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mjad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun snyel chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2 —

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon tan bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3 —

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras spungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bzhas mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras skrungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bca sa la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rdza 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/ ——zhe——da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu sau rngo 1 6 3 'byud dod dang gnas dang / paṇḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung bcun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos padma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dzwa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bzhad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bzhes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdu sa/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smra ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang / gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ārya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug pū hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lanta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bzhes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gzhan rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon padma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go / de nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta ga rta nanda dang pra yā mā nanda gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni rbu ṇa shrī dang puṇḍa badzra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/ dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du shambha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

ba sngu /du~X grela~X 'di ska ḍi~X ༵ rnyeda~X dzī~X ༵sna rdo shā spu nga ste the rngo mang bstan ༵ ༵gre ༵ ༵ don dhi bsdus mi sngu ༵ sdi ༵ / gzhan / shad dod nā sdo pa ༵༵rni rno ༵ ༵༵ /skad dod / ༵ dhi dzhai rjo zhes rno pa so / ba lha sdus gas ma / rde kyi nyung nyu mdu / ༵ne/ byang du byang chub bzang chas rtsi~X ༵ ༵nga ༵ pri ༈zlo snra ༵ chi lti~X pyi/ ༵tshong rde rnyi tsong dhi pa~Xje por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar pam lhi pa pa dzhai phyog ༵ gnyis dhi smo nga / gyi da snro gi~X de dpa rdi ga/ ༵༵ thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khe/ra bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sna/na (sa ༵༵ dbya~X/ spyu sku ṭā ṭā~X tsho nā nge lnga~X /dzhai da de/ ༵༷ dhi dzhai dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/— 10—

rim pa rnam par bshad pa dngos grub nyer 'tsho zhes bya ba bzhu / gas/oṃ swasti/ gu ru buddhā bo dhi sa te khyo na mo na maX dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa rnam par bshad pa dngos grub nyer 'tsho zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang dbyer ma mchis pa sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gsung bdud rtsi'i cha shas tsam/ /rna ba'i bum par lhung bas kyang / /srid gsum mchog tu bde ba'i sar/ /'god mdzad rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud/ /mtha' dag bde bar gshegs ri kun 'dus pa dus 'khor lo/ /rtsod dus 'gro la mkhas btsun bzang po'i bshes gnyen tshul/ /ston mdzad srid gsum 'di na dol po pa zhes grags/ /kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan de la spyi bos 'dud/ gang zhig mchog tu mi 'gyur lhan skyes lang tsho rgyas pa'i sku/ /rnam pa kun ldan 'khor lo'i dbang mor gdod nas rtag par rol/ /kun khyab srid pa'i bdag po dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i dpal gyur de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjes gdul dka' 'dul mdzad 'jigs byed he ru ka dpal ni/ /rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro ma tshogs dang bcas khro bo'i rgyal rnams la/ /yang dag btud nas de cha 1 dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thams cad

la'ang / /spyi bos 'dud do srid 'dir bgegs rnams zhi zhing dge legs mdzod/ /zla ba bzang la shākya sesgos gsungs don 'jam dpal gyis ni drang srong tshogs rnams la'o/ /mtha' dag grol ba'i rgyur gsungs 'jig rten mgon pos de don gsal byed rgyas 'grel rgya mtsho las/ /thigs pa'i tshul du cung zad blangs nas dag pa'i rnal 'byor cha tsam yi ge'i lam du bya/ /mkhas dang mkhas min mang pos yang yang bshad mod g.yin gyis bskul dang rang sems dag phyir yin/ /de bas de ring 'di 'dra sbyor ba la/ /bden dang blo gros ldan rnams bzod par mdzod/ /gang la skyon spangs yon tan kun ldan tshig /rgya cher ston de 'phags mchog kho nas yin/ /bdag nyid kyis ni ji ltar go /de ltar gzhan la ston mod kyi/ /phyogs 'dzin phrag dog 'gran sems dang / /g.yo sgyu med phyir yid rab bde/ /de yang srid zhi kun la khyab pa'i ye shes chos kyi dbyings khyab pa dang rtag pa'i sku can bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i rang gzugs ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ma lus pa zung 'jug ro mnyam du bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems dpa' ris med pa nyid do/ /de nyid kyi rang bzhin chos thams cad kyi srog dang mgon dang dwangs ma dang bcud dang snying stobs dang gnas dang gzhi dang rten gyi tshul du gdod nas rtag tu bzhugs pa yin la/ sems can rnams kyi bde ba dam pa'i rgyur brtan g.yo thams cad kyi rnam pas 'gro ba'i don spyod —2—

————— — — —pa ring chi/myo cho da kye/ de dag so so'i gnas skabs dang khyad par la bltos nas 'gro ba rnam/sa kyi sdug bsngal sel ba po dang / bde ba skyed pa po rnams dang sna tshogs pa'i rig pa dang / grub pa'i mtha' du ma ston pa po dang / skye bo rnams kyi las dang bya ba dang / lam ston pa po mtha' yas pa byung ba dag kyang gdod ma'i mgon po de nyid kyi rnam 'gyur du gsal bar bsngags te/de skad du yang rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ thig le nus ma mig sman dag dang mkha' lding lha yi chu bo me sbyin dang ni 'dod 'jo dang / /rdzong dang glog dang rig pa bzang po 'gyur med mchog gi cha dang lha yi skad dang lus med te/ /yang dag rgyu ba'i gzugs 'di rnams kyis sa la 'jug par 'gyur ro rgyal ba yi ni ye shes sku/ /byung bar gyur dang byung dang 'byung 'gyur rig byed rtog ge la sogs bstan bcos mtha' dag rab tu smra/ /zhes gsungs shing / phal po che dang dkon mchog ta la sogs mdo sde du ma zhig las kyang rnam pa 'di lta bu mang du gsungs so/ /de lta bas na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' bzhi la sogs pa lta ci smos/ phyi rol kyi gzhung lugs tha dad pa dang / bzo'i gnas la sogs pa rig pa'i 'jug sgo ma lus pa'ang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi ye shes las byung ba'i 'phrin las kyi rnam 'gyur tsam du ni rig par bya la/ de'i phyir 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod 'dir byung ba'i mkhas par 'dod pa mang po zhig rang nyid dul bar rlom zhing khas len la gzhan gyi lta ba dang rig pa dang spyod tshul dang ngang tshul la sdang smras 'ba' zhig gis mi tshe ril po dus 'da' bar byed pa ni shin tu mi mkhas shing dam pa'i spyod tshul btang bar —3—

gsal lo/ /'on kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa yang bzang zhing / de las phyi rol tu gyur pa dag kyang de dang 'dra bar bzang ngo snyam du sems su rung ba lta ga la zhig ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin las gang la gang 'dul du 'jug pa yin pas log par mos shing rnam par grol ba'i skal ba med pa dag la yang dag pa'i lam dngos su ston par mi 'gyur bar rnam pa gzhan dang tshul gzhan gyis 'jig rten pa'i lam tsam zhig ston pa yin te/dper na/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal pos/ sa steng gi skye 'gro thams cad la bya dga' dang / kha zas kyi khyad par mtha' yas pa dag stsol bar mdzad pa na/ khyi dang phag la sogs pa dag la ni rin po che dang / lha rdzas kyi gos dang /glang po la sogs pa'i theg pa dang kha zas ro brgya ba dag gis ci zhig bya/gzhan du na lhag ma'i zas dang smad pa'i dngos po dag gis tshim par byed de/rang nyid mngon sum du de dag la lag bdar te ster bar yang mi byed do/ /de ltar 'dir yang de bzhin gshegs pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi don mdzad pa na/byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams de dang de la 'god cing /mtho ris kyi skal ba can la 'jig rten pa'i lam ston la/ de'i skal ba'ang med na ngan 'gro'i gnas nyid du bde ba phra mo dang / sdug bsngal chung ngur sgyur ba dang cher mi skyed pa'i thabs tsam yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na mu stegs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha' ston pa'i gzhung lugs de dag kyang shin tu rmongs pa'i gang zag la blo gros kyi 'jug pa gsar du skye ba'i rgyu yin pas/ gnas skabs kyi bde ba phra mo yang skyed la/ blo gros shin tu byang —4—

ba'i tshe yang dag pa'i lam dang spyod pa la'ang 'jug par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod pas/ rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa ni yin zhing / thar pa'i lam gyi skal ba med pa'i phyir rgyal bas de dag la thar lam bstan pa yang ma yin la/ skyon kun spangs/ yon tan kun rdzogs/ sangs rgyas nyid ces 'jig rten du grags pa'i sku'i rnam pas kyang de rnams la dngos su gsung bar mi mdzad de/ lha dang drang srong dang dka' thub pa dang rtog ge ba dag la byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ de dag gi gzugs su sprul nas ston par mdzad do/ /de ltar yang rgyud las/ rig byed mtha' las gsang ba 'di dag tshangs pa yis ni rnal 'byor pa rnams dag la mngon brjod kyang / /dus kyis shes pa rab nyams thub pa rnams kyis 'dir ni srog chags rnams la gsod pa dag kyang bstan/ /mi rnams mtho ris don du de la rab tu 'jug ste dmyal ba dar pa'i 'bras bu ster bar 'gyur/ /sol ba 'o ma'i rgyun gyis mngon par bkrus pa 'dir ni zla ba'i mdog tu 'gar yang 'gyur ma yin/ /zhes rig byed la sogs pa'i gzhung 'ga' zhig sbas pa'i don ma 'khrul pa yod kyang skal ba dang mi ldan pa'i ngor ches shin tu gab pa thal ches te/ tshig don dngos bstan la grol ba'i lam te gsal bar ma bstan pa lta ci smos/ log pa'i lam du ma ston pa ltar yang byung ba skal med rnams kyis ma shes te/ gzhung de la yid brtan 'cha' ba'i rjes 'jug rnams phyin ci log la zhugs pa yin zhes kyang gsungs la/ des na nang le las/ yan lag dang bcas rig byed dran pa'i gzhung dang bcas dang rtog ge grub pa'i mthar ldan 'jig rten du/ /snyan ngag mkhan po rgyas pa me la sogs pa rnams kyis byas pa'i —5—

bstan bcos gzhan yang rig pa min/ /rig pa zhes pa nang rig 'gyur med kyang ste 'jig rten 'dir ni thub pa rnams kyis rab gsungs nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dngos su na sangs rgyas/ kyis bstan pa kho na thar ba'i lam ston pa yin gyi/ grol ba'i thabs ston pa gzhan med la/de yang theg pa gsum gyi lam zhes brjod mod kyi/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam dang 'bras bu yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin te/ dngos su lam gyi cha shas dum bu nye tshe tsam bstan pa dang /'bras bu thar ba'i cha shas tsam thob pa yin pa dang / mthar thug theg pa chen po 'a/ gzhol dgos pa'i phyir rang skya ma thub pas/ dgos pa'i dbang gis theg pa gsum du gsungs kyang gnyis po theg pa chen po'i lam du 'dus pa'i phyir shin tu ches tha dad pa'i rim pa gsum yod pa ma yin no/ /theg pa chen po de la yang 'bras bu mthar thug bgrod byed kyi lam rdzogs par mi 'byung ba pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / mthar thug bgrod byed kyi lam rdzogs pa sngags kyi theg pa gnyis zhes 'byung ba'ang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang 'bras bu'i rnam pa thams cad sngags kyi theg par 'chad la/ rdo rje theg pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnams ni de la med pa'i lhag po yin zhing / dod thub kyang bzhag tu med pas don gyi sgo nas theg pa chen po mdo sde'i tshul yang sngags kyi tshul du 'dus so/ /de la 'dir ni theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi nang nas rgyud thams cad kyi yang rtser gyur pa/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo ste/ de yang rgyud kyi rgyal po'i ye shes le'u las/ shes rab rgyud ni shar nas slar yang rnal 'byor rjes su —6—

rig pa nyid ni nub kyi zhal las so/ /g.yas kyi zhal nas rgyal ba'i bdag pos rnal 'byor ra rgyud gsungs g.yon gyi zhal nas bya ba la sogs so/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs khongs nas/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang rtog pa'i rgyud la sogs pa bsdus pa yin la/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa ni mtshon byed de rnal 'byor bla med las thabs kyi rgyud rnams so/ /de la bya spyod rtog pa gsum ni gtsang sbra la sogs pa lus kyi bya ba gtso bor ston pa'i phyir/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i g.yon zhal sku rdo rje'i 'phrin las yin pas des gsungs pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams ni 'dod chags bde ba chen po cung zad rgyas pa'i lam nyid kyi phyir g.yas zhal dmar pos kyang mtshon la/ sngags kyi yig 'bru'i dngos grub nyid mthar thug tu ston pa'i phyir/g.yas zhal gsung rdo rjes gsungs pa dang / rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa dang 'dus pa la sogs pa thabs rgyud rnams ni rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ye shes rdo rje de khong du sbas pa'i za ma tog bskyed rim bya ba dang bcas pa gtso bor ston pa'i phyir/ rgyab zhal ye shes rdo rjes gsungs pa dang / bde mchog dang dgyes rdor la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnams mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i za ma tog thugs rdo rje'i lam zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes spros pa'i snang ba nub pa can de nyid gtso bor ston pa'i phyir/ mdun zhal thugs rdo rje'i 'phrin las yi na pa dang des gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar na bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum las ches mchog tu gyur pa/bzhi pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa yin la/ de la yang thabs dang shes rab kyi rgyud —7—

gnyis las byin rlabs myur ba'i sgo nas rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud mchog yin zhing /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo ni/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud khyad par can yin yang gong du gsungs pa ltar gyi zhal re re'i phyogs su lhung ba ma yin par zhal bzhi'i spyi bo'am yang na sku lus dang mtshungs par bstan pa ste/ de yang dpal gyi mgur nas gsungs pa'i rgyud rnams la spyi ldog nas bzang ngan gyi dbye ba mi thub kyang /brjod byed tshig gi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa la/ brjod bya zab mi zab dang rgya che chung gi khyad par ni nges par 'byung du rung ba las/ dus kyi 'khor lo ni lhag par zab cing rgya che ba yin no/ /de yang phyi 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag skar rtsis kyi rim pa sogs dang / nang rdo rje lus kyi skye gnas 'jig tshul sogs gzhi gtan la 'bebs tshul yang gzhan pas rgya che zhing / grub mtha'i dbye ba dang rang lugs kyi 'khor ba 'jug zlog sogs gzhi'i gnas tshul gtan la 'bebs tshul gzhan pas zab pa'ang yin la/ smin byed dbang gi dus na chu sogs kyi dbang la rgyud gzhan rnams la rgyal ba rigs lnga tsam las ma gsungs pa la/ 'dir lha bzhi bcu rtsa drug sogs kyi dag pa mdzad pas/ gzhan pas 'di rgya che zhing zab la rgyud smin tshabs che ba dang / dbang gong ma'i gnas skabs kun na bzhi pa phyag rgya chen po'i dbang rgyud gzhan du mi gsal zhing bsdus pa/'dir rgyas shing gsal bar gsungs pas ches zab pa dang / gzhan nas ma bshad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon bdag po dang bdag po chen po'i dbang dag gsungs pas/ slob dpon gyi dbang la zab pa dang rgya che ba gnyis kar gyi sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa dang /—8—

bskyed rim la yang pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gzhan thams cad kyi zab gnad gcig tu 'dus pas mchog tu gyur pa dang / bzlas pa sogs la thun mo nge ma yin pa'i zab gnad thor bu du ma yod pa dang / zab gnad kyi gtso bo tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya ba'i nye lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes bya ba rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid phyag rgya chen po dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zung du 'jug pa'i lam dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes de ni rgyud rgyal gzhan rnams su gab cing mi gsal ba dang brda thabs dang / zur tsam gyis mtsho ni pa dang / ming tsam dang / mtshan nyid mdor bsdus tsam gyis mtshon pa las ma gsungs pa la/ 'dir rgyas shing gsal la thang mar brdal ba yin no/ /de bzhin du 'bras bu'i bzhugs tshul gyi sgo nas kyang / gzhan las gsal por mi 'byung ba'i zab khyad du ma dang bcas pa gsal bor gsungs pa yin zhing / der ma zad rgyud gzhan thams cad kyi mi gsal ba gsal byed bla na med pa yang 'di yin la/ theg pa gzhan thams cad kyi dgongs don yang 'dir gtan la phab pas/chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi nang na gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur pa ni rgyud rgyal dus kyi 'khor lo 'di'o/ /yang bka' rgyud sde rnams rtogs dka' bas/ dgongs 'grel mkhan po'i gzhung la brten nas rtogs dgos par 'dod pa yang mang na/ dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung yang lugs 'di nyid ches mchog tu gyur pa ste/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan rnams la ni 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇḍi ta phal pa dang / sgrub pa po nus pa cung zad thob pas bshad pa dang / thun —9—

mong gi dngos grub tsam thob pa'i grub thob kyis bshad pa'ang mang la/ 'phags pa'i sa thob pa'am mchog gi dngos grub thob par grags pa rnams kyang sngar mi'i 'gro ba so so skye bo'i rten la skabs der mchog gsar du brnyes pa/'phags pa'i sa dang po lta bu thob pa yang yod/ mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud pa'i sbyor lam gyi sa thob pa la mchog thob par byas pa'ang yod kyi/dgongs 'grel mkhan bzang shos rnams kyang de tsam zhig yin la/ 'dir ni byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum dang / lta 'dod mdor bstan dang /don dam bsnyen pa la sogs pa ni/ nges pa'i don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid gdul bya'i snang ngor tshul ston pa'i rnam pa'i dbang du byas na sa bcu'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje'i snying po dang / phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa rgyal sras thu bo rnams kyis rgyud don gsal bar mdzad pa'i bstan bcos yin pas so/ /des na sems 'grel skor gsum sogs 'di dag ni/ bsdus pa'i rgyud gzhan rnams la bshad rgyud ces bya ba/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi don 'grel ston pa nyid kyis gsungs pa'i rang 'grel lta bu de dag dang khungs che chung la khyad par med pa las go bde zhing tshig don gsal ba'i phyogs nas 'di dag ngo mtshar che che tsam yin no/ /de la dpal ldan 'bras sbungs kyi mchod rten chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas su 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya sesgos phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa'i sku rgyal po zla bzang sogs sngags kyi theg pa'i gdul bya rnams la dngos su gsungs pa'i rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa dang / de'i rnam par bshad pa zla bzang nyid kyis mdzad —10—

pa stong phrag drug cu pa sogs ni/ 'a rogs pa'i yul dang gangs ri'i khrod sogs chu bo sī ta'i lto phyogs 'dir mi yu4/ gyi 'gro ba'i don du ma byon te dbang mdor bstan sogs cha shas nye tshe tsam ṇḍi rma/ gtogs so tsho /'phags pa'i yul du ji tsam dar zhing yod pa de thams cang/ bod yul 'dir byon pa ma yin mod/ 'on kyang gtso che ba rnams ni 'dir ya nga yod pa las/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi dum bu nges don phyogs gcig pa dbang mdor bstan dang / bsdus rgyud le'u lnga pa 'phreng 'dzin sdeb sbyor gyi tshigs bcad stong sum cu lhag bcas dang / bsdus pa'i rgyud phyi ma rnams ni yongs su grags pa rgyud kyi mtshan 'byar ba yin la/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i gsung lta 'dod mdor bstan dang / padma dkar po'i gsung don dam bsnyen pa dang / gzhan yang rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba sogs gzhung phran ci rigs de dag kyang / rgyud kyi mtshan ma 'byar mod/ don gyis rgyud du ri gtogs go /dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen dri med 'od glo ka stong phrag bcu gnyis pa rdzogs par dngos su yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje snying ngo/sa mdzad pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa'i 'grel pa phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa gnyis ni/ yongs rdzogs kyi tshad glo ka stong phrag drug pa rer bshad kyang / rgya bod sa/'is su 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir spyod pa ni/ stod kyi cha nas nyung zad re yin mod/ ‘snad gnyis re res kyang don gyi snying po'i cha nas rgyud don rdzogs par 'grel ba ste/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rim pa cha tshang rdzogs pa re bstan no/ /de dag dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa dang / rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs rigs ldan khyab 'jug sbas —1/—

pas mdzad pa sogs kyang rgyud kyi 'grel bshad dang / sgrubs thabs zhes pa'i tha snyad kyis go bkag ste/ rgyud kyi mtshan ma 'byar yang don gyis rgyud dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ /de la kha cig 'di snyam du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas/de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las ma 'das gong du byung ba ni bka' dang / de'i rjes su byung ba ni dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos su 'jog dgos pas dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsdus pa'i rgyud kyang ston pa nas lo drug brgya'i phyis su byung ba'i phyir dgongs 'grel kho na'o snyam na/ 'di ni tshig dang don gnyis ka'i sgo nas/rtsa ba'i rgyud nyid las 'byung ba bsdus pa kho na ste/ nyi ma'i shing rtas gsol ba btab pa sogs kha skong gi tshig sho lo ka 'ga' zhig ma gtogs sho lo ka stong dang sum cu rtsa rgyud las btus pa'i tshig kho na la/ sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis go rim bsgrigs mtshams bsgyur ba tsam ni yod mod/ de ni sdud pa po'i bsam pas mdo rgyud gzhan thams cad la yang yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi bka' rgya chen po las tshig nyung ja'i tshul du bsdu ba de lta bu/ dus phyis so so skye bos byas na bka' yin par mi 'gro ba srid mod kyang / 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis mdzad pa yin pas/ sdud pa pos bka' bsdus pa dang khyad par med pas bka' ma yin par mi 'gro'o/ /de las kyang khyad par du gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi gtso bo ston pa nyid kyis rtsa ba'i rgyud du lung bstan pa nyid kyi phyir bka' yin te/ 'phags par lung bstan pa'i gang zag de 'phags pa yin par the tshom med pa bzhin no/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ 'phreng 'dzin tshigs bcad sum cu ni/ /—12—

lhag pa'i phyogs brgya le'u lngas/ /dpal ldan rgyud dag rdzogs par ni/ /smra ba'i rgyal pos ston 'gyur te/ /sdud par byed pa po yang 'di/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dri med 'od sogs ni gong du brjod pa ltar don gyis na bshad rgyung/ nyid du 'gyur zhes smra yi/ sngon nas da lta'i bar du rgyud kyi tha snyad mi byed pa'i phyir/ bdag cag gis kyang rgyung/ kyi tha snyad gsar du sbyor bar mi byed de dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de las rgyud kyi rgyal po 'grel ba dang bcas pa 'di la bod kyi phyogs 'dir lo tsā ba tha dad pas bsgyur ba'i 'gyur mi gcig pa shin tu mang bar byung ste/ gyi jo rma lo 'bro gnyan mang 'or dang / /'a zha rwa lo ga rong tsa mi dang / /spong zho kher rgang lding ri grags ming bzhi/ /rong gling se lo lo chung bsod ye dang / /blo gros snying po chag lo yar lungs pa/ /de rnams lo paṇa sdebs pa'i 'gyur yin te/ /kha cig gzhi 'gyur kha cig 'gyur bcos yin/ /'gos lo khug pas bsgyur zhes 'ga' zhig zer/ /shong ston thang ston dpang lo'i 'gyur rnams ni/ —/paṇḍi ta la ma nyan rtsal 'gyur yin/ /lo tsā blo gros gnyis kyis bsgyur ba ni/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen chen po yi/ /bka' yis bskul zhing gsung dang bstun pa'i phyir/ /rtsal 'gyur yin yang byin rlabs gzi byin ldan/ /'gyur gsar rnams kyi nang nas 'di nyid mchog /go bde tshig lam legs shing gsal ba yin/ /de dag kyang 'di lta ste/ thog ma gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi 'gyur te 'di la 'gyur mangs su grags/ de nas rma dge ba'i blo gros/ 'bro lo tsā ba gnyel tser shes rab grags/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ mang 'or byang chub shes rab/ 'a zha rgya gar brtsegs/ rwa lo tsā ba —13—

chos rab/ steng pa lo tsā ga rong tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ bu rang lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ grags pa'i ming gi mtha' can bzhi ni/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ spong zho gsal ba grags/ kher rgang 'khor lo grags/ lding ri chos grags so/ /yang rong gling lo tsā ba rdo rje dbang phyug /se lo tsā ba chul khrims gzhon nu lo tsā ba bsod nams ye shes tsā/ lo tsā ba blo gros snying po/ chag lo chos rje dpal/ yar lungs shud ke grags pa rgyal mtshan te/ de rnams kyis rgya gar gyi paṇa grub la dbang man ngag bshad pa rnams zhus te bsgyur ba yim nga/sa/phal cher byin rlabs dang snye ldan pa yi ma yang rwa 'bro tsā mi chag lo'i lugs rnams ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams la brgyud pa ring du ma dar ba 'dra'o/ /paṇa chen zla mgon gyi rang 'gyur dang gnyos kha rag lo tswa'i 'gyur dang khyung po chos brtson gyi 'gyur yang yod par grags la/ 'gro seng dkar dang / mtshur dbyig gi snying po la sogs pas kyang sems /'grel skor ci rigs par 'gyur zer/ de dag kyang bar skabs kyi mkhas pa chos kyi spyan yangs 'ga' res gzigs pa'i dbang du byas la/ bdag gis rim mthang ba ni rwa 'bro gyi rma 'a zha lo chung mang 'or tsa mi chag lo shud ke shong dpangs jo 'gyur rnams so/ /bar skabs su tsa mi dang chag lugs kyang dar rab byung mod/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la bod khams 'dir rwa 'bro'i lugs gnyis po 'phrin las kyi sgo 'gran zla med pa yin zhing /'bro ba la sgrub pa'i bka' babs/ rwa ba la bshad pa'i bka' babs zer ba yang phyogs mthun rung yin te/ rwa lugs 'dzin pa la rgyud bshad shin tu dar zhing 'phrin las che la/ 'bro lugs pa rnams la grub pa brnyes pa ches mang du —14—

byung ba'ang yin no/ /lo tsā ba 'gos khug pas phyag rdor stod 'grel bsgyur ba ni lod la/ dus 'khor rtsa 'grel bsgyur ba'i thog ma ni/ gyi jo nyid yin par kun tu grags shing / sngon gyi chen po thams cad zhal 'cham pas 'gos kyis bsgyur ba med par sems la/ slob dpon gzhon nu dpal ba sogs yod skad gsung ba gal te bden srid na gyi jo dang dus mnyam tsam yin gyi ches snga ba min no/ /shong thang dpang gsum gyi 'gyur ni/ rgyud 'grel gyi don la rang blos dpyad cing / bod sten rnams la dri gshugs byed bzhin du sgra la mkhas pa'i sgo nas 'gyur bcos byas pa yin gyi/ /rwa 'bro tsā chag bzhi las brgyud pa logs su ni med 'a / blo gros kyi rtsal gyis dpyad pa'i bshad pa dang lag len mi 'dra ba ni yod do/ /de rjes jo nang 'gyur du grags pa lo tsā ba rnam gnyis kyis bsgyur ba ni/ shong 'gyur sgra don 'grig cing tshig sbyor legs par yod pa la/ da dung dom gyi cha gnad du ma phyin pa yod pa rnams la 'gyur rnying rnams dang dpang 'gyur sogs la'ang gtug/sa/ sgra don la mkhas pas legs par dpyad cing 'gyur bcos kyang mdzad la/ gnad che sa mang por chos rje kun mkhyen chen po nyid kyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa yin pas 'gyu/ra gsar gzhan rnams las ches byin rlabs che'o/ /de phyin chad nas kyang 'gyur bcos than thun byed ma/span byung zer te/ byung ba tsam du zad kyi bshad sgrub kyis gtan la phab pa med do/ /rgyud phyi ma gnyan lo dang she'u lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ phyis jo nang lo tsā ba blo gros dpal gyis sho lo ka bcu gcig 'gyur chad bsabs shing / gzhan la 'gyur bcos yang dag par mdzad go /don dam bsnyen pa paṇa chen zla rma gon gyi rang 'gyur —15—

nyid gtso bo yin la/ 'gyur bcos gzhan yang yod/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i lta 'dod mdor bstan ni/ kun mkhyen chen po jo nang pa'i thugs sras kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang gis bsgyur ba'o/ /gzhan yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs la dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mang rab 'gyur te/dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa zhes bya ba/ nā ro pas mdzad pa dang / dus zhabs pa zhes bya bas mdzad pa dang / mdzad byang med pa phyis bu ston gyis bsgyur ba dang / rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos mdzad pa dpang los bsgyur ba dang / sā dhu pu tras mdzad pa rje sbob brdar ba'i 'gyur te 'grel pa lnga yod pa/ phyi ma gsum po ni dang po'i rjes 'brang ngo / /dbang gi rab byed kyi 'grel pa rgya gar dā ri ka pas byas pa dang / dka' 'grel padma can dang / dus 'khore gyi sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa dang / yan lag bcu gcig pa gnyis dkyil chog yid 'ong 'phreng ba ste/ bzhi po de rnams paṇḍi ta dus zhabs pa zhes bya bas mdzad do/ /mdor bsdus dang po la slob dpon mi g.yo snying pos bshad sbyar snying po snang ba zhes bya ba mdzad pa dang / sā dhu pu tras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog gnyis/ bal bo mi tri pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang /lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs rol pa'i rdo rje dang dus zhabs pas mdzad pa gnyis/mtshan brjod sgrub thabs zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpas mdzad zer ba gcigasnying po rgyan zhes bya ba rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa'i sgrub thabs bram ze bsod snyoms pas mdzad pa dus 'khor gyi man ngag gi gzhung chung dus zhabs pas mdzad pa/ sbyor drug gi gzhung dpe med 'tshos mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel ba nyi ma rī —16—

dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor gsum gyi snying po gsal ba ye shes spyan sgrub nyi zla sgrub pa/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud/ sbas pa mig 'byed rtsa 'grel/ sbyor drug gi man ngag tsi lu bas mdzad pa/ shā bā ri'i gzhung chung / tsa mi'i sbyor 'phreng /bi bhu ti'i nang gi snye ma/ rtsa lhung gi gzhung byang chub sems dpas mdzad zer ba gcig /dus 'khor gyi sdoms tshig dang / dus 'khor la 'jug pa zhes bya ba a bha yā ka ras mdzad pa/ kha che paṇa chen shākya grwas mdzad pa rtsis kyi gzhung chung gsum/ gzhan yang rab gnas tshogs 'khor spyin sreg /rnal 'byor ma'i gtor chog sā dhu kirtis byas pa'i bstod pa rgyun chags rnams yod la/ rgyud gzhan gyi skor dus 'khor lugs su bkral ba la/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel ba bdud rtsi'i thigs pa nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa yod/ dpe med 'tshos mdzad zer ba'i mtshan brjod kyi 'grel ba tshigs bcad ma 'di phal cher de dang bshad pa mthun la/ padma dkar pos mdzad zer ba'i mtshan brjod kyi 'grel ba 'di bshad sgros de dang mi mthun yang dus 'khor lugs yin zhing / de gnyis ka bod rtsom ni min pa 'dra'o/ /rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa dang / /phan yon gyi 'grel pa ni bod rtsom zangs mar 'dug cing /bstan 'gyur sgrig mkhan rnams kyis dus 'khore phyogs kyi sdebs su bcug mod/ dus 'khor gyi lugs ye min no/ /yang rgyud kyi ngo bo mi gcig pa'i dbang gis bstan bcos 'gyur ro tshal bsdu ba po rnams kyis dus 'khor gyi chos skor la ma bcug 'dug kyang / dgongs pa gcig pa'i phyir 'di'i chos skor yin nges la rdo rje snying 'grel ni rtag gnyis kyi le'u thog ma lnga'i 'grel ba yin zhing /—17—

phyag rdor stod 'grel ni bde mchog rtsa rgyud le'u dang po'i sho lo ka byed dang /bcu gcig gi 'grel pa yin no/ /de bzhin du bde mchog gi sgrub thabs phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa dang / phag mo bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs khyab 'jug sbas pas mdzad pa dang / de'i dkyil chog 'jigs med lhas mdzad pa dang / da ri ka pa'i gzhung phran gnyis tsam dang / dgyes rdor gyi dka' 'grel nā ro 'grel chen du grags pa dang / rdo rje snying po'i smad 'grel du grags pa kha 'phangs yin pa de yang ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang 'brel ba la de tsam zhig 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /gzhan gyis bsgyur ba dang / snga rol nas 'gyur yang ma rnyed pa gzhan mang du yod srid na'ang grags che ba ni de dag go /chos 'byung zhi ba'i sgrub thabs ni paṇḍi ta nags rin gyi dus su 'gyur bar grags che ya nga ma mthong la yang tsa mi'i rgyud gsum du grags pa bla ma'i yon tan yongs bzung dang / ce spyang tshogs rol dang / glu gar gyi rgyud te gsum po ni/ mkhas pa chen po rnams bod kyis rtsams rgyud yin par bzhed pas tshig gi phyogs nas de ltar yin yang / don gyi cha nas skur pa gdab par mi bya'o/ /de dag las dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa ni/ nā ro ba'i gsung rgyun tsam yin nam sems te rtsom pa rang ni min pa 'dra la/ spyir rnam dpyod dang mthong rgya che ba'i paṇḍi ta zhig gis byas 'dug cing / legs bshad kyang mang mod/ skabs su mi bab pa'i bshad pa dang / sems 'grel dang mi mthun pa yang cung zad yod do/ /nā ro ba'i rtsom pa yin du chug kyang slob dpon de sku tshe de la phra mo rnams grub cing / grong 'jug sogs thun mong gi dngos grub chung ngu brnyes pa tsam yin pas/ sems 'grel —18—

dang mi mthun pa rnams dor bya yin gyi/ 'di na gzhan mkhas par grags pa gang dag sems 'grel dang 'dra bar rtsi ba mang po 'dug kyang gnang ma dgongs pa ste/ gser dang ra gan mnyam par ma rtsi shig rgyud sde gzhan sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i gsung gis dgongs 'grel med pa rnams la thebs gzhan med pa'i phyir/ so so skye bo mkhas pa las dang po pa la yang rtsis su byed pa'i skabs mang zhing / nus pa ci rigs pa brnyes pa rnams la lhag par yang rtsis su byed dgos mod/ chos 'di la ni sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi bshad pa thang mar brdal ba yod phyin chad pan chung dang grub chung gi tshig zur la 'jug dgos pa ma yin no/ /dus zhabs pas mdzad zer ba kun yang rgyud spyan 'dren pa po grub thob dus 'khor ba 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / tsi lu bar grags pa grub thob dharmā nanda dang / pi hā ṭā tsarya bsod snyoms pa 'od byed sbas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa ni ma yin la/ gal te de rnams kyis mdzad na rgyun spyan 'dren pa po nyid kyi phyir khungs tshad mar byed dgos kyang / de rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i glu re re tsam ma gtogs/ bstan bcos gzhan ni med par grags shing don la yang gnas so/ /yang rgyud sde gzhan gyi bshad sgrub cher mi mdzad par dus 'khor kho na'i bshad sgrub rtsal du 'don pa'i slob dpon su byung yang slob dpon dus 'khor ba zhes zer la/ de la zhes sbyar bas slob dpon dus 'khor zhabs zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ dus zhabs pa zhes pa 'di la sna tshogs pa yod cing / tsi lu ba dang /bsod snyoms pas mdzad zer ba'i gzhung phran 'di kun yang mtshan gyis byin gyis brlabs pa kho na'o/ /slob dpon nā ro ba ni bde dgyes sogs rgyud sde —19—

gzhan la rtsal 'don mdzad par grags shing grub la/ de dang de'i rgyud 'dzin yang mang zhing / rang yang khas len bzhin du nā ro ba dus 'khor zhabs chung ba'o zer ba ni 'brel med pa'i phyogs zhen thal ches pa'i mu cor te/ rgyu mtshan de ltar yin pa'i phyir na mthar gshugs na dus 'khor min pa mi shes zer bar 'gro nyen yod pas/ bstod ra mi gtong dgu gtong byed par 'dod kyang smad par song ba yin no/ /slob dpon a bha yā ka ras dus 'khor la gzhung phran mang du mdzad par grags shing / bod du yang gong du smos pa ltar than thun 'gyur la/lo tsā ba grags pa'i mtha' can bzhi car khong gi thugs sras yin zhing / /bzhi kas 'di'i gzhud 'grel 'bad nas bsgyur ba'i phyir/ kha cig a bha yā ka ra dus 'khor gtso bor mi byed do zer ba yang rdzun 'ba' zhig go /yang kyai rdo rje'i 'grel ba rdo rje'i tshig bsdus zhes bya ba 'di rdzogs rim nges don gyi bshad pa mang zhing / bshad pa bzang bar yang yod la/ rdzogs rim thams cad dus 'khor lugs ltar bkral ba yin mod kyi/ 'di yang nā ro bas mdzad par 'dod pa dang mi 'dod pa gnyis sngon yang byung la/ de la bod kha cig sa skya paṇḍi tas dpyal lo la phrag dog mdzad nas nā ro'i gsung min zhes bsgrags zer yang mi bden par snang ste/ de'i rgya dpe bdag gis mthong ba gcig na yang / kha che chen po byang chub rdo rjes mdzad zer ba snang ba don du gnyer na rgya dpe de yang bstan par bya'o/ /de ltar na dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung rnams la'ang mchog dang mchog min gyi dbye ba shes par bya'o/ /bod kyi dus 'khor ba mang po dag sā dhu pu tra dang 'jigs med 'gyung gnas gnyis/ /sā dhu —2()—

pu tra mchog yin par bzung nas/ /tha na lung 'dren tshun chod la yang / a bha ya'i sngon du de 'dren ci thub byed pa mthong ste/ su dhu pu tra de ni a bha ya'i rjes 'brang yin pa ma shes pa'o/ /de cis mngon zhe na/ des mdzad pa'i dus 'khor gyi dkyil chog na/ rdo rje 'phreng ba'i kha skong kho na mang ba'i phyir dang / /tshes lha'i kha dog rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng bzhin med kyang / gzhan phal cher mthun cing / de ni 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi rjes su byung ba'ang yin pas so/ /yang 'jigs med ni shing rta chen po mtshungs bral yin la/ gcig shos phyogs re'i blo gros can yin pa'ang go dgos la/ de ltar na slob dpon che chung dang / gzhung bzang ngan dang / khungs che chung gi dbye ba shes pa gal che'o/ /rgyud 'grel sgyur byed lo tsā ba ni gong du smos pa ltar yin la/ gzhan yang paṇa chen shākya shrī dang/bi bhu ti tsa spro dang / ratna rakṣi ta la sogs pa phyogs 'dir dbang dang rgyud bshad gsal bar mdzad pa dang / /rga lo tsā ba dang / tre bo shes rab dpal la sogs pa man ngag rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i rkang tshugs pa ji snyed cig byung ngo / /de dag las rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku chos rje yab sras bzhi po'i skabs su/ rwa 'bro tsa mi chag lo shākya shrī bi bhu ti lo grags pa'i lugs sogs dbang bka' dang rgyud bshad bka' ma nub pa thams cad gsan zhing / rdzogs rim brgyud pa mi 'dra ba bcu bdun sogs bka' yod lhad med thams cad gcig tu 'dus par mdzad pa yin la/ 'on kyang grub thob brgyud pa yin pa dang / nyams myong byin rlabs brgyud pa'i dbang las paṇa chen zla mgon gyi bka' srol 'bro lugs 'di nyid snying gi thig ler bkod nas bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs —21—

par mdzad cing / rdzogs rim ni bi bhu ti tsant+ra'i nye brgyud la yang shin tu rtsis su mdzad do/ /de dag kyang gdul bya gzhan ngo dang bstun te/ kha na ma tho ba spang zhing / rtsod pa'i dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur mi'i rten can gyi bla ma dam pa kho na rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams la byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgor gzigs nas/brgyud pa bzang tshad 'dus par mdzad pa yin gyi/ byin rlabs bka' babs kyi brgyud pa gcig gis chog ma shes pa yang ma yin la/ de las kyang lhag par dpal jo nang pa'i chos rje yab sras lnga'am drug rnams sa bcu'i dbang phyug rigs ldan rnams kyi sprul par the tshom med pa dang / ya nga sgos su dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mkhyen chen po dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes phyogs thams cad du snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis khyab pa 'di ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nyid 'gro ba'i don du bzhes gnyen dam pa'i tshul bzung ba yin pas/ chos 'di dang chos gzhan gang dag la byin rlabs dang ldan pa'i brgyud pa tha dad pa dang / legs par bshad pa'i zab don gyi rnam grangs gzhan de kun ni chu klung bye ba phrag brgya lta bu/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po rang nyid kyi nges don gyi bstan pa'i babs dang / byin rlabs kyi bka' babs ni rgya mtsho chen po bdun dang 'dra ba yin pas/ rang lugs la byin rlabs kyi bka' babs gzhan la 'tshol mi dgos so/ /zhes pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim gyi rnams par bshad pa las/ zab mo'i chos la 'jug sgo bstan pa'i sde tshan te dang po'o// //de lta bu'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo de yang phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi rim —22—

pa las brtsams te rtogs par bya dgos na/ 'dir ni gzhan gyi rim pa'o/ /de yang smin byed kyi dbang dang / grol byed kyi lam dang / grol ba 'bras bu ste gsum mam kun khyab chos nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ste bzhi'o/ /skabs 'dir gnyis pa grol byed lam gyi dbang du byas na/ grol byed lam spyi ldog nas gtan la dbab pa dang / sgrub thabs kyi rnam gzhan bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la grol byed lam gyi ngo bo/ nang sel gnyis su dbye ba/ phye ba so so'i rang bzhin/ rang bzhin don ldan gyi mtshan nyid/ nyams len sgrub pa'i dgos pa/ grangs dang go rim nges pa/ dbang lam 'bras bu'i sbyor tshul te bdun no/ /dang po ni/ spyir theg pa gsum gyi lam thams cad grol byed kyi lam yin yang / gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i phyogs 'dir skabs su bab pa smin grol gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i grol byed lam gyi ngo bo ci zhe na/ gzhi sgyur ba'i lam khyad par can la 'jog pa yin no/ /de la theg pa spyi la grags pa'i gnas gyur dang / sngags pa phal la grags pa'i gzhi sgyur ba dang / chos 'ang/ la grags pa'i sgrib bral du byed pa zhes pa rnams don gyi 'gangs 'dra ba yin rna/ /de yang gzhi zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba snod bcud kyi 'jig rten/ phung khams skye mched lus ngag sems dang chags pa'i thig le las nyon sdug bsngal gsum gyis bsdus pa 'di dag yin la/ gzhi de la dmigs nas re re bzhin rnam pa 'ga' ba'i gnyen pos mthar de dang de'i snang ba 'gags pa'i stong pa la sbyor bar byed pa ni gzhi spong ba'i lam yin la/ 'dir ni de lta bu ma yin te/ gzhi'i chos de rnams nyid la dmigs nas snang cha de rtsa ba nas bkag pa'i snang med kho —23—

na la mthar skyel ba mi byed de/ /lha sku dang bde chen la sogs pa gzhi'i chos de nyid dang rnam pa phyed 'dra ba tsam du bsgyur nas/ snang bcas kyi ye shes de nyid bsgoms pas/ gzhi'i gnas tshul rtogs par byed pa yin no/ /de la 'di lhar go dgos te/ spyir mdo sngags theg pa gsum gyi lam kun la yang / gzhi spong ba dang / gzhi sgyur ba'i cha shas gnyis ka 'dres mar yod mod kyi/ /theg dman gnyis ni gzhi sbong ba kho na shas che la/ theg chen mdo lugs su yang cung zhig spong ba gtso che zhing / bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum du cha mnyam pa tsam yin la/theg pa bla na med pa 'dir sgyur ba nyid ches mang zhing lhag par gtso che bas/gang zhig gtso che ba de'i sgo nas bzhag go /de yang dper na dug gi sdong po zhig la/ lo 'dab gcod pa dang / rtsa ba 'byin pa dang / mes sreg pa la sogs pas dug med par byed pa ni gzhi spong ba'i dpe yin te de'i lugs la tha mal gyi lus 'di dag par byed pa la dper mtshon na/ dang por lus kyi snang ba bkag pa'i snang med la mnyam par 'jog mi thub pa'i skabs/ lus 'di mi gtsang ba dang / mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / byed pa pos stong pa sogs sgom la/de dag kyang lus kyi snang ba nub par byed pa'i ring rgyu tsam yin te/ mi gtsang bas lus sra ba ma yin pa mi brtan pa'i rgyu dang / sdug bsngal bas lus kyi snang ba mi 'dod pa dang / mi rtag pas skad cig re re bzhin 'jig pas lus kyi snang ba shar nas sdod long med pa dang / stong pas na gang zag gcig gis dbang bsgyur nas lus yod par byed pa 'gog pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su yang bdag med yid yul du byed pa yod mod kyi/ gsal bar mngon du byed —24—

mi nus so/ /de la goms nas phyis theg dman ltar na gang zag gi bdag med de/ lus de mi brtan par ma zad/ de la dngos po gcig pu rang rkang tshugs pa med pas nga bdag med par mthong nas der snang ba zad pa dang / theg chen la chos kyi bdag med te/ de yang mi gtsang mi rtag sdug bsngal stong pa'i phyir snang ba tsam ma gtogs/ rtag tshugs thub pa med par shes te/ lus nam yang gdod nas ma grub nga tsam la blo bzhag pa na/ yid yul du snang ba ci yang med pa zhig la gnas par 'gyur ro/ /des na dmigs pa'i rnal 'byor re re bzhin thog mar khyad gzhi lus la dmigs nas bsgoms kyang de ma thag tu lus kyi snang ba 'gags pa'i snang med la yang yang gtod par byed cing / de nyid dang por gsal snang tsam dang / phyis mngon du phyogs pas sgrub par byed de/ dug rtsa ba nas bcom ste mi snang bar byed pa bzhin no/ /theg dman gang zag gi bdag med tsam sgom par byed pa la lus gdod nas stong par rtogs pa ni med mod/de'i 'jig rten 'das pa'i mnyam gzhag tu tha mal lus kyi snang ba dmigs par mi byed do/ /de ltar na lus ni mtshon byed de chos thams cad sbyar ro/ /gzhi mi spong bar sgyur ba'i dpe ni/ dug gi sdong po la sngags dang sman sogs reg pa'i khyad par gyi bsgrubs pas/ de'i nyes pa rnams ni sangs/ yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa'i sman mchog phun sum tshogs pa'i sdong por gyur pa ni/dug la skyon du mi blta zhing / bsreg bcad la sogs pa ma dgos par sdong po de'i rigs rgyun yang ma chad la/ yal ga lo 'dab kyi phyi dbyibs la rnam 'gyur chen po med kyang / nus pa dang byed las shin tu mi 'dra bar bsgyur bas gzhi —25—

dug gi sdong po bsreg bcad kyis spong ba mi dgos par rdzas sngags kyi sbyor bas nus pa dang mtshan nyid thams cad bsgyur ba yin no/ /de bzhin du 'dir yang spong sems zhe bcad dang / nyes dmigs mthong ba'i chags bral dang / stong nyid kyi sgo nas snang ba yal du gzhug pa sogs gtso bor mi spyod de/ dgos pa'i dbang gis lam gyi yan lag phra mo re re tsam ni ma gtogs so/ /des na rang gi lus la dmigs nas dag snang lha'i rnam pa dmigs pas sgom pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs lus stong gzugs dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar sgrub pa sogs gzhi dus lus kyi snang ba dang phyed tsam rnam pa mthun te/ bskyed rim la zhal phyag gzhal med khang sogs gnas dang lus kyi rnam par mtshungs pa dang /rdzogs rim la stong gzugs kyi sku dang zhing khams 'char ba dang / bde ba lus dang mnyam pa sogs kyi phyir ro/ /phyed tsam cig shos kyi cha nas rnam pa 'gal te/ bskyed rim la tha mal gyi rnam pa dang 'gal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa dang/ rdzogs rim la rdul chos kyi rnam pa dang 'gal ba'i ye shes kyi rnam pa dang / 'gyur ba'i rnam pa dang 'gal ba'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba la sogs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ rkyu mtshan des na slob dpon sangs rgyas/ ye shes kyis kyang /rnam pa 'gal ba dang 'dzin stangs mi mthun pa'i tha snyad mdzad de/ de dang rnam pa 'gal bar gyur pa'i yid/ /ces dang / gang zhig gang dang mi mthun pa dag tu/ /zhes bshad pa lta bu'o/ /'o na rnam pa 'gal ba'i phyir gzhi spong bar mi 'gyur ram snyam na/ gzhi'i chos la spong sems dang mi mthun par 'dzin pa med de/ gzhi'i chos de nyid la dmigs gtad byas nas de dag sgrub pa'i tshul gyis —26—

bsgom pa'i phyir/ gzhi spong bar mi 'gyur te/ dper na dbul po'i skye bo rnams kyi srog phral nas mi dbul po med par byed pa lta bu ma yin gyi/ dbul po la nor dang yo byad mang po sbyin te/ phyug por bsgyur nas dbul po med par byed pa bzhin no/ /des na mi dbul po de'i steng gi mi'i dngos po tsam zhig ni gzhi dngos yin la/ de'i khyad chos skyon du gyur pa bkren pa de bzlog cing / khyad gzhi mi'i dngos po la nam yang gnod pa med par phun sum tshogs pa gzhan yang thob pa dang 'dra ba yin no/ /yang 'o na mi spong ba zhes pas skyon mi spong ba'i phyir lam du mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ skyon mi spong ba ga la zhig ste/ gzhi spong ba'i lam las kyang 'di lhag par skyon spong tshul stobs che'o/ /des na mi spong ba zhes pa ni/ skyon du blta ba dang/ mi 'phrod par 'dzin pa dang / spong sems kyis ched du gnyer nas spong ba ma yin pa'i don te/ dper na skyes bu zhig gis skyes bu gang yang rung ba la/ skyon rtog pa dang / 'khon pa dang / de las gud du 'gro ba la des nge spangs so zhes brjod kyi/ skyes bu de de la dga' ba'i blo ma dor bzhin du rang bor pa la spangs ba'i tha snyad mi 'jug pa bzhin no/ /des na lus kyi chos nyid ye shes kyi lha skur gdod nas grub cing / de la brten nas byung ba'i dri ma yin pa'i phyir/ me long gi g.ya' me long gi gzugs dang phyogs 'dra tsam du 'byung ba ltar/ /rdo rje'i sku dang rnam pa phyogs 'dra rung tsam du lus de yang bzhin lag dbang po dang bcas pa'i rnam par shar/ de'i tshe rnal 'byor pas lus dang lus kyi chos nyid gnyis rnam pa 'dra ba'i 'dra chos lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas tha mal gyi lus kyi rigs rgyun de/ gnas gyur nas lam gyis bsdus pa'i —27—

ye shes lha sku'i rnam pa can du gyur pa ni/ dper na sngags btab pas dug gi nus pa sman mchog gi nus pa gyur pa lta bu'o/ /lam dus kyi lha sku de goms pa na/ tha mal lus kyi snang ba'i dri ma kun dag pa'i tshe/ lam yang dbyings su thim nas chos nyid kyi sku rdo rje mngon 'gyur du thob par 'gyur te/ tshul 'di chos gzhan thams cad la yang rigs bsgre'o/dper na 'dod chags kyi chos nyid bde ba 'gyur med rnam pa thams cad pa yin/de la brten nas byung ba'i phyir/ 'dod chags nyid kyang bde ba gnas lus longs spyod kyi rnam pa can du shar/ de yang bde ba 'gyur bcas dang / rnam pa tha mal ba yin mod kyi/ rnal 'byor pas 'dod chags dang chos nyid bde ba rnam bcas tsam du mtshungs pa'i cha nas gzung ste/ zhu bde 'gyur med dang / stong gzugs kyi sku'am/ bskyed rim gyi lha sku gnas dang mchod par bcas pa'i rnam pa can tshogs pa gcig tu yang yang bsgrubs pas sngar gyi 'dod chags kyi rigs rgyun de yon tan du gyur nas zhu bde 'gyur med kyi lha sku'am/ lam gyi chas bsdus pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar 'gro tshul sgrub pa po nyams rtogs mtho dman dang bstun mod/ gang ltar yang lam gyi bde ba rnam bcas de bsgoms pas nam zhig 'dod chags kyi bag chags rang zad pa na/ chos nyid kyi bde ba rnams pa thams cad pa de thob pa yin te/ nyon mongs lam byed kyi gnad mthar thug pa yang 'di kho na'o/ /de dag gi tshe lus dang 'dod chags la smod pa dang /mi mthun par blta ba dang / sbong sems kyis spong pa dang / blo thag bcad nas rgyang skyur gyi tshul mi byed pas nyon mongs mi spong ba dang / lus mi spong ba zhes tha —28—

snyad byed la/ lus dang 'dod chags nam gnas gyur pa'i mtshams nas ches shin tu spangs pa'ang yin mod kyi/ rang spangs la song ba las gzhan du ched gnyer gyis spangs pa ma yin no/ /gzhi'i mchog lus dang 'dod chags kyi chos nyid la dmigs nas spong ba'i dmigs gtad mi byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/lus dang 'dod chags kyi rdzas rgyun la dmigs nas ched du spong ba dang mi mthun par 'dzin pa med pas/ gzhi lus dang 'dod chags kyi rdzas rgyun mi spong la/ lus dang 'dod chags kyi steng du snon kha dang / longs spyod dga' ston gyi tshul du lha sku dang bde ba rnam bcas bsgoms pas/ lus kyi sdug bsngal dang /'dod chags kyi sems rgyud ma rungs par byed pa'i cha de bzlog nas/ lha sku dang bde ba khyad par can rgyun mi chad par shar ba na/ lus dang 'dod chags kyi rdzas rgyun de gnyis kyang / lha sku dang bde bar gnas 'gyur ba'i phyir gzhi bsgyur ba zhes bya'o/ /de ltar na/ gzhi bsgyur ba'i ming tsam zhig sngags par 'dod pa kun gyi kha na rgyu yang don ni mkhas rlom phal gyis kyang phyogs mthong tsam las gsal dag tu go ba zhig mi 'dug pas 'dir rjen cher du bshad do/ /gzhi bsgyur ba'i lam zhes pa'i don de ltar yin la/ khyad par can zhes bya ba ni/ 'dod chags chen po'i lam yin pa ste/ de yang theg dman gyi lam ni chags bral kho na dang / theg chen mdo ni chags bral shas che ba dang / rgyud sde 'og ma'i lam ni cha mnyam pa tsam dang / 'dir ni chags chen gyi lam ches gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /de ltar na 'dus pa phyi ma las/ gsang sngags kyi don yid skyob pa la bshad pa dang / dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od las kyang / rdo rje theg pa zhes —29—

pa'i rdo rje'i don chos 'di nyid kyi rang lugs las byung ba'i stong nyid snying rje dbyer med dam/ bde stong dbyer med la bshad de/ yid skyob pa'i don ni lam sgyur ba dang / bde stong dbyer med ni chags chen gyi don yin no/ /gnyis pa nang sel gnyis su dbye ba ni/ 'o na de 'dra ba'i lam de la rang 'bras dngos grub sgrub tshul rnam pa gnyis kyi dbye ba rtogs pa'i phyir/bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis su dbye'o/ /de gnyis kyi sgra don ni/ bskyed rim gyi skad dod utpa ti kra ma zhes pa la/ utpa ti bskyed pa ste gsar du bcos pa'i don yin pa dang / rdzo gas rim gyi skad dod ni dzin kra ma zhes pa'i ni dzin ni rdzogs pa ste/ rtsol med shugs byung du 'byung ba'i don yin la/de gnyis ka'i kra ma ni rim pa ste lam gyi go rim mam/ thabs yin pa'i don no// //gsum pa dbye ba so so'i rang bzhin ni/ rgyud las/ lha yi dmigs pa gang yin mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bskyed rim gyi ngo bo ni rjes su dpag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor yin la/ rdzogs rim gyi ngo bo ni/ mngon sum gyi lha'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de la rjes su dpag pa'i don ni/ gzhan las rgyu mtshan dran pa'i nges shes kyi khyad par la 'jog pa ltar/ 'dir yang bris sku sogs la blta ba dang / tshig tu brjod pa las dngos su thos pa'i don bsams te/ sngar gyi mthong thos dang rjes su mthun par de ma yin yang de dang 'dra ba'i rnam pa shar ba'o/ /de ni rgyud las/mngon sum med na rjes su dpag pa shi ba'i lus bzhin de nyid min pa yis ni —30—

brtags pa gang / /de ni ri mo sogs la blta bya yongs su ma smin blo can rnal 'byor rnams kyis bsgom pa'i don/ /ces gsungs te/ bris sku la sogs pa'i rnam pa las rjes su dpags nas/ lha'i sku ni 'di 'dra'o zhes yid kyi snang ngor gsar du bcos pa tsam las/ gnas lugs la zhugs pa'i de kho na nyid ma yin no/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ ji skad du/ mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /zhes nam mkha' la skar ma shar ba'i dpe 'dis stong pa nyid las ma g.yos bzhin du shar ba'i don dang / skar ma'i gzugs brnyan rtogs pas bsgom mi dgos par mig gis dngos su mthong ba ltar rdzogs rim gyi lha ni stong par blos gsar du sgom pa la ma bltos par stong pa'i ngang las shar zhing shar nas kyang stong pa'i rang bzhin las ma 'das par gnas pa dang/ stong pa dang lha sku gnyis kar rnam rtog gis brtags pa ma yin par dngos su myong ba'i yul du byung bas na/ mos pa yid byed kyi rnal 'byor tsam ma yin par de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /yang 'ga' zhig 'di snyam du/ de kho na nyid ni don dam pa yin la/ de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor de yang mngon sum du rtogs pa la byed na ni/ so skye'i rdzogs rim med par 'gyur zhing / dmigs pa'i yul ma nor ba'i sgo nas byed na ni/ bskyed rim kyang de kho na nyid kyi yid byed du mi 'gyur ram/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes pa yod pas so snyam na/ ma yin te 'dir re zhig de kho na nyid ces pa don dam bden pa nyag gcig la 'jog mi dgos te/ 'dus byas mi rtag par sgom pa sogs de yin pa ltar/ kun rdzob 'khor ba'i rang bzhin gnas lugs ni snang —31—

bcas kyi ye shes yin pa la/ de dang mthun pa'i gsal snang shar ba'i gnas tshul dang shin tu mthun pa'i de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor yin la/ snang cha de ma brtags par dngos su snang ba'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa la mngon sum zhes bya'o/ /bskyed rim ni dngos po'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor du gnas pa de la dmigs pa tsam yin yang / de dang rnam pa dang mtshan nyid mi mthun pa che ba'i phyir/ /de kho na nyid min pa zhes gsungs la/ gong du smos pa ltar rtog sgom nyid kyi phyir/ mchog tu bzang yang rjes dpag las ma 'das so/ /'o na lus kyi chos nyid lha sku'i rnam pa can du gnas par khyed 'dod na ci'i phyir bskyed rim de kho na nyid yid byed ma yin/ 'dzin stangs dang gnas tshul mthun pas so snyam na/de kho na nyid yid byed tsam yin du chug kyang / rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib can gyi phyir de kho na nyid rnal 'byor du byed mi nus la/ sgrub pa po des lus kyi chos nyid mngon sum du ni ma mthong / gsal snang yang ma skyes pas chos nyid lha skur sgom pa sogs su rlom kyang / chos nyid la bsgoms par ma song de'i don spyi la bsgoms par song bas/ don spyi ni lha'i skur med pa'i phyir/ yul dang rnam pa mthun pa ma yin no/ /yang chos nyid ces bya ba ming rkyang gcig la dmigs na de ltar 'gyur yang / lus 'di nyid lhar sgom pa'am/ 'di stong par sbyangs pa'i shul du lha bsgoms pas gnas lugs la reg par 'gyu/ra snyam na'ang / ma dag pa'i lus 'di yang lha sku ma yin la/ 'di sbyangs pa'i shul yid ngo'i stong pa de yang lha sku ma yin pas/ de 'dra de lha skur sgom pa gnas tshul dang mthun pa ma yin no/ /rdzogs rim ma brtags par rang shar ba'i lha sku ni thams cad kyang —32—
