thugs bskul ba legs par grub pa yin la/ las drug po de dag la dmigs pa'i khyad par la sogs pa gzhan dmigs gsal ma gsungs shing / gnon byed dang mtha' bsten gyi yi ge'i sngags nyid kyi mthu las de ltar 'byung ba'o/ /skabs de'i bsnun pa la sogs pa byed rgyu'i lha de/ rang re'i yid kyi mos ngor dam ye dbyer med kyi lha de yin pas/ gdod ma'i lha dang 'bras bu'i lhar mos pa yin mod kyang / song tshod la don dam dbyings kyi lha lta ci smos/ kun rdzob gzhan snang gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i lha rnams ma yin te/ des na bdag bskyed kyi lha dang / de'i yang gtso bo dam tshig pa nyid do/ /dam tshig pa'i lha de'i ngo bo ji lta bu zhe na/ slar slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba'i dus kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi rgyun slob ma'i sems rgyud la 'phos pa na/ de rang sems kyi chos nyid la phan 'dogs shing mthun pa'i chos yin pas/ chos dbyings de'i nus pa dang cung zad 'dres pas gzhan dge ba'i chos spyad pa rnams kyang de'i grogs su 'gyur zhing / sngags kyi byin rlabs kyi rgyun de rgyur byas nas/ dang por dbang dang phyis bskyed rim gyi dus su de lha'i rnam pa can du bzheng par 'gyur la/ mos pas chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes lhar gyur pa la/sngar sangs rgyas thob zin pa'i ye shes lha gzhan rgyud ltar snang ba rnams la rang la bstim zhing bsre ba'i nga rgyal byas mod kyang / song tshod la sngar sngags kyi byin rlabs sems la bzhag pa'i rgyun de bskyed rim gyi lha skur bzhengs pa yin pas de la gsal snang rags pa thob pa na/ de lha skur gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /de 'dra'i lha de sems snang tsam las rgyud logs pa med kyang / gzhan rgyud ltar snang ba'i —439—

ye shes lha rnams kyi byin rlabs zhugs te/ kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul du rang dang 'dres nas bzhugs la/ rang dang res 'ga' gcig pa dang res 'ga' tha dad pa'i rnam par snang ba de ni bskyed rim gyi dam tshig sems dpa' dngos yin la/ lha de rang las logs pa'i sems dang ldan pa min yang / sgrub pa po rang nyid kyis spyod par mi nus pa'i sems can gyi don mang po byed do/ des sgrub pa po kha cig la 'jam zhing bde ba kho nas dngos grub sgrub par yang byed la/ kha cig la ni re zhig dngos grub mi stsol ba dang / g.yin 'ga' la ni 'khu ba'i tshul 'byung zhing / nad dang gnod pa la sogs par 'gyur ba yang yod do/ /de dag kyang sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi las kyi sgrib pa che chung dang / dge ba'i bsags pa che chung dang dam tshig dag ma dag gi dbang las snang ba yin gyi/ sngags kyi lha la rnam rtog kyang med cing rang las gzhan du grub pa yang med de/ dper na 'khrul 'khor gyi mi 'khrul 'khor mchog las byung ba zhig gis skye bo ngan pa la brdeg cing gsod pa dang / bzang po 'ga' zhig la rim gro'i bya ba byed pa dang 'dra ste/sngags kyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /des na gsang sngags sku ni rab sgrub byed/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po yin/ /zhes sogs gsang 'dus skor las/gsang sngags kyi sku zhes bshad pa'i don nges tig can ni 'di yin yang 'dus pa ba phal gyis ma rga'o/ /des na gsang 'dus dang rdo rje gur sogs las 'byung ba'i lha phur bus gdab pa sdig sbyor zhes grags pa yang gnad 'di la brten pa yin pas/ rang gi sems kyis bkod pa'i gzugs brnyan dngos grub sgrub par byed pa'i spogs chog gi khyad par zhig yin gyi/ gzhan rgyud kyi lha la gnod par —440—

'gyur ba ni nam yang ma yin no// lha 'dis sems kyi dri ma sbyangs na/ ye shes kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba la shin tu phan pa ni yod/ 'di rang ye shes kyi skur 'gyur ba ni min te/ sems 'grel skor gsum gyi dgongs pa'o/ /'dis dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul ni/ 'di dang sangs rgyas dngos kyi byin rlabs 'dres te/sgrub pa po'i blo'i snang ba la rgyud gzhan gyis bsdus pa'i yi dam lhar snang nas rang la dngos grub stsal bar snang ba yang yod cing / rang gi lus ngag yid rnams sngags kyi lha de'i ngo bor thim pa na/ bskyed rim pa rags pa'i lus ngag ste/ 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin du gyur pa'i rnam gzhag byed la/ gong du bshad pa'i rig sngags kyi nus pa dang byin rlabs sems la bzhag pa de ni kun rdzob bden pas bsdus pa'i sngags sdom gyi ngo bo rang rkang tshugs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes zhor la 'ongs pas chog go /yang las drug po de rnams rgyud 'grel las/ bzlas pa'i skabs su che thang du bshad cing / rgya bod kyi dus 'khor ba phal cher gyis gal cher bshad 'dug pa dang / rgyud don go ba la phan pa'i phyir gsal por brjod do/ /'on kyang rang lugs ni 'di yin te/ 'di 'dra ba lha gnad la bor ba yin pas sngon sngags kyi lha la dad pa'i tshad du bzhag pa gcig bskyed rim la cung zad sems brtan cing / bzlas brjod mthar phyin pa yan chad la dngos grub dngos nyid grub pa'am/ phra mo'i las rnams yin yang thog med du grub pa 'byung ba'i don du sgrub pa yin gyi/ las dang po pa la ni dgos pa min pas da lta'i dus na rjes mthun pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len pa'i tshe/ dang por snying po'am snye snying ngam rnam bcu dbang ldan bye ba spyin sreg dang —441—

bcas pa song zhing / bskyed rim gyi khrid cung zad bskyangs pa zhig gis lha la gus pa'i tshul gyis las drug po 'di dag byas nas gsung gi sngags 'bum phrag bcu sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de rjes sku'i bzlas pa 'grub na ni legs/gong du bye ba bzlas pa des dod thub tu bzhug kyang rung ngo / /rgyud 'grel dngos kyi dgongs pa las drug bsnyen par bshad pa ni/ las sam dngos grub kyi don gyi sgos bsnyen yin gyi/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ma yin te/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob cing / lha gnad la bor ba med na mi 'grub pa'i gang zag gi rigs de la'ang nang tshan gsum yod pas rab kyis las drug brtsams pas dngos grub thob/ 'bring gis de'i steng du gsung bzlas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa dang / tha mas de'i steng du sku'i bzlas pa bye bas dngos grub thob ces rags tshig tsam go bar byas nas/ de re re bskyed rim la brtan pa chung ngu thob na zhi sogs thogs pa med pa dang / 'bring gis ro langs la sogs pa dngos su 'grub cing / rab tu thob pas chen po rig 'dzin gnyis kyi dngos grub 'a snang ba dngos su thob par 'gyur ro/ /de thob nas spyod pa spyad pas myur du rig pa 'dzin pa thob pa'o/ /da ni skabs 'dir dkyus kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa bshad par bya ste/thugs kar zla ba'am nyi ma'am/ zla nyi sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i gdan la rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge brtsegs pa khams so so'i /spa dog nges can nam/ yang na gtso bo nyid kyi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa sngon po'am/ las thams cad pa'i don du ljang khur bsgoms kyang rung la/ de las 'od zer spros 'phags pa mchod —442—

sems can gyi don byas slar bsdus te rnam bcu dbang ldan la thim par bsams la/ oṃ āoṃ swāhā zhes bzla zhing / yang gnas bzhir rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon nan tan du ༷mi gsal btab nas spyi bo dang / gsang ba dang /snying ga'i hūX gi steng tsam ste/ gnas gsum po de gang rung gcig tu snga ma bzhin bsgoms te/ de thams cad la 'od zer spro bsdu byed pa ni snying po'i bzla tshul yin la/ rigs drug gi sa bon dang / nye snying la yi ge drug po rnams gnas drug tu bkod nas 'od zer spro bsdu byed cing / khyad par du nye snying la yi ge drug po re re'i gnas su g.yas g.yon nam steng 'og tu oṃ dang swāhā re re sgom mo/ /sku dang gsung gi sngags la thugs kar nyi ma sogs kyi steng du sa bon hūX la sngags de dang des bskor ba bsgoms nas spro bsdu byed pa ste/ 'khor gyi bzlas pa la yang des rigs 'gre'o/ /las drug po rnams la ni/ snying gar zla nyi sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i steng du rang rang gi sngags kyi yig 'khru steng du oṃ dang / 'og tu phaṭa dang swāhā la sogs pa so so'i skabs bzhin sbyar ba 'od zer 'phro ba bsams te/ gtso bo rang nyid kyi sku gang las dang rjes su mthun pa'i bya ba byas par bsam/ yi ge'i kha dog ni/ kā yig lta bu lha nyid kyi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa dang / oX yang de dang 'dra bar kha cig bzhed la/ steng gi yi ge dang sku la sngags gnyis las dang rjes su mthun par bya dgos na/ dang po rengs pa'i las yin pas ser po dang / gnyis pa dbye bar gtogs pa'i phyir nag po dang / gsum pa dgug pa dang drug pa —443—

dbang yin pas dmar po dang / bzhi pa zhi ba dang / lnga pa rgyas pa yin pas dkar po ste/ las dang mthun pa'i kha dog gam/ yang na gzhan de dang 'dra ba la ha sogs 'byung ba rang rang gi kha dog tu byas kyang legs par bzhed na/ de'i tshe ming gi yi ge dang po las kyi kha dog tu byed do/ /'khor gyi lha rnams dgos su sgrub pa yin na/ rang rang gi sa bon la spyi dang mthun par de nyid gsum spel lam lnga spel du byed pa lta bu'i thugs kyi bzlas pa bya/ gsung mtshan sngags kho na ni gtso bor mi byed la/ sa bon sngon 'gro can gyi mtshan du byed pa ni/ o ā tā tā re hū swāhā/ zhes pa lta bu ming las lhag pa sku sngags kyi tshul du bzlas pa bya/ de yang mdun bskyed du byed na rang dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs kar hū gi mtha' skor du sngags des bskor ba dang / mdun gyi thugs kar sa bon bsgom ste/ 'od zer phan tshun du bstim pa dang spro bsdu byed/ mdun bskyed kyi lha de dang por rang gi thugs ka nas spro zhing mthar rang gi thugs kar bsdu'o/ /bdag bskyed du byed na gtso bos rigs 'gre ste/ nus ma nas rab gtum ma'i bar du nges par sbyor zhing / gzhan yang gza' bcu dang / nag po chen po dang / 'phrog ma la sogs pa yang sgrub tu rung ngo / /spyir ni mos pa'i dbang las de tsam bshad pa yin gyi/ bcom ldan 'das sna tshogs gtso bo dus 'khor nyid grub na thams cad 'grub la/ gtso bos byin gyis ma brlabs na gzhan rnams kyang mi 'grub par bshad pas gtso bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor la nan tan du bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di skabs tsar tsi kā sogs rang rang 'khor bcas kyi bzlas pa byed na/sngags kyi spro bsdu sogs gtso mo kho na la byas pas chog /sngags ni/ oṃ ā ha —444—

tsar tsi kā hi hi ya yi lho yu yil ya hū swāhā/ zhes bzla ste gzhan rnams kyang des rigs 'gre'o/ /ma mo brgyad dang lha chen rnams dang / khro bo rnams dang /klu rnams dang / rab gtum ma rnams kyi bzlas brjod byas na/ 'phral gyi 'dod don phra mo mang po sgrub tu yod de/ dman pa la mos pa rnams la shin tu nye bar mkho ba'ang yin no/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa 'di dag bla ma dam pa rnams kyi man ngag gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa yin pa'i phyir/ nyams len gyi sgo nas gces spras su bya yi/ chos skad kha rgyugs dang / dgag sgrub kha la khyer ba'i rtsod chos su 'bebs nga/ra ma byed cig rgyud gzhan gyi man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bkod pa'i bzlas pa/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa/ do li'i bzlas pa/ yid bzlas/'gog bzlas sogs kyang sbyor du rung bar mngon la/ bskyed rim gyi rdor bzlas ni ye shes le'u'i so brgyad pa'i 'grel par rdzogs rim dang bsres pa'i tshul gyis gsungs te/ ji skad du/ 'dir bgrang 'phreng med cing sngags brjod pa med de/ dbugs 'byung ba dang 'jug pa dag dang lhan cig sngags kyi yi ge rnams rab tu 'byung ba dang 'jug pa me tog gi 'phreng ba bzhin du zla ba dang nyi ma'i rang bzhin lugs dang mthun pa dang / lugs dang mi mthun pas blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas snying ga'i sa bon las sngags kyi yig 'bru dbugs 'byung ba dang lhan cig byung ste/ nyi ma'i lam sna bug g.yas pa nas lugs dang mi mthun par sngags kyi tha mas sna drangs te 'gro ba dang / dbugs nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig lugs mthun zhes pa oṃ sogs sngags kyi thog mas sna drangs te zla ba'i lam sna bug g.yon pa nas 'jug cing / snying ga'i sa bon la —445—

thim/ rlud gnas pa na sa bon gcig pu la sems gtod pa ste/ bskyed rim gyi rdor bzlas 'di lta bu'ang gsal bar gsungs pas/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rdor bzlas dngos nyid kyang 'dis shugs la 'phangs bas gsal bar mdzad do// //bzhi pa phan gnod kyi yan lag rtsi ba ni/ gong du a ku ha rko sogs khams so so'i dgra grogs tha mal nga/ gsum rtsi ba'i tshul rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin yin pa/ don gyi snying po ni spyir rgyud 'di las gnas skabs gzhan phal cher du dbyangs sum cu'am so gnyis/ gsal byed sum cu dang gong dpe byad brgyad cu'i skabs bzhi bcur phye ba sogs gsungs mod kyi/ dgra grogs rtsi ba'i skabs 'dir brda sprod sogs kyi gzhung las 'byung ba dang mthun te/ ngag sbyor gyi rim pa dang / brtan g.yo so so'i sa bon dang / dus so sor 'char tshul dang yi ge phan tshun phan gnod byed tshul te/ gnas skabs bzhi po de dag la phal cher mtshungs pa mang yang so sor rang rang gi dgos pa'i dbang gis mi 'dra ba yang mang du yod do/ /des na gnas skabs snga ma gsum gyi me chu lta bu dgra gshed kyi rigs su gtogs pa yin yang / dngos su yi ge phan tshun gnod pa byed par ma nges te/ 'ga' zhig bar ma dang / 'ga' zhig phan pa yang yod do/ /'dir sngags kyi dang po dang ming gnyis la nges par phan gnod tha mal gsum 'byung ba'i dbang du mdzad de/ 'di tsam zhig gsungs pa yin la/ 'di'i dbang du byas na chu ni me'i dgrar nges shing / rlud la tha mal pa ste nus med du nges la/ sa la grogs por nges kyang spyi ldog nas chu khams kyi yi ge tsam me'i dgra la sogs pa'i rigs su skyes pa tsam yin yang / me rlung sa gsum gyi yi ge —446—

la re re bzhin du phan gnod bar ma gsum kar 'byung ba'i skabs srid pa yin no/ /des na skabs gzhan du gsungs pa'i gsal byed sum cu po rnams la nang tshan lnga tshan drug la khams drug gi re re spyor zhing / lnga tshan re re yang lnga lnga'o/ /dbyangs la sde tshan drug la khams drug mi sbyor yang sde tshan re re bzhin kham/sa 'byung ba lnga lnga'i dbye ba sogs gsungs pa rnams dang / 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ der ar yig gnyis me dang / al yig gnyis sar 'byung yang 'dir ni bzhi po de'i yi ge dang po ni a kho na yin pas nam mkha'i khams su brtsi la/ ra la gnyis me dang sa yin yang dang po'i yi ge ma yin pas phan gnod brtsi mi dgos so/ /e i gnyis i dang 'dra/ o au gnyis u dang 'dra la cung zad stobs chung ba ni yin no/ /'dir ku tsu ṭu pu tu zhes 'byung ba ni zhabs kyu u yig sbyar bas/ rang rang gi sde ba thams cad mtshon pa ste/ sgra'i gzhung las uta kyis sde dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba bzhin no/ /des na ku ni ka sde dang / tsu ni tsa sde dang / ṭu ni ṭa sde dang / pu ni pa sde dang / tu ni ta sde'i ming yin la/ de'i phyir a ka kha ga gha nga / ha na rnams mkha' khams yin zhing /tham/sa cad la grogs kho nar gnas/ i tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ya sha rnams ni rlung khams te/ chu yi dgra me'i grogs/ sa la nus med do/ /ṛ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ra ṣa rnam/sa me ste sa khams kyi dgra/ chu la nus med rlud gi grogs po'i tsho/ /u pa pha ba bha ma/ wa pi rnams chu ste me'i dgra dang / rlung la nus med dang / sa'i grogs po/kla ta tha da dha na/ la sa rnams sa khams te rlung gi dgra dang / sa'i grogs dang /me la nus med do// des na skabs 'dir sa sde ye shes kyi khams zhes logs —447—

par mi byed par lnga po'i nang du phar bsdus so/ /'byung chung gi rim pa ni/gzhan la mi brtsi ste/ sde pa lnga po nyid la bya na/ nga nya ṇa ma na rnams stong pa'i khams/ gha dzha lha bha dha rnams rlung khams/ ga dza ḍa ba da rnams me khams/ kha tsha ṭha pha tha rnams chu khams/ ka tsa ṭa pa ta rnams sa khams so/ /de rnams kyi yang dgra grogs brtsi tshul gong dang 'dra/ /sdom ni/ chu dgra rlung yin rlung dgra sa/ sa dgra me yin me dgra chu/ /sa chu phan tshun grogs po dang / /me rlung phan tshun grogs po dang / /rlud la chu dang me la sa/ /chu la me dang sa la rlud / /snga mar phyi ma nus med de/ stong pa kun gyi phan tshun grogs/ /zhes so/ /re mig 'god par 'dod na/ phyogs bzhi g.yas skor tshul la ni/ chu me sa rlung rim bzhin bkod/ /brang sprod zung dag grogs yin te/ g.yas skor tha mal g.yon skor dgra/zhes pa ste/ de dag thams cad la rigs mtshungs pa rnams ni rtag tu grogs yin la/ o yig la sogs pa mgo 'dren pa'i sngags yig rnams yar phung pa'i 'dod lha'i sngags kyi yi ge dang po de rnams dang / sgrub pa po'i ming yig dang po de dgra grogs brtsi dgos na/ dgra byed po dang / grogs byed po dang / nus med byed pa po ni sngags yin la/ gang la bya ba'i yul sgrub po'i ming yin pa go bar bya ste/ dper na/ sgrub po'i ming rab 'byor zhes pa lta bu yi ge dang po ra yig me khams yin pa la/ oṃ mā ma gī zhes chu khams byung na/ gsal byed kyi dgra yin pas sngags kyis sgrub pa po la nad kyis gdung bar byed la/ sgrub po'i ming yig dang po ra yig la sngags kyi dang po lo tsa na lta bu la yig sa khams yod na/ tha mal pa ste nus med yin pa dang / sgrub po'i ming ra yig la sngags kyi dang po ya —448—

manta ka zhes pa lta bu ya yig rlung khams yod pa grogs yin pas bde ba dam pa thob par byed cing / dbyangs kyi yi ge'i sngags rnams dgrar gyur na/ sgrub po 'chi ba dang / grogs su gyur na yun ring du 'tsho ba dang dngos grub chen po rnams myur du thob pa'o/ /gsal byed dgrar gyur pas nang du byed cing / grogs su gyur na 'byor pa rnyed pa dang / dngos grub chung ba rnams rnyed do/ /rgyud gzhung 'di rnams su gsal kha med kyang man ngag gzhan rnams las 'byung chen 'byung chung gnyis 'byung chung stobs che bar 'dod do/ /legs sbyar sogs rgya skad la ming gi yi ge dang po de la yi ge gnyis brtsegs yod na steng ma la brtsi ba yin yang / bod yul 'dir grags pa'i sngon 'jug dang mgo can sogs ni gzugs 'bri ba'i tshe thog ma dang mgo bor yod kyang don so sor go byed kyi brda tsam ma gtogs/ yi ge'i brjod pa sgyur nus ma yin pas/ yi ge dngos gzhi la brtsi mi dgos te dper na skal bzang zhes pa'i sa mgo de/ rgya skad kyi yi ge brtsegs ma dang mi 'dra ste/ bsod nams can du go ba'i ched kyi brda tsam yin gyi brjod pa'i yi ge ma yin pa'i phyir/ ka nyid la brtsi dgos pa dang / dkar mo zhes pa lta bu la 'phul byed da yod pa'ang / kha dog go byed kyi brda tsam yin pas nga yig gi gzugs dang por bris kyang brjod pa'i yi ge ma yin pa'i phyir ka nyid nas brtsi ba yin la/ yang dga' byed dang / rdza mkhan dang sbas pa dang / brda ga|ji ba la sogs pa ni/ gha dzha bha dha'i dod yin te sgra gcig pa'i phyir dang / sgra lta bu ni ghra zhes pa'i dod yin zhing / sa mgo ni snyan cha go ba'i phyir tsam ste/ brtsegs ma'i dang po gha rang nyid yin gyi sa ma yin pa dang / rgya skad kyi yi ge dzña la zur chag —449—

pa'i tshul gyis rgya gar gyi yul phal che ba na/ rgya zhes 'bod pa dang / 'ga' zhig tu smya zhes 'bod pa yang snang ba/ yi ge'i ngo bo mi gcig kyang sgra phyogs mtshungs pa'i 'dra chos yod pas/ bod kyi yi ge mkhan pos rga la ya btags kyi rnam gzhag sogs byas nas/ dzña zur chags dang brjod pa gcig par byung bas/rgyal po zhes pa lta bu'i yi ge dang po rgya skad kyi dzña yig gi rigs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ca cha ja rnams tsa tsha dza nyid yin la/ dpyod ldan dang spyod pa zhes pa lta bu bod yig gi gzugs la ba 'phul bzhag can dang sa mgo can yin yang rgya yig gi lus 'gyur dang 'dra ste/ yig gzugs yi ge ma yin la/ brjod pa nyid yi ger 'jog dgos pas/ de dag kyang tsa yig gi khongs su bsdu'o/ /de rnams kyis gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ zha ni sha dang mtshungs par grags pa bzhin dang / za ni sa dang mtshungs par grags shing / sgra mtshungs pas na dza dang yang 'dra bar mngon la/ 'a ni a yig dang mtshungs par bya ste/ sngon gyi bod yig byed pos ring po la 'a 'dogs byed pa'i rgyu mawo yang de yin no/ /de bzhin du mkha' ni kha/ mnga' ni nga / 'tsha ni tsha/ mtha ni tha/ 'pha ni pha/ dma' ni ma/ lha ni la/ bsha ni sha/ bsa' ni sa dang mtshungs pa ste/ de dag gis rigs 'gre ste ma bshad pa rnams kyang dpag par nus so/ /des na yi ge'i dgra grogs 'di dag rgya skad kyi steng du brtsi tshul yin pas/ bod skad du ngo bo mi 'dra ba rnams la dod brtsi ba gal che zhing / yi ge yang gzugs la mi brtsi yi brjod pa'i sgo nas brtsi dgos so/ /'o na 'di dag sngags bzlas pa thams cad la brtsi dgos sam snyam na/ sems can bsam pa'i bye brag gis sngags byed pa pos gang byin gyis —450—

———bsnye—ga—rdze——geb ————snye she——brlabs pa de kho na 'a nus pa de 'byung ba yin pas/ rgyud 'di dang de'i rjes su 'brang ba rlams la nges par gal che zhing / bla med kyi rgyud sde gzhan/ rnams la 'di ltar brtsi ba legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba ni yod kyi nges par dgos pa ni min la/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams su 'di dag mi dgos pa shas che'o/ /rgyu mtshan yang rgyud 'dir ni/ 'byung ba'i khams kyi rim pa nyid 'khor 'das brtan g.yo kun gyi sre/ga tu bzhag pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la/ bla med gzhan/ rnams las khams lnga srog tu bzhag pa cung zad yod kyang / rgyud 'di lta bur rtsal du bton pa med pa'i phyir dang / 'og ma rnams su de 'dra'i dag sbyor re zhig dngos su gsungs pa med cing mi sbyor ba'i phyir ro/ /phyi rol kyi sngags rgyud la yang rigs can dang mkha' lding gi rgyud la yi ge'i khams kyi dgra grogs brtsi zhing / ri khrod pa dang / 'byung po dang 'chol ba'i rgyu la brtsi mi dgos pa dang 'dra'o zhes bla ma paṇḍi ta 'ga' zhig gsung ngo / /gong du drangs pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi lung las/ sgrub pa po yi yi ge gnyis/ /skye ba las skyes ming skyes 'gyu/ra/ /zhes pa'i don sgrub pa po'i yi ge ni rnam pa gnyis te/ skye ba'i yi ge dang ming gi yi ge 'a/ phyi ma bshad zin pa dang / skye ba'i yi ge ni dang po btsas pa'i dus su zhag de la yi ge gang shar ba dang / yud tsam sum cu'i yi ge gang la btsas pa dang / dbyug gu so so'i yi ge gang la btsas pa dag brtsis te/ de dang sngags kyi yi ge'i dgra grogs brtsi dgos pa yin te/ 'di'i rgyas bshad rang gi yi ge la yang gnyis zhes sogs rdo rje snying 'grel gyi lung drangs pa de yin no/ /spyir nas ming las kyang 'di gal che ba 'dra ba zhig 'dug kyang / bod yul 'dir de rtogs par dka' —451—

——————rde————— bas skye ba'i yi ge gang yin ma shes pa skyon yin yang / de 'a brten pa'i rnam rtog mi 'jug pa yon tan du snang bas yul lugs dang bstun par byos shiga'adir yi ge mangs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ma spros so// //lnga pa las dang mthun pa'i bgrang 'phreng gi dbye ba ni mdo tsam du bshad na/ zhi ba la shel gyi bgrang 'phreng ste/ dbyangs thung ngu bco lnga la a a ha bsnan pa dbyangs bco brgyad kyi grangs so/ /rgyas pa la mu tig gi bgrang 'phreng sde dbyangs thung ngu bco brgyad dang / ring po bco brgyad de sum cu rtsa drug bi grangs kyis so/ /dbang la bo te tse'i bgrang 'phreng ste gsal byed sum cu rtsa drug gi grangs kyis so/ /dgug pa la tsan dan nam padma'i sa bon gyi bgrang 'phreng ste gsal byed thung ngu sum cu rtsa drug dang/ dbyangs bco brgyad 'dus pa lnga bcu rtsa bzhi'i grangs kyis so/ /bsad pa la mi'i so'i bgrang 'phreng sde rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi grangs kyis so/ /sdang ba dang bskrad pa la rnga mo'am bong bu'i so'i bgrang 'phreng ste rgyu skar nyis 'gyur lnga bcu rtsa bzhi grangs kyis so/ /rmongs pa la lung tang gi bgrang 'phreng ste/ ril bu phyed bcas bcu gsum rgyu skar phyed kyi grangs kyis so/ /rengs pa la ru rag sha'i bgrang 'phreng ste thung ngu dang ring po'i gsal byed bdun bcu rtsa gnyis dang dbyangs sum cu rtsa drug bsres pa brgya dang brgyad kyi grangs kyis so/ /slar gso ba la ni/ ma ra ka ta'i bgrang 'phreng gis so/ /las thams cad pa la dbang le'i spyin sreg gi skabs su gsungs pa ltar mtshan so gnyis dang / dpe byad brgyad cu bsres pa'i grangs spyir brgya dang bcu gnyis yin pa las bzhi ni rdo rje bzhi dang ri rab kyi gdong bzhi mtshon pa mdo —452—

'dzin gyi don du sbyar bas 'phreng ba dngos la ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad pa ste/ rgyu ni zhi rgyas sam lha dbang du byed pa yin pa'i phyir bo te tse'am/ gzhan yang dge zhing shis pa'i rgyu gang yang rung ba ste/ bsnyen pa'i dus kyang las thams cad pa dang 'dra'o/ /bgrang 'phreng byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ gdan bzhi dang sa myu zhi'am dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs las 'byung ba bzhin byas kyang legs la/ yang na man ngag las 'byung ba hū rlu las gtso bo yab yum gyi ngo bo bgrang 'phreng nyid du bskyed/ bgrang 'phreng la ye shes pa bstim nas/ rigs drug gi sa bon brgya rtsas byin gyis brlabs na'ang legs pa yin no/ /zhes pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim rnam par bshad pa las/ sngags kyi bzlas pa'i rim pa bshad pa'i sde tshan te dgu pa'o// //gsum pa la mchod pa gtor ma zas kyi rnal 'byor gsum ni/ sgrub thabs le'ur/ oṃ ā hū ho rim par gnas pas dang por 'dir ni rtag tu chang ni sbyangs nas rgyas par bya/ rab tu 'bar bar byas te ring bong can ni zhu ba bzhin du rim pas bsgoms par byas nas ni/ /snod de nas ni thig le dag gis lag par ri bong can gyi ming med rtse mos sa gzhi la/ phyi rol tu ni zur gsum byas nas de yi dbus su nyin mor byed pa dang mtshungs zlum po'o/ de yi dbus su ye shes 'khor lo srid gsum gnas pa dag kyang 'dir ni sngags pas bsgoms byas nas/ /mthe bong dang ni ming med dag gis nyin zhag so so'i dus su tshim par byed pa la sogs bya/ /yul dang grong gi bdag po rnams la thog —453—

mar 'dir ni gtor ma dang po dbus mtha'i ming gis te/ / 'phrog rma/ la ni chang bu gnyis dang slar yang sngags pas khro bo'i rgyal po la ni gtor ma'o/ /pho nya mo rnams dag la zas kyi phud ni sa steng gnas su bdag po'i rdo rje rnams kyis sbyin/ /'gyung po rnams la zos pa'i lha ma slar yang dge ba'i don du spyin pa'i tshigs bcad 'dir bklag go /zhes gsungs shing / gshegs su gsol ba yang sgrub ler/ gtsug tor du ni rdo rje rtse mo lnga par 'gyur te phyi rol rtse mo dag ni nyis 'gyur gyi/ /rdo rje chos kyi 'khor lo 'gyur zhing nyis 'gyur gzhan ma dang ni de yi nyis 'gyur dag kyang gzhan/ /de yi yang ni nyis 'gyur gzhan du 'gyur te lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i 'khor lor ro/ /de yi snying por rtse mo gcig pa bde mnyam 'bras ster gsang ba'i padma'i khongs su gnas pa'o /zhes gsungs shing / yang maṇḍal dang 'brel ba'i mchod chog ni/ dbang le'i tshigs bcad gya bzhi pa'i 'grel bar gsal bar gsungs pas/ de rnams kyi khog don sdeb na/ 'grel chen las/ de ltar gshegs su gsol ba byas te/de nas thun mtshams gsum la sngar gsungs pa'i cho gas gtor ma spyin par bya'o/ /sngar gyi cho gas bdud rtsi lnga sbyang ba byas nas/ des bdag nyid tshim par bya'o/ /zhes bdag bskyed kyi lha tshogs rang nyid la bsdu ba'i gshegs gsol byas zin pa'i rjes su gtor ma 'bul ba dang / gtor ma'i rjes su kha zas kyi rnal 'byor bya bar shin tu gsal la/ de'i phyir spyi ldog nas bdag bskyed la gtor ma tsam mi 'gog kyang skabs 'dir gtor chog ni bdag bskyed kyi lha la ma yin te/ spyir mdun bskyed dang / khyad par du yang khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje —454—

shugs sde drug dang bcas pa la 'bul ba dang / gzhan mkha' 'gro ma dang yul bdag grong bdag sogs la spyin pa nyid yin zhing / kha zas kyi bya ba'ang thun mtshams de nyid la byed rgyu yin na gtor ma'i rjes su bya yi/ sngon du ma yin te zas kyi phud nyid la gtor ma bya ba'am/ ma yin kyang zas kyi phud nas gtor ma la 'bul dgos pa'i dbang du byas so/ /maṇḍal mchod pa'i cho ga ni/ dbang le'i gya bzhi pa'i 'grel pa las 'di skad ces/ 'dir sngar brjod pa'i cho gas lha rnams dmigs pa byas te/ de nas ye shes kyi 'khor lo dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang lhan cig tu byas nas/ sngar gyi sngags kyi tshig rnams kyis mchod yon la sogs pa 'bul lo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i sngar brjod pa'i cho gas lha la dmigs par byas te/ zhes pa'i lha la dmigs pa sngar gsungs pa la kha 'phangs pa'i gnas skabs ni gnyis yod de/ dbang le'i mdor bsdus gnyis par 'di skad ces/ stong pa nyid la dmigs pa dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog dang / thig le'i rnal 'byor dang / phra mo'i rnal 'byor rnams sngags pas bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de la bsnyegs pa na bdag bskyed kyi mthar dkyil 'khor ma bsdus pa nyid la maṇḍal du dam ye bsres nas mchod pa bya bar gsungs par song bas/ bdag bskyed kyi lha la mchod pa 'bul ba bstan la/yang mdor bsdus gsum par mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas par gsungs zin pa las kha 'phangs pa'ang yin pas sngar ji ltar bshad pa'i lha tshogs de lta bur bsgom zhes par 'gyur la/ dngos bstan yang mdun bskyed kyi 'jug nyid na yod pa gnyis ka la yang 'jug mod kyi/ cho gas lha rnams la dmigs zhes —455—

pa'i tshig ni mdun bskyed kyi bskyed chog las kyang bdag bskyed rnal 'byor bzhi la gtso bor 'jug go /des na bdag bskyed kyi lha maṇḍal du mchod pa yang nges par grub la/ mchod chog dang gtor chog gnyis dkyus thog gcig la byed na spyir yang gtor chog 'jug tu byed pa phal cher la grags la/ khyad par 'dir mchod chog ni/ bdag bskyed ma bsdus pa la byed dgos shing / gtor chog ni bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i rjes su byed pas sngar gyi lung gis grub pas/ bdag bskyed maṇḍal mchod pa ni sngon du bya dgos shing / de la phyi mchod nang mchod gnyis yod pa las sngon du phyi mchod byed pa rgyud sde spyi'i lag len gyi rig pas grub/ de gnyis la dkyil 'khor so so mi dgos par gcig gi steng nas bsgrubs kyang rung mod/ dbang ler maṇḍal mchod pa dngos la tsandan la sogs pa'i maṇḍal gsungs pa phyi mchod dang / sgrub ler nang mchod byin gyis brlabs nas bdud rtsi'i maṇḍal byed par gsungs pa nang gi mchod pa'i maṇḍal yin par shin tu gsal bas 'grub na so sor bya'o/ /mchod sngags chen mo ni/ deng sang nang mchod la sbyor ba'i lag len kho na yod kyang me tog la sogs pa dang / mchod pa bcu'am bcu gsum dang phyi nang gsang ba thams cad kyi spyi sngags yin no/ /maṇḍal mchod pa mdun bskyed du byed pa'i rigs la/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang 'brel na dkyil 'khor mchod pa dngos gzhi nyid kyi skabs las gzhan du ma yin la/ logs su byed na phal cher bdag bskyed bsdus pa'i mthar byed pa dang / mchod chog tsam la bdag bskyed sngon du ma song yang thun mtshams kyi lha la brten nas kyang byar rung mod kyi/—456—

gal te gtor chog dang sbrel nas byed na mdun bskyed la mchod chog song ba'i rjes su gtor chog bya'o/ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ spyir nges pa med kyang de'i rjes su dpa' bo'i ston mo bsdus pa'i tshul gyis byed pa yin pa las/ 'khor lo'i mchod chog dngos la zas kyi bya ba zin/ lhag gtor btang ba'i 'og tu maṇḍal dang / gtor ma'i lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba yin yang / dkyus kyi rnal 'byor la ni de ltar byas kyang rung / maṇḍal gyi'am de dang gtor ma'i lha lhan gcig tu gshegs su gsol zin pa'i rjes su kha zas kyi rnal 'byor byas kyang rung ngo / /yang dkyil 'khore rgyas pa dang ma 'brel na mchod pa 'bul ba'i yul gtor ma'i mgron cung zad mi 'dra bas/ maṇḍal mchod pa'i lha gshegs su gsol ba'i rjes su gtor chog bya/ de gshegs su gsol nas zas kyi rnal 'byor byas pas kyang chog go /de ltar spyi khog nges par byas nas/ skabs 'dir thun mtshams kyi bya ba la dbye na/ mchod bstod gyi rnal 'byor/ nyer bsdu'i rim pa/ gtor ma'i cho ga kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor te lnga las/ dang po la mchod pa bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis so/ /dang po bsdus pa ni/sgrub thabs ljon shing la 'jug pa las/ dkyus su bstan pa'i mchod pa bcu gnyis dang / 'dud nyi shu dang / ye shes lnga'i bstod pas bstod pa tsam bya ba ste/dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod skabs kyi bdag bskyed kyi 'jug tu 'di kho na 'jug cing / rgyun gyi nyams len la ni/ mchod chog rgyas pa gang 'grub bya zhing / mi shes pa dang / mi nus pa dang / long skabs med na 'di tsam gyis kyang go ni chod —457—

la/ kha cig sdeb gcig la bsdus rgyas gnyis kar byed pa ni/ spros pa kho na lhur blangs pa las gzhan ma yin no/ /bzlas pa'i 'jug tu maṇḍal dang 'brel ba'i cho ga rgyas pa 'di byed phyin/ mchod bstod bsdus pa 'di mi dgos mod/ gzhan dag phal cher gyis phyi rol rdul tshon sogs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing bsgrubs pa la mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs/ maṇḍal du dam tshig pa bskyed pa la rdul tshon dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshur spyan 'dren pa'am/ maṇḍal du dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan dam tshig pa rjes mthun pa la/ mgron gyi lha ye shes pa rjes mthun pa byas te bkug nas/ de nyid la mchod pa 'bul bar gsungs pa de dngos bstan dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa yin zhing /de tsam go yang bla ma'i man ngag gi dkyus kyi nyams len la/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor maṇḍal la gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshul can dam tshig pa rjes mdun pa dang / mgron gyi lha ye shes pa rjes mthun pa yang spyan drangs te mchod pa'i lag len gyi rgyun nyams pas rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa de ltar yin pa ma shes par/ maṇḍal mchod phyin phyi rol mchod pa kho nar bsams shing / de'i tshe bdag bskyed la mchod bstod bsdus pa de ma byas na/ maṇḍal mchod pa byed ring bdag bskyed gug par las kyi dogs pa der snang la/ maṇḍal gyi lha dang bdag bskyed kyi lha tha dad par bzung bas gshegs gsol gyi skabs maṇḍal gyi lha badzra mu yis zangs kyis gshegs nas/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu bar 'dod la/ yang na bdag bskyed kyi lha dang mnyam por rigs mthun rigs mthun sdebs nas maṇḍal gyi lha bsdus kyang chog ces gdam ka'i sgo nas sbubs —458—

yangs 'phrul chags yin par rlom mo/ /gal te maṇḍal mchod pa 'di phyi rol mchod pa'am mdun bskyed kho na yi myo na/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor ma bsdus kyang gnad 'chug pa'i nor ba min mod 'on kyang de'i sngon du bsdu ba nyid bzang ste/ bdag mdun nges par rnga/sre dgos pa'i rigs can yin na ma gtogs/ gsang sngags spyi'i cho ga'i lu gas rgyas bsdus che chung phal cher la de lta bur snang ba dang rig pa mtshungs pas so/ /bdag mdun gnyis tshogs khang gnyis su tshogs pa so sor 'tshogs pa lta bu dang / khyim gcig gi cha shas kyi nang du khyim gcig shos bkod pa lta bu byed pa'i rnam gzhag ni tshad ldan yongs su grags pa gang la'ang mi snang ba'i phyir dang / mdun bskyed mchod pa tsam la bdag bskyed kyi 'khor rnams bya ra byed pa tsam la dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na bdag bskyed bsdu ba maṇḍal mchod pa'i rjes su byed/ pa'i phyir bdag bskyed nyid mchod pa yin te/ gzhan du na bdag bskyed kyi cho ga'i bar der bdag nyid kyi dkyil 'khor ma/ bsdus bzhin du de'i dmigs pa btang nas mdun bskyed kyi lha la yun ring du dmigs shing / bya byed mang pos dus ring du 'da' ba 'os pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa ni/ maṇḍal 'dus bya ba/ phyi mchod byin gyis brlab pa/ dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa/ mgron spyan drangs pa/phyi mchod rgyas par 'bul pa/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba/bstod pa/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa rnams cho ga'i rim pa yin la/ maṇḍal 'dus bya tshul ni/ maṇḍal gnyis las gcig mchod pa byin rlabs kyi rjes su/—459—

—tsan dan gyi lde gu sogs 'theb srin gyi blang ste legs par byugs/ me tog gi tshom bu ci rigs pa bkram nas/ gzugs brnyan lta bu'i lha gsal 'debs pa sogs byed cing / maṇḍal gcig shos zhi// phyi mchod dang bstod pa'i bar du maṇḍal la nang mchod kyi chos 'byung gru spru/sum dbus su thig le zlum po dang bcas pa bkod nas dbus su me rta ge cig bzhag maṇḍal snga ma'i lha dang dbyer med du mos nas/ nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan gnas skabs so sor gsungs pa de nyid ma nor tsho bar bsgrigs pa'i lugs phan tshun rgyas bkab kyi bsre slad med pa de yin la/ 'on kyang zla ba re'i nang du lan re sogs khyad par gyi dus skabs gal che ba la ni nges par bya zhing / rgyun gyi nyams len la 'grub dka' na/ maṇḍal phyi nang gang rung zhig la bsdus pas rung mod/ khyad par du phyi nang gis maṇḍal gnyis po nang gtso che bas nang mchod kyi chos 'byung thig le dang bcas pa de bkod pa gcig pus chog go /de yang skabs 'dir gsar du nang mchod byin rlabs byed pa'i lag len 'dug kyang de gtso mi che ste/ thun gyi mgor byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod des bya'o/ /de ltar na dang por nang gi maṇḍal 'dus byas te stegs cung zad la bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mdun du mchod pa bsham/ mchode pa bcu bcu gnyis bcu gsum sogs ri mor bris pa'am/ 'bur du dod pa sogs yod na shin tu legs/ med na yid kyis bsgoms pas chog /dung chos sogs snod gtsang ma gcig gam bzhir yon chab blug de rjes dung chos sogs snod gcig tu bsang chu 'thor yab ku sha'am dur ba dang bcas pa bzhag nas/ yi ge drug pa lan brgya sogs ji —460—

ltar 'os pa bzlas pas bsang chu sgrub mchod gtor thams cad la des bsang ba yin/ gal te bsang chu mi byed na/ nang mchod kyis bsangs kyang chog go /gnyis pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ sgrub mchod kyi skabs dang 'dra/bsang ba'i sngags yi ge drug pas bya zhes gsungs pa la/ kha cig oṃ ā hū ho : ha kṣa la bzhed pa dang / 'ga' zhig hā lha sogs la 'dod pa'ang yod pa/ de dag rang gi 'dod pa tsam ma yin par man ngag las byung ba yin na spyir bzang mod kyang / 'grel pa las/ bsang byed kyi sngags dngos su gsungs pa sngags gcig las med cing / de ni spyin sreg gi skabs su/ o ā hū hra phaṭa ces pa 'di gcig pu'o/ /de'i phyir bsangs sbyangs tsam gyi don du/ spyin sreg kho na la khyad chos 'ong ba mi rigs shing / gnas skabs gzhan du gzhan yang gsungs pa med pas dngos su gsungs pa gcig pu de bor nas/ ma gsungs pa la rig pa'i sgrub byed mang po bkod kyang / g.yem ma mu cor gyis rgyal lo/ /zhes par 'gyur bas/ des na 'di ni rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan yin la/ brgyud pa'i rim pa ma chad pa'i bla ma dam pa'i man ngag las kyang byung ngo / /'o na yi ge lnga las med pa ci zhe na/ pha dang ṭa so sor 'byed pa yin te/ 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtogs pa bdun pa las kyang / mkhas pas gnyis su bya zhes phaṭa kyi pha dang ṭa so sor bgrang bar gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'o na ra btags dang klad skor la sogs pa yang bgrong dgos par 'gyur ro snyam na/ de dag sgra 'dres pa yin pas so sor mi bgrong la/ pha dang ṭa sgra mi 'dre ba'i phyir/ yi ge so sor bgrong pa rigs pa nyid do/ /mchod pa'i snod shel las grub pa ni/ zhi ba'i —461—

skabs su gsungs la/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen sgrub dang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni/ zhi ba'i las sgrub dngos min yang zhi ba dang 'dra ba byed pa spyi lugs yin no/ /gsum pa mchod yul gyi lha dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa ni/ maṇḍal la bsangs sbyangs byas te/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhi yongs su dag pa der bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus pa gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bu'i tshul du skad cig gis grub par bsam/ 'di yid kyis bsams pa kho nas chog mod/spros pa la mos na gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po tsam dang / 'khor rnams kyi sa bon tsam brjod/ 'di bdag bskyed kyi lha rnams dngos su byon pa lta bu min/bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa sngags dang phyag rgyas der spyan 'dren pa lta bu yang min/ der dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan shar ba'i tshul las lha dngos su bzhengs par sgom pa yin no/ /bzhi pa mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ badzra sa mā dza dza hu ba ho zhes brjod pas bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad nye bar byon te/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsam /bzhi pa phyi mchod 'bul ba la/ dang por mchod yon ni/ sbyin sreg gi skabs su mchod yon gyi sngags/ oṃ pra wa ra sa tpa ra ma hā ra smi pra tī tstsha swāhā/zhes kyang gsungs mod kyi/ ma hā ra smi zhes pa 'od zer chen po ste me lha'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pas 'di dngos su sbyin sreg gi sgos chos yin yang lha'i mtshan gyi gnas spos na gzhan la'ang rung bar ni mngon no/ /'on kyang skabs —462—

gzhan du gsal bar gsungs pa yin pas/ oṃ ā hū ho tri dha tu ke shwa ra sogs mdzad pa nyid bzang ngo / /chu gzhan bshams yod na/ o shrī kā la tsakra sa pa ri wa re sdu pu du pra tī tstsha na ma sogs kyis phul/ 'grel chen las/ na ma mchod pa rgyas par gsungs pa'i tshig gi rjes su/ rin chen ind+ra ni la la sogs pa rnams dang / gser gyi me tog dang zhes sogs mchod pa bcu gsum gsungs pa dang / gzhan pa rnam bcu zhes pa ni 'chad par 'gyur pa las brjod par bya'o zhes kha 'phangs pa ni/ dbang le'i tshigs bcad brgya lnga bcu nga lnga pa'i 'grel bar/ chu'i snod dang mchod yon gyi snod dang / zhes sogs mchod pa rnam pa bcu gsungs pas/ de dag gang yang rung ba zhig phul bas ceb la/ da lta lag len du mchod pa bcu gnyis 'bul bar mdzad/ khams gsum dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang 'brel ba'i mchod pa la/tshig ge brjod pa mang po dag mdzes pa'i skabs yod yang / rgyun gyi nyams len la tshig ha cang spros pa ches pa'ang mi legs pas dmigs pa rgya bskyed la ngag gi brjod pa ran tsam de bzang ngo / /drug pa nang mchod 'bul ba la/ nang mchod gsar pa zhig logs su bshams yod na legs/ med na sngar gyi de kha gsol la/ byin rlabs rgyas par byas nas dang por rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing 'bul/ de bshad tshod med kyang gsang sngags pa spyi'i phyag len du 'dug pa byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo khyad par can du snang ngo / /de nas oṃ buddhā ya na ma sogs mchod —463—

sngags chen mos mchod cing / go skabs bde na mtheb srin gyis maṇḍal nyid du 'bul la/ mi bde na rang gi dpral ba'i thad tsam nas 'bul/ thugs dkyil kho na sgom pa yin na/ oṃ ṣaṭa aṅgā ya na ma zhes pa'i rjes su oṃ gu ru bsnyi sbyar bas chog des mtshon te lha nyer lnga bcu gsum lha dgu lha lnga sogs la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /'ga' zhig na ma mchod pa'i skabs 'dir mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba na/ bzed zhal gyi nang du maṇḍal spyan drangs te bdud rtsi dang / me tog dang /zas mchog sogs dngos su 'bul ba'i lag len yang snang ba/ rang lugs la gtso bor mi mdzad na'ang / spyi rgya bal mkhas pa'i lag len gyi rgyun yin pas/de yang skabs 'gar byas na legs mod kyi/ rgyun gyi nyams len bdag bskyed kyi skabs 'dir mi dgos so/ /mchod yon nas 'di'i bar du dngos su mkha gyi lha gzugs brnyan lta bu de la 'debs pa'i mos pa byed kyang / bdag bskyed nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du mchod pa dpag tu med pa byung zhing lha rnams tshim par bsam mo/ /na ma 'i sngags kyi skabs 'dir nang mchod kho nar ma zad/ mchod pa gzhan thams cad la yang dmigs nas 'bul ba yin te/ lcogs shing 'grub la spros pa la dga' na/ dngos su lha so so'i gnas su me tog 'dor zhing /mchod sngags chen mo tshar gcig brjod/ de bzhin du dri dang spos dang mar me sogs thams cad la sbyor ba yin yang de tsam mi nus pas rdzas kyi mchod pa nges can rnams sngon la mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis spyi bungs su phul nas/ rdzas nges can gyi mchod pa'i rting ma nang mchod yin pas de lha so so'i sngags kyis —464—

'bul ba'i zhor la mchod pa snga ma rnams kyi lha so so la dmigs pa yin no/ /de la rdzas nges pa can ni/ rgyud 'grel nyid las dngos bstan du gsungs ba'i mchod pa bcu dang bcu gnyis bcu gsum sogs phyi nang gi dag sbyor can rnams yin la/ gzhan ma nges pa rnams la ni/ lha so so'i sngags kyis 'bul ba mi dgos so// //bdun pa bstod pa ni/ spyir nges pa med kyang mtshan brjod kyi 'dud nye shu dang / gang la thog mtha' dbus med sogs ye shes lnga'i bstod pa tsam mdzad pa phyag len yin zhing / rkang pa bcu drug pa la sogs pas bstod kyang legs so// //brgyad pa 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni/ spyir bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gang yin yang 'dod don zhu ba'i yul gyi gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' yin la/ dam ye dbyer med nyid kyi phyir dam tshig sems dpa' la yang zhor byung du yin te/ dam tshig pa nus pa rgyas pa dang / ye shes pa mnyes pa'i phyir bzlas pa dang / mchod bstod dang / gsol ba 'debs pa rnams dgos pa yin no/ ne/de nas skabs 'dir yig brgya bzod gsol sogs kha bskang kyang rung ma byas kyang rung ste/ mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gzugs brnyan lta bu'i dkyil 'khor de/ dper na chu pho ba na zla gzugs mi snang ba lta bu'am/ yang na rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid la thim par bsgoms kyang rung ngo / /de ltar don tshan brgyad kyis maṇḍal mchod chog bshad zin to/ //gnyis pa nyer bsdu'i rim pa ni/ gtsug tor du rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa'i lte —465—

bar sogs te/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lha rnams gnas gzhan du gshegs dgos pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir dpag bsam gyi shing sogs rdo rje bzhi po nyid spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab bzhi la thim pa ni nges par yin zhing / bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo zhes pa las 'khor lo pa zhes sam/ 'kho‘ra lo'i lha zhes pa'i gas la kha med pas bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas kyi gzhal med khang nyid kyang gshegs su gsol ba yin te/ gyi jo'i 'gyur las/ gtsug tor du rtse lnga pa'i rdo rje bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol lo//zhes 'byung ba go bde'o/ /phung po bzhi dang khams bzhi'i lha ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum bzhi bzhi ste brgyad/ smos kyang phan tshun yab yum (se khyud pa'i dbye bas bcu drug yod pa/ da/pral ba'i rtsa 'dab kyi grangs dang mnyam/ pa yin pa dang / skye mched bcu gnyis ni sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis/ khro bo bzhi ni thugs kyi sgo srung ste bcu drug po la lus bsam mtshon byed phan tshun 'byud pa'i yab yum gyi dbye bas sum cu so gnyis mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab dang grangs mtshungs pa yin no/ /thugs dkyil rkyang pa las/ ma bsgoms na de tsam gyis chog pa yin la/sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs la gzhan rnams kyang bsdu dgos pas lte bar rdo rje rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa dang / rnal 'byor ma re bzhi grangs mtshungs kyang padma'i lte ba'i lha la gsal kha ma byung ste des na gtso mo brgyad po rang rang gi 'khor la spyi khyab tu gnas pa'i dbang du bya/ gsang ba'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis yin la/ sku'i sgo skyong ni kha sbyor gyi lha ltar na drug yab yum so sor bgrangs kyang bcu gnyis las med pa la/ skabs 'dir dgos pa'i dbang gis dag pa las sum cu rtsa —466—

gnyis kyi dbye ba byed de/ de yang sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi skabs 'dir las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa'i dag pa sku'i sgo skyong rnams la 'jog pa'i skabs shig byung ngo / /de'i dbang du byas nas yab rnams las dbang dang / yum rnams bya ba yin pas sbyangs bya tha dad pa nyid kyi phyir yab gtso bor byed pa dang yum gtso bor byed pa gnyis ka byung zhing / des na yab drug la yum drug gis 'phyud pa'i lha bcu gnyis/ de go zlog pa'i lha bcu gnyis/ de dag ni skyes pa dang bud med kyi yul la las mtha' dag sgrub par mdzad pa yin la/ thun mong du las dbang dang bya ba'i gzhi yul rnam par dag pa'i shing rta drug ste sum cu rtsa gnyis po gsang ba'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis dang grangs mthun pa'o/ /las kyi 'khor lo tshigs chen bcu gnyis por tshes lha rnams thim par byed pa la nag pa dang sa ga'i lha gnyis gru mo gnyis dang / snron dang chu stod 'khrig ma gnyis dang /gro bzhin khrums stod dpyi gnyis dang / tha skar smin drug pus mo gnyis dang /mgo rgyal bol gong gnyis dang / mchu dang dbo rnams dpung pa gnyis la ste/sngar bshad pa rnams kyi rig pas shes so/ /rkang lag gi sor mo'i tshigs drug cu la klu dang rab gtum ma/ thabs shes kyi dbye bas phan tshun du phye bas dngos su lha bzhi bcu 'byung la/ de rnams kyi gdan nyi shu bsnan pas 'khor lo'i grangs dang mthun pa'i drug cu po rnams thim par byed pa yin no/ /gzhan dag skra dang ba sbu la grub pa 'byung po sogs thim pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad na'ang / de dag bskyed chog gis bskyed pa ma yin pas nges par dgos pa ni ma yin la/gzungs ma rnams dang / 'dod phyir 'dod rnams bskyed chog gis bskyed mod —467—

kyang / zhor byung gi lha yin pa'i phyir rang rang gi bskyed gzhi dang lhan cig tu bsdu ba'am/ so so'i gzhal med khang bsdu ba'i skabs su bsdu'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang bsdu bar gsungs pas mtshon te/ thugs dkyil dang gsung dkyil rang rang gi lha rnams dang lhan cig dang / sku dkyil ni tshes lha rnams dang lhan cig bsdu la/ bsrung 'khor khor yug dang bcas pa sgo skyong klu rab gtum rnams dang lhan cig bsdu'o/ /gtso bo gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor bsdu zhes gzhan mang po dag bzhed kyang / mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin na ni/ dmigs gsal med pa'i bde chen 'khor lo'i lha yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang legs mod kyi bdag bskyed kyi skabs su de ltar 'chad pa ni/ rang nyid yongs rdzogs bsdus na gang du bsdu ba'i gzhi med pa'i phyir/ tshig rkyang par zad la/ 'od gsal gyi rim pas gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor bsdus par 'dod pa yin srid kyang / de ltar bsdus zin pa la gnas so sor slar lha rnams sdud par byed mi thub ste/ bsdu ba'i gzhi med pa'i phyir de ni mi 'thad la/ spyir yang gtso bo bsdu ba lugs 'di la mi dgos par mngon no/ /yang rang lus phal pa rtsa 'khor las byung ba'i rdo rje dang bcas pa bzhag nas/ ye shes kyi lha dus kyi 'khor lo gtsug tor du bstim pa yin zer na yang rang tha mal du 'gyur bas shin tu mi 'thad la/ rang dus 'khor gyi nga rgyal dang rnam pa la gnas na ni/bsdus so bsdus so zhes lan brgya stong du brjod kyang ma bsdus pa kho nar rig par bya'o// gzhan grub pa dang 'byung po sbu la bsdu ba sogs bla ma'i man ngag yin na de bzhin du byas kyang rung mod rtsod pas ci zhig bya// //—468—

——dzin gsum pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ thun mtshams kun tu 'grub na legs la/ gal te ma grub na thig mtha' gang rung ngam/ gnyis ka la bya'o/ /de la gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa/ mgron spyan 'dren pa/ gtor ma 'bul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ /bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro ba ste/ bsang ba'i sngags yi ge drug pas byas kyang legs par 'khyu byer la/ rdzas mtha' dag sbyang ba'i sngags oṃ badzra dhwa ti shwa rī sogs kyis bsang ba'i srol yod pa'ang cung zad rgyas pa'i skabs su shin tu 'brel la/ spyir ni sngags de mchod pa dang / gtor ma dang /bza' ba sogs longs spyod kyi rdzas thams cad sbyong zhing byin gyis rlob pa'i sngags yin pas/ sngags de kho nas kyang gtor ma la sogs pa'i byin rlabs yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang da lta lag len du gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas pa'i skabs/ thog mar gtor rdzas la dmigs nas sngags des dngos po rnams yid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i yul du dmigs/ de nas yi ge drug pas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ 'bud pa dang 'bar ba'i gzhi sa bon las rlung dang mi'i dkyil 'khor bsgom/ rgyal mtshan ni g.yo ba'i byed las dang / 'bar ba dang me lte yang me'i byed las so/ /kha cig yaX raX gnyis me rlung gi ming yig dang por 'dod pa ni tom chol du snang la/ ming yig dang po las dngos po bskyed pa ni ming rkyang tsam du grub pa mtshon byed yin zer ba sogs kyang 'brel med do// snod kyi rten ni/ mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum yin la/ gsum du byed pa ni 'jig rten bya ba dang mthun pa'i phyir dang / rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /mi mgo a las bskyed pa ni/ a ni yig —469—

———'bru kun gyi rtsa ba yin yang / dam rdzas kyis kyang gsung rdo rje mchod nga/sa dam rdzas kyang gzhi a yig de la thug pa'i phyir ro/ /snod ni thod pa ste ka pā la zhes pa'i don bde ba skyong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir bde chen mtshon zhing / dge ba bsags pa mi'i lus kyi rtse mo mchog las byung ba dang / rdo rje khro bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dgyes pa'i snod kyi phyir ro/ /sa bon oṃ las bskyed pa ni/ oṃ ni rab bsngags dge ba dang bkra shis pa'i don te/ de'i nang gi rdzas rnams skyon spangs shing nus pa dge zhing phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par byed pa'i don yin no/ /nang du bdud rtsi lnga'i dam rdzas la a i ṛ u '-i las bskyed pa ni phung po lnga'i dngas ma yin pa'i don dang / rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dam rdzas yin pa'i 'brel bas bzhag go /bdud rtsi'i don ni/ rang gi lus la gnas pa'i lnga po de dngas mar 'gyur na 'chi ba med par 'gyur zhing / sbyangs rtogs spar gsum nus pas byin gyis brlabs te brten na/ phyi rol kyi de dag la yang nus pa rjes mthun pa yod pa dang nang gi de'i rigs su rtogs pas so/ /rgyud gzhan las bdud rtsi lnga po yum lnga'i dam rdzas su byed pa mang yang / rgyud 'dir bdud rtsi lnga sangs rgyas dang / sha lnga yum gyi dam rdzas su gsungs pa/ mang ngo / kha lnga po dbyangs ring po la las bskyed pa ni yum lnga'i dam rdzas dang / srog chags lnga po de dag khams lnga so so'i rang bzhin can yin pa mtshon zhing / sha lnga la sgron me lnga zhes bya ba ni/ dngos grub gsal bar byed pas sgron me zhes thams cad 'chad mod/ tshig de tsam gyis don mi go bas 'di ltar bya ste/ 'jig rten du sha zos pas stobs dang mdangs rgyas par byed do zhes grags pa ltar don la sha'i —470—

dam rdzas kyis lha rnams mnyes par byas pas gang zhig thob pa'am 'thob par 'gyur ba'i dngos grub de yang stobs dang ldan pas gsal ba ste gzi brjid ldan par byed tshul gsang 'dus las gsungs pa lta bu yin la/ don dam par sha lnga'i brdas ma sna ni pa 'byung ba lnga'i dngas ma stobs su gyur pas mi gsal ba sha khrag gi lus dag ste ye shes kyi lus 'od 'bar zhing gsal ba thob pa'i don no/ /de nyid la lcags kyu lnga zhes bya ba ni/ dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i don te/ de ltar na rdzas bcu po de rnams ni spyi khyab kyi mtshon don rags pa phung khams rnams mtshon byed yin la/ gzhan rigs sum cu rtsa drug gi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ dam rdzas kyi khyad par rnam pa mang po de dag yin no/ /rdzas rnams zhu nas gcig tu 'dres pa tsam ni 'og gzhi me rlung gnyis kyi byed pa yin la/ de nas thal mo g.yon pa bstan te/ lag mthil du gnas pa sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ yig dkar po'i 'od zer rdzas la phog pas rdzas ngan pa'i rnam pa sbyangs te/kha dog dang rnam pa phyogs mtshungs pa la dri ro mdog dbyibs ngan pa rnams med pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i rnam par gyur par bsams la sngags dang po brjod do/ /de bzhin du thal mo g.yas bstan zhing / gsung rdo rje ā yig gi 'od zer dmar po phog pas ri bo dang rgya mtsho lta bur rgya cher 'phel bar bsam/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum kar de rnams kyis rigs 'gre ste/ lag pa gnyis thal mo kha sbyor bstan zhing / thugs rdo rje hū gi 'od zer mthing ka phog pas shin tu 'od 'bar zhing / me lce ltar gsal ba reg bya yang ba kha dog dri ro phun sum tshogs par gyur pa'o/ /yang mkha' lding bya khyung gi phyag rgya ste/ lag pa —471—

gnyis bsnol/ mthe chung gnyis 'dud/ mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du gtad/sor mo lhag ma gsum gshibs te brkyang ba/ lag mthil rgyab sprad pa'i 'dzom du ye shes rdo rje hoXyig las 'phros pa'i 'od zer ser po phog pas nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdud rtsi ste/ brtan pa'i dngos po ljon shing sogs la blug na/ bskams pa gsar du skye zhing / rlon pa mi skam pa dang / lcags sogs khams la rag na gser la sogs par 'gyur ba dang /g.yo ba srog can gyis zos 'thungs bsten na/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par byed pa'i mthu can ngo bo don dam chos nyid kyi ye shes yin pa la rnam pa de lta bu'i bdud rtsi'i mtshan nyid can du gyur par mos pa'o/ /nyi zla sgra gcan dus me bsam pa ni/rdo rje bzhi'i gdan gyi dbang du byas pa'ang yin la/ rdo rje'i lus su byed pa'i rgyu yang khams dngas ma bzhi po de dag gis byed pa'i phyir 'dir yang bdud rtsi'i rgyur smos pa'o/ /byin rlabs rgyas bsdus kyi dbye ba sogs dkyus na gsal la gong du'ang spund zin to// //mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ sangs rgyas yab yum zhes sogs so/ /de la sras bcas zhes pa'i sras ni sems dpa' yab yum dang khro bo yab yum rnams yin la/ 'khor g.yog ni rnal 'byor ma dang / lha chen nas khor yug gi 'byung po'i bar ro/ /de rnams nyid grogs dang bcas gnyen gyis bskor zhes dang /rang rang gi 'khor lha dang lha mo rnams kyis mchod par byed pa de thams cad kyang kun khyab tu byin gyis rlob pa po gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' nyid dang bcas pa spyan 'dren pa'i don yin te/ de la spyir rgyud so so las gtor ma'i rnam —472—

gzhag mang du 'byung yang / rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi zhi ba la bshos gtsang dang / khro bo la gtor ma zhes grags shing / gtor sngags rnams kyang khro bo nas 'jig rten pa'i bar du gsal bar gsungs kyi/ zhi ba la gsal por ma gsungs pa ni gtso che ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /phyag rdor stod 'grel las/ gtso bo he ru ka la gtor ma 'bul ba shin tu gsal bas de dang mtshungs par 'dir yang gong ma rnams kyi man ngag phyag len du/ oṃ ā hu ho ye gle kā la tsakra badzra bha ra ba bhe ska rā ya sa pa ri wa re khyu i da ba ling sogs sbyor ba ni shin tu legs la/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor sngags kyang de la 'thus par mdzad pa'i srol zhig rje phyogs pa man chad la byung 'dug kyang / rgyal mchog kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung la med cing / mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor sngags ni yul bdag dang 'dra yi/ sde drug dang mi 'dra bas logs su byas na legs so/ /sde drug srung ma drug cu'i gtor ma ni/srung 'khor gyi skabs su byed pa de kho na ste/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma gzhan yod na yang skabs der phul nas/ de nas mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma dang / /'byung po spyi gtor gzhan dang / yul bdag grong bdag gi gtor ma rnams kyang 'bul lo/ /srung ma drug cu'i gtor ma yan chad med mi rung yin la/phyi ma rnams rang gi mos pa dang bstun par bya'o/ /tshogs kyi bza' ba dang ma 'brel na/ de rjes rdo rje'i glu blangs shis brjod dang smon lam byas te yig brgya bzod gsol gyi mthar gtor mgron rnams gshegs su gsol ba yin no// //bzhi pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ phud bcad de/ lko ā hu gu ru ja khyu bo dhi sa te smyo badzra ni wi rkye skyo/ zhes —473—

bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phul/ de rjes o ha ri st+ya piṇḍa ke pra tī tstsha swāhā zhes pas 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa la chang bu gnyis dang / oṃ sarba dū tī ke a grwa gra sa pra tī tstsha swāhā/ zhes pho nya sogs 'byung po phud la dbang ba rnams la sbyin/ de nas rang nyid dus kyi sde bor lo lte ba'i ho las gtum mo 'bar ba dang / gshegs gsol gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gnas de dang de dag tu lha rnams gsal thebs na rab/ min na'ang bzhugs par mos pa tsam bya la/ yang na phung khams thams cad gdod nas grub pa'i lha sum cu rtsa bdun ye shes kyi 'khor lor mos pas kyang chog gang ltar yang nang gi spyin sreg gi tshul gyis sdig dang ma 'dres shing / rgyal ba'i bkas gnang ba'i bza' btung la longs spyad par bya'o// mjug tu smon lam btab/ gal te zhor la dpa' bo'i ston mo'am/ dpa' mo'i ston mo rjes mthun pa grub par byed na/maṇḍal gyi mchod bstod song mtshams nyid nas dkyil 'khor ma bsdus pa la byas na legs te/ de ma thag gtor ma bshams nas gtor bsngo bya/ yang na maṇḍal mchod chog dang bdag bskyed bsdus kyang rung ste/ gtor bsngo song ma thag tu/ kha zas byin gyis brlabs/ phud dang po gtor ma la spron pa'am/ snod gzhan du spyi bungs kyi tshul byas te/ gtor ma'am maṇḍal yod na yang maṇḍal gyi mdun du bzhag grogs dang bcas pa yin na tshogs bsre ba'i dri ba dri lan gyis drangs/ sgos kyi zas phud kyang bcad/ rang gcig pu yin na de gnyis ka mi dgos/ phud la mchod sngags chen mo'am/ gtor sngags kyis phul/ de rjes sngar bzhin myong bu sbyin zhing longs spyad la/ lhag ma bsangs sbyangs/ rma ā hū —474—

hos byin gyis brlabs/ spyi 'gros ltar 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang kha khru btab pa byas kyang chog gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang min/ oṃ kha kha ji hi 'a hi usnri sgo ba li usnro ni bhakṣa bhakṣa ka swāhā/ zhes pas lhag ma phyi rol tu dor ba dang lhan cig mkha' 'gro ma dang 'gyung po spyi gtor sogs kyang dor/ de rjes sde drug gi gtor ma rnams kyang 'dod don gsol ba'i tshig dang bcas te phyir btang ngo / /rdo rje'i glu dang steng na byang chub sems dpa' sogs smon lam dang shis pa brjod pa byas/ yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams song ba'i rjes su sngar bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor ma bsdus na lus la bsdu zhing / bsdus zin na gtor mgron gtso bo ye shes 'khor lo dang bcas pa rang nyid la bstim/slar yang smon lam dang shis brjod rgyas par bya/ lag len du/ bsod nams 'di yis 'gro rnams du ba la sogs zhes pa nas/ bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig ces pa'i bar de mdzad do// //lnga pa spyod lam kyi rnal 'byor ni/ dus thams cad du snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bu dang / brag cha lta bur shes shing / gzugs su snang ba thams cad lha/ sgra grag tshad sngags/ yid kyi 'char sgo thams cad ye shes lnga'i ngo bor dag pa dran par bya'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe gnas drug tu rdo rje drug bkod de/ de yang lte bar dhra/snying gar hūX/ mgrin par hro/ dpral bar nywa/ gtsug tor du hraX/ gsang lābar hāXste yan lag drug go /de nas 'od gsal gyi gdams ngag gis gnyid log par bya zhing / sad pa'i tshe langs nas snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dang / bla ma yi dam dran bzhin pas dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ khrus kyi rnal —475—

'byor la sogs pa bya'o/ /zhes pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim rnam par bshad pa las/ rnal 'byor lam gyi yan lag thun mtshams kyi spyod pa rnams bshad pa'i sde tshan te bcu pa'o// //gsum pa gang bsgrub par bya ba'i yul dkyil 'khor gyi rab dbye la/dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i shin tu gtso bo ngos bzung ba dang / rgyud 'di nyid las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi grangs bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom/ par dka' bas mi nus na/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'ba' zhig bsgoms pas kyang gzhan gsang 'dus la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa bsgoms pa las kyang cho ga'i rim pa mang zhing / dag bya dag byed kyi sgo nas kyang rgyas par 'gyur ba dang / thugs dkyil 'ba' zhig tu dbang bskur ba thob pas kyang rgyud don mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang ba'i rgyu mtshan ni rigs dang rigs can gyi sgo nas sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi lha thams cad thugs dkyil nyid du 'dus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin la tshul ji lta bus 'dus snyam na/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ dpal ldan rdo rje can dang kun bzang rigs kyi dbang gis rdo rje 'dzin rnga/ phyag na rdo rjer 'gyur/ /don yod grub dang nam mkha'i snying po dri med nor bu'i phyag dang sa yi snying po yang dag go /phyag na 'khor lo rnam par sel bar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis 'od dpag med dang 'jig rten mgon/ /dpal ldan yum dang chos kyi khams te sgra yi rdo rje ma dang rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /dpal ldan sgrol ma reg bya rdo rje ma ste rigs kyi dbye bas gos dkar ro yi rdo rje ma/ /mā ma gī dang gzugs —476—

zhes grags par 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis spyan ma dri yi rdo rje ma/ /khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje shugs dang rgyal ba'i bdag por 'gyur te kun tu bzang po de nyid do/ /gtsug tor mi bskyod pa nyid 'dir ni slar yang shin tu stobs dang don yod grub par rab tu grags/ rmugs byed dang ni phyag na rin chen du 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis khengs byed dang ni 'od dpag med/ /rengs byed dang ni rnam par snang mdzad du 'gyur stobs ldan phyag na rdo rje dag dang gnod mdzes so/ /mkha' snying dang ni dbyug pa sngon po rang bzhin yon tan dbang gis sa yi snying po 'dod pa'o/ /rnam par sel dang shin tu brtson 'grus su 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis 'jig rten gru/gon po mi g.yo ba/ /yum dang khro bo'i dbang po'i phyag rgyar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis sgra yi rdo rje de bzhin nyid/ /stong par grags pa shin tu sngon mo rlung me chu dang sa rnams dang po mtha' yas brtson 'grus ma/ /rmugs byed ma dang khengs ma rengs byed mar ni rim pas rab tu gsal zhing nges par rab tu grags/ /drag spyan chos kyi khams mar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis lcags sgrog ma dang reg bya rdo rje ma/ 'od zer can dang dri yi rdo rjer rab tu 'gyur te khro gnyer can dang tsun dwar rab grags pa/ rigs kyi dbye bas nges par ro yi rdo rje ma dang gzugs kyi rdo rjer rim pas shes par bya/ 'dir ni rengs byed dus mthar byed pa nyid de slar yang shin tu stobs dang bgegs dgrar rab tu grags/ /rmugs byed shes rab mthar byed dag tu rab tu 'gyur te de bzhin khengs byed dang ni padma'i dgra/ /rlung me chu sa tsa muṇḍa dang phag mo dbang phyug ma dang de bzhin dbang mo bzhi pa ste/ /dri dang gzugs dang ro dang —477—

reg bya zhes pa g.yo ba 'a ca1ga byed lha min mer ni gnas pa yang tshangs pa dang ni rnam par snang mdzad du 'gyur rigs kyi dbang gis rgya mtsho dag dang 'od dpag med/ /me dang dpal ldan phyag na rin chen du 'gyur rlung dang don yod grub pa dag ni de bzhin nyid/ /mi bskyod pa dang lha min dgra bor 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po dang ni bde byed rab tu grags/ /rnam par sel ba gang de brgya byin du 'gyur 'jig rten mgon po tshogs kyi bdag po de bzhin nyid/ /sa yi snying po gdong drug par 'gyur dpal ldan mkha' snying lha min bdag por rab tu grags pa yin/ dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje dus su 'gyur te drug pa kun tu bzang po nor gyi bdag po'o/ rig ma drug dang rdo rje drug ni rang bzhi yon to dbang gis de rnams rang rang phyag rgya ste/ rig ma phyag rgya la sogs nyi ma lha yi mchog gi bdag rnams dkar po nag po rdzogs pa'o/ de dag rnams kyi pad 'dab la ni nor lag tshe ste mchu yi zla ba la sogs gang de rnams/ zla ba drug ni snga ma drug tu 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis lha mo rnams kyi phyi ma yang / /klu brgyad gang de bum pa rnams te khyab bdag padma'i 'dab la nus ma de rnams rab gtum ma/dpal ldan du ba bya rog gdong mar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis bya rgod gdong ma smig sgyu ma/ /mkha' snang ma ni 'ug gdong ma ste dpal ldan mar me mkha' 'gro'i bdag po'i gdong mar rab tu grags/ /nag mo 'bar ma khyi gdong ma ste dmar mo 'bar ma shin tu rnam 'gyur gdeng ldan phag gdong ma/ dkar mo 'bar ma stag gi gdong mar 'gyur te rigs kyi dbang gis ser mo 'bar ma ce spyang ma/ /de bzhin rnam pa bcu yi sgeg mo la sogs kun rab gsal te sna —478—

tshogs yum gyi lhag ma'o/ /zhes gsung dang sku'i lha tshogs rnams thugs dkyil la 'dus/ par gsungs te/ tsa muṇḍa sogs bzhi sgrol ma sogs bzhi las byung ba dang / tshangs ma sogs bzhi dri rdo rje ma sogs bzhi las byung ba dang / khyab 'jug rlung me chu changs pa drag po rnams mi bskyod pa sogs rgyal ba rigs drug las byung ba dang / nor bdag sogs drug kun bzang sogs sems dpa' drug las byung ba dang / 'dab ma'i lha mo rnams rang rang gi gtso bo yab yum du 'dus pa dang / khro bo gtsug tor sogs drug kyang mi bskyod pa dang mkha' snying sogs su bsdus shing / khro mo rnams kyang de dag gi yum du 'dus pa dang / klu rnams bum pa dang / rab gtum ma rnams nus ma la 'dus shing / 'dod phyir 'dod rnams kyang rang rang gi sprul gzhi la 'dus pa'i phyir ro/ de ltar thugs dkyil tsam sgom pa yang yongs rdzogs la bltos nas bsdus pa yin pas bsdus pa zhes bya yi/ spyi ldog nas rgyas pa la dga' ba'i don du gsungs pa yin te/bsdus pa kho na la mos pas ni/ thams cad kyang gtso bo yab yum du 'dus pa'i phyir lhan skyes sgom pa yin te/ gzhan yang lha lnga dang / lha dgu la sogs nga ji ltar 'os pa'o// //gnyis pa rgyud 'di nyid las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi grangs bshad pa ni/ 'o na rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di las dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs ji tsam bshad ce na/ gtso bor smos pa dang / dngos su gsungs pa dang / 'gres bsgyur ba'i rnam grangs kyi dkyil 'khor te gsum las/ dang po ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid dang / sdom pa che chung —479—

gnyis/ gsang ba 'du/sa pa lha so bzhi ma/ sgyu 'phru/la drwa ba lha zhe dgu ma ste lnga po de rnams so/ /de dag ni gtso 'khor gyi lha rnams gcig gi nang du gcig shos bsdu mi nus pa'i phyir shin tu mi 'dra zhing / dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams de dag tu 'dus la/ 'di rnams ma tshang na mi 'du ba'i phyir rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi tha snyad bzhag na legs la/ 'on kyang de thams cad kyi yang gtso bo ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid do/ /drug brgya sum cu so drug gi lha tshogs dang ldan pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor skrub thabs le'ur rgyas bshad mdzad pa 'di ni/ chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khore zhes bya la/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khordo ra zhes bya ba ni/ dkyil 'khor bcu gcig gam bcu gnyis yongs su bsdoms pa'i ming ngo //khro rgyal rdo rje shugs srung ma drug cus bskor ba lta bu gtso bo yang cung zad tha dad pa dang / 'khorwa ra kyi lha zad par bcu dang gza' bcu lta bu drug brgya sum cu so drug gi lha tshogs dang / dpal ldan rgyu skar stong drug brgya nyi shu'i nang du mi the ba dang / lha de dag bskyed chog gi sgo nas bskyed cing nges pa can gyi lhar yang mdzad pas/ 'di yang rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du bgrang dgos pa ma yin nam snyam na/ 'di ni sa sbyang ba dang srung 'khor gyi skabs su dgos pa'i lha tshogs tsam yin pas/ 'di la dkyil 'khor sbyar ba ni/ cha shas kyis gsungs pa'am don thob kyis sbyar ba'i dkyil 'khor yin gyi/ dngos su gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor ma yin la/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor yin na dngos su gsungs ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis khyab pa'i phyir der mi bgrang ngo / /yang zad par rnams ni khor yug gi grub —480—

pa'i nang tshan dang / gza' rnams kyang khor yug gi lha la yod pas 'khor thams cad gsung dbang gi dkyil khor du 'dus sam snyam na de ni ma yin te/ khor yug gi lha gtso bsdus su rlom pa rnams sa bon phyag mtshan las bskyed chog gis bskyed pa ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin zhing / 'di'i khungs kyi rtsa ba ded na paṇḍi ta spros pa can gyi blo'i ri mo tsam la thug 'dug pa'i phyir/ gza' bcu sogs de'i nang du bcug mod kyang / rgyud las gsungs ba'i chos dbyings gsung dbang dang / dpal ldan rgyu skar gnyis ka la lha de dag gi mi the'o// //gnyis pa ni/ sngar bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga po de dag las rnam par phye na/ dkyil 'khor shin tu mang por 'gyur te/ sgrub ler/ gcig pu'i sku'am nus ma dang ldan gnas dgu dang bcas nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid la sogs pa/bsgoms na phyag rgya la sogs grub pa rnams su nges par nyin zhag 'ga' zhig dag gis yang dag 'gyur/ zhes gsungs shing / 'grel chen du/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dpa' bo gcig pa'am shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid dam/ lnga'i bdag nyid la sogs par gsungs pa ni/ zhal la sogs pa'i dbye ba rnams kyi zhi ba la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes brgya sum cu pa'i 'grel par gsungs pas gcig pu'i sku las phye na dpa' bo gcig pa dang lhan skyes gnyis yod la/ rtsa ba'i tshig gis ma zin mod lha lnga pa yang 'grel par byung zhing / gtso bo nus ma dang bcas pa'i lha dgu dang / bde gshegs 'phar ma'i re mig gi gnas dang / gtso bo'i gnas te mdor na gtso bo gshegs pa yab yum brgyad dang bcas pa'i lha dgu dang / thugs dkyil lha nyer lnga mar yongs su —481—

grags pa dang / sogs khongs nas lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang / lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang / bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang / thugs dkyil yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams ston pa ste/ skabs gzhan du gsungs pa la dgongs so/ /de la lha bcu gsum ma ni nang le'i brgya nga gcig par gsungs te/ gshegs pa yab yum brgyad kyi steng du khro bo bzhi bsnan pas bskor ba'o// 'di ni byis pa'i gdon zhi byed kyi skabs/ dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor du yang gsungs so/ /bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ nang le'i brgya zhe bdun gyi 'grel par/ lha dgu rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi tshad khru gcig go /bcu gsum rnams kyi khru gnyis so/ /mi bdag ces pa bcu drug rnams kyi khru bzhi'o/ /zhes bcu drug ces pa 'khor gyi lha bcu drug go /de yang nus ma brgyad dang sangs rgyas yab yum brgyad/ gtso bo dang bcas pas bcu bdun no/ /lha bcu dgu ma ni/ sgrub ler ro langs sgrub pa'i thabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su gsungs te rigs bzhi yum bzhi khro bo bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs so/ /nyer lnga'i bdag nyid ni/ rgyud las/ du ba la sogs lha mo brgyad po dor nas rgyal ba'i bdag po'i padma dag la res 'ga' ni/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo'i snying po'i dbus su mi yi bdag po nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid du yang 'gyur/ /zhes pa ste/ nus ma brgyad spangs pa'i gzhan thugs dkyil gyi lha rnams tshang ba yin te/ 'di la ni mtshon sa'i dbus su padma 'dab brgyad bya ste/ka ba dang bcas pa'i bde gshegs 'phar ma spangs pa 'dab ma brgyad la rigs lnga yum bzhi bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs dkyil yongs rdzogs ni/ dbang gi —482—

— sto—— —lnge————— sdi— —don du dkyil 'cha/ ra dag ni rigs kyi dbang gis phyi yi 'khor los rab tu dman par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyi tsam nas gong du bshad pa'i lha grangs nyung ngu de rnams kyang sgom pa'i don 'ba' zhig tu ma zad dbang bskur ba yang rung ste/ bcu gsum gyi skabs su bshad pas mtshon no/ /'on kyang 'dir dbang gi don du zhes gsungs pa ni/ snga ma de rnams su dbang bskur ba ni/ cung zad rgyud smin pa'i stobs chung la/ rnal 'byor pa mchog gis spyod yul yin na ma gtogs/ dbang bskur rab gnas sogs sgrub pa la cung zad dpal chung ba'i dgag bya yod la/ gtso bor sgom pa'i don du ni/ rang gi blo'i nus pa dang bstun nas sbyor dgos pas mos pa tha dad pa so so'i ngor thams cad legs pa sha stag yin pas spang blang gi dbye ba mi 'thad de/ rgyud las/ rang gi sems kyi nus pa shes pas bcom ldan 'di yang rnal 'byor pa rnams dag gis bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ nyer lnga pa'i skabs su 'di skad ces gsung pa ni/dpa' bo gcig pa nas nyer lnga pa'i bar sgom pa'i don du gtso che bar dgongs so/ /gcig pu'i sku'am zhes pa'i skabs kyi dpa' gcig dang lhan skyes ni/ re zhig phyag mang gi dbang du byas pa'o/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid la yang sgrub pa'i thabs dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga dang / paṇa grub rnams la dbang bskur ba'i rgyun yang yod de/ thugs dkyil yongs rdzogs dang phal cher mtshungs par dgongs shing / zor yang ba'i phyir shin tu 'thad pa'ang yin la/ 'on kyang gsung dbang yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor bzheng par mi nus pas/ thugs dkyil rgyas pa bzheng thub na ni/ yongs rdzogs dang phan yon khyad med pa lta bur —483—

—bsngags pa mdzad do/ /thugs dkyil dang gsung dkyil ni yod la sku dkyil spangs pa lta bu/ bar mtshams der rnam gzhag mi 'dra ba gzhan ma gsungs pas thugs dkyil rgyas pa las spros pa byed phyin/ sku gsung thugs gsum car rdzogs pa nyid sgom dgos pa yin la/ de nyid la lha mang nyung gi dbye ba ni 'byung du rung bar mngon no/ /gzhan yang dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi skabs su dgos pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo lha stong dang bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / 'byung po sgrub pa'i skabs su gsungs ba'i rdo rje shugs lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / klu brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor te gnyis dang / sdom pa chen po lha brgya nyi shu pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / sdom pa chung ba drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor dang /gsang 'dus lha dgu pa bcu gsum ma bcu dgu ba nyer lnga ma so gnyis ma so bzhi ma ste/ gsang 'dus rigs drug dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba bzhi bcu zhe gsum ma dang / zhe lnga pa dang / zhe dgu pa rnams dang / sna tshogs yum lha lnga bcu nga drug pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / rnal 'byor ma rigs sum cu so drug gi dkyil 'khor te skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /gsum pa 'gres bsgyur ba'i rnam grangs kyi dkyil 'khor la rgyud tshig gis zin pa dang don gyi thob pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang nas/ padma gdan can gyi dkyil 'khor logs su phyung ba ni/ nang le las/ nus ma khro bo rnams ni rim pas bcu ru rab tu 'gyur te lnga ni sangs rgyas lha mo rnams/ /gzugs sogs mig la sogs pa drug ste slar yang mi yi bdag po lha yi tshogs ni drug gnyis so/ /rnal 'byor ma dang klu dang gtum mo brgyad ces bya ste srid par 'di —484—

rnams thams cad nyis 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung ste/ 'di la nus ma bcu la yang padma'i gdan logs su byed cing / thabs re res dngos su 'byud pa dang / rgyal ba yab lnga yum lnga khro bo bcu/ sems dpa' yab yum bcu gnyis/ lha chen bcu gnyis/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad/ rab gtum ma brgyad/ klu brgyad de bdun cu don brgyad po de rnams thabs la shes rab kyis 'byud pa dang / shes rab la thabs kyis 'khrud pa'i dbye bas brgya lnga bcu nga drug dang / rgyas 'debs kyi lha drug ces bya ba/ rigs bdag rgyal ba rigs drug rnams bsnan pas brgya drug cu re gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor du yang 'gyur la/ 'ga' zhig snying rje'i dbang bskur gyi skabs su bshad pa'i mtshan so gnyis kyi lha tshogs la gtso bo rdor sems dang / mi bskyod pa'i dbye bas dkyil 'khor gnyis su 'gyur ba dang / spyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bcu yang tshig zin gyi dkyil 'khor du bgrong la/ de bzhin du sgrub le las/ zhes pa la sogs mi yi bdag po lha rnams dang ni lha mo rnams kyi sgrub thabs so so sa /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni rang gi rgyal ba'i rigs kyi dbang gis las kyi dbye ba mtha' dag rnams kyis 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par yang / lha dang lha mo rnams kyi sgrub thabs so so ru dkyil 'khor 'dir ni dpa' bo gcig pa rnams kyis 'gyur te rang gi rgyal ba'i rigs kyi dbang gis ni/ rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i rigs kyi dbang gis las kyi dbye ba mtha' dag rnams kyi sgrub thabs su 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / yang snga ma'i 'phros las/ sum cu rtsa drug rnal 'byor ma rnams 'gyur te slar yang bzlas dang sbyin sreg rang gi sa bon gyi/ /zhes gsungs shing de'i 'grel par yang / sum cu rtsa —485—

drug rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / gzhan dur khrod kyi mthar thug pa rnams kyis 'chad par 'gyur ba'i sgrub thabs su 'gyur te/ zhes 'byung bas/ las phra mo so so ba'i skabs su/ gtso bo nas dur khrod kyi bar gyi lha re re nas dkyil 'khor du 'gyur bar bshad pas nus ma bcu/ sangs rgyas yab yum bcu/ khro bo bcu/klu bcu// rab gtum/ ma bcu/ sems dpa' yab yum bcu/ gnyis/ lha chen bcu gnyes/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad/ gsung dang sku'i 'dab ma'i lha bzhi brgya dang bcu gnyis bsdoms pas lnga brgya brgyad cu gya gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/de bzhin du rang gi mos pa'i dbang gis lha re re'i sgrub thabs kyang de bzhin du 'gyur te/ gzhan yang rdo rje shugs srung ma drug cu dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / khro bo bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis su 'gyur zhing / rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag mtshan so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor dang / dngul chu'i bcud len gyi skabs su gsungs pa'i dzambha la'i dkyil 'khor dang / gsang 'dus rigs drug gi lha thams cad gtso bo go 'pho byas pas/ lha dgu la dkyil 'kho1ra dgu nas lha so bzhi pa la dkyil 'khore so bzhi'i bar du 'gyur bas/ kun bsdoms na gsang 'dus la brgya dang sum cu so gnyis so/ /de ltar na sngar gyi nyer brgyad mi the ba'i 'gres kyis bsgres pa/ rgyud 'grel gyi tshig zin las bstan pa'i dkyil 'khor bdun brgya bco brgyad do// //gsum pa don gyis thob pa la/ khro bo mo bcu'i dkyil 'khor dang / rnal 'byor ma brgyad la lha bcu pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad dang / tshes lha rnams la lha sum cu ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo nyid —486—

la'ang / rgyal ba rigs drug go 'phos pa'i dbye bas dkyil 'khor chen po drug tu 'gyur zhing / dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i skabs su sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig la thugs kyi dkyil 'khor khru bcu gnyis pa dang / gsung la bcu drug pa dang / sku la nyi shu par gsung pa dngos bstan che chung gi tshad la thugs gsung sku'i dag pa sbyor tshul tsam zhig yin pas/ gzhan rnam 'gyu/ra mi 'dra ba dang lha grangs sogs la khyad par gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / don thob kyi rig pas da lta'i gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor dngos su bshad pa 'di ye shes rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yin pas gzhan de dag la sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi rdo rjes gtso bo mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung zhing /mdun bskyed bri cha la ji ltar 'byung ba ltar bdag bskyed la sgom du rung ba yin la/ da lta ye shes rdo rje'i dbang du byas nas mi bskyod pa dang rdor sems kyi ngo bor byed pa bzhin du thugs rdo rje la rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs su 'di go zlog dang / gsung la rin 'byung rgyu don grub 'bras bur byed pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / sku la rnam snang rgyu 'od dpag med 'bras bur byed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ gang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa de nyid rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag tu bya'o// thugs la da lta'i gtso bo'i kha dog sngon po'i gnas su ljang khu 'byung / gzhan 'dra / gsung dang sku'i nag po la yang phal cher de dang 'dra ba dang / dmar po dang dkar po la zhal gyi dbye ba rim pas 'pho tshul dang / phyag dang po bzhi'i 'pho tshul rigs bsgre ba yin la/ yang na rgyu 'bras rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis ka rigs tha dad yin kyang sku'i rnam 'gyur mi 'pho bar dmar po dang 487—

dkar por bya zhing de'i tshe thugs rdo rje yang nag po'o/ /de bzhin du sbyin sreg gi dkyil snyen ra bcu la yang de dang mthun pa'i bsgom bya'i dkyil lubor kho 'byung zhing / rnal 'byor ma so drug gi dkyil 'khor gsungs pas dpa' bo sum cu rtsa drug gi dkyil 'khor yang don gyis thob pa dang / sdom chen la gsungs pa ltar sdom pa chung ba la yang yum gyi dkyil 'khor thob pa dang / gsang 'dus la gtso bo go 'pho gsungs pas/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gsum la'ang gtso bo go 'pho thob ste/ de bzhin du gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo nyid kyi zhal phyag mang nyung gi sgo nas kyang dbye ba'i rnam grangs du mar 'gyur te/ ye shes le'ur/ rdo rje rnams kyi zhal gyi dbye ba 'gyur te rgyal ba'i bdag po'i phyag rnams dbyangs kyi dbye ba yis/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ rigs gcig gi zhal gcig dang / rigs gsum gyi dag pa zhal gsum dang / rigs lnga dag pas zhal lngar 'gyu/ra ba dang / rigs drug gi dag pa zhal drug tu 'gyur te 'jigs zhes bya'o/ /de bzhin du zhal brgyad pa la sogs pa nas/ ha la ha la gdong brgya pa'i bar du khams rnams kyi dag pa gtso bor 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / sgrub ler/ gcig la sogs pa mtha' yas zhal te phyag dang zhabs mang du ma'i kha dog mun pa dag gi mthar/ zhes gsungs pa'i 'grel par/ 'dir zhal gcig pa'am sogs pa'i sgras zhal gnyis pa'am/ bzhi dang lnga dang mtha' yas pa'am/ zhes zhal gnyis pa yang gsungs la/ ye ler/ shes rab thabs ni zhal bcu yon tan rnam pa gsum gyi dbang gis bzhi la zhal ni bcu gnyis pa/ /zhes pa dang / 'grel bar/ de ltar zhal bcu gnyis dang / phyag nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das —488—

dus kyi 'khor lo gcig go zhes gsungs shing / de la zhal gcig pa ni dpa' gcig bsdus pa dang / lhan skyes bsdus pa lta bu rtsa ba'i zhal phyag tsam zhig yin la/ zhal gnyis pa ni mdun zhal sngo zhing rgyab zhal ljang ba'am rtsa zhal sngo steng ljang ba lta bu phyag bzhi phyag mtshan rdor dril dang gri thod 'dzin pa/ de gnyis la yum phyag gnyis ma ste lhan skyes bsdus pas mtsho ni/ zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa ste/ zhal mdog dang phyag mtshan rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dang mthun/zhal bzhi pa ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ phyag brgyad pa g.yas rdo rje ral gri rtse gsum gri gug g.yon dril bu phub dang / kha smo thod pa 'dzin zhing / yum yang zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma spyi dang 'dra'o/ /zhal lnga pa yang spyi dang 'dra ba las/steng zhal ljang khu lhag po dang / phyag brgyad kyi phyag mtshan gong du bshad pa bzhin dang / tha ma gnyis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo ltar na/ dgra sta/tshangs mgo dang / he ru ka ltar na glang lpags so/ /'di la yum zhal gsum phyag drug ma'o/ /zhal drug pa ni/ zhal drug phyag drug zhabs drug pa ste phur pa'i khro bo dang 'dra'o/ /zhal brgyad pa ni/ phyogs bzhi'i zhal phyogs mdog mtshams bzhi'i zhal phyed gzugs sam/ yang na kha dog 'dres pa'o/ /de'i tshe phyag bcu drug pa ste/ phyag mtshan gsal kha med na'ang dgyes rdor dang mtshungs par bzhed pa dang / nyer bzhi pa'i phyag mtshan gyi nang nas 'dor len byed zer te/bdag gi rtog pa ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i hūṃ mdzad phyag bcu drug pa dang mtshungs par byas na legs sam snyam mo/ /zhal bzhi phyag nyer bzhi pa ni dkyus kyi gtso bo 'di yin la phyag nyer drug pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can nyid dang /—489—

zhal bcu gnyis phyag nyer bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje bzhi la zhal gsum gsum ste/phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mdog dang mtshungs so/ /phyag mtshan yang de nyid kyis regs 'gre/ 'di la'ang phyag nyer drug pa 'byung bar mngon zhing /de bzhin du nyer gnyis pa dang zhal bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa'i dag pa yang yod la/ gzhan zhal brgya pa'i bar du 'byung zhes gsungs kyang mtshan nyid gsal bar ma bshad pas de dang de'i rnam gzhag mi bya'o/ /des na gong du bshad pa'i gcig pu'i sku'i dkyil 'khor nas/ sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi bar la gtso bo'i zhal phyag gi dbye ba mi 'dra ba du ma sbyar na mtha' yas par yang 'gyur la/ 'on kyang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs phra mo du ma ni/spyir rgyud kyi don la ji ltar gnas tshul tsam go ba la nye bar mkho yi/ nyams len sgrub pa la de tsam gyis dgos don chung bas/ gtso bo gtso dag bzung bar bya'o/ /dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor la dkyil gon ra so so tha dad pa ni/sngar bshad pa de rnams nyid yin la/ dkyil 'khor thams cad gcig tu bsdoms te sgom pa dkyil 'khor logs pa zhig tu byed pa yang yod de/ mi 'gal zhing legs par yang sems mod/ kha cig gzhal med khang lhag po zhig phyir bkod de sgo sbrag bzhi pa byas nas/ phyogs bzhir dkyil 'khor gsum gsum 'god rgyu la gnyis ma 'dangs te mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis bcug /de rnams thams cad 'dod snam tshun chad kyi dkyil 'khor du byas nas kun gyi phyi rol tu khor yug chen po gcig gis chog par byed zer te/ de 'dra ni rang bzo kho na nyid du 'gro bas mi bya la/ des na srung 'khor gcig kho nas chog —490—
