pa dang / tshogs gsog gi tshe yang dkyil 'khor bcu gcig kar spyan 'dren/ de nas stong nyid dus gcig tu bsgom/ gzhal yas khang gur dang bcas pa bcu gcig dus gcig tu bskyed/ mngon byang lnga sogs gtso bo so so bskyed pa yang dus gcig la bya/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog spro ba dang / zhu ba dang /glus bskul dang / las rgyal mchog spro ba dang / ye shes sbyan 'dren dang / rgyas btab kyi bar du dmigs pa gsal na dkyil 'khor bcu gcig bcu gcig po rnams dus gcig tu bskyed/ mi gsal na yang dkyil 'khor bcu gcig po'i bya ba re re rim can du byas nas spel gyin bsgom/ de la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bcu gcig bsgom dgos pas/ dpal mchog dang rtse mo'i rigs bsdus sam/ gnyis med rnam rgyal brdzus ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rigs 'gre mi bya'o//phyogs gang du dkyil 'khor gang 'god na/ rgyud las/ 'di la sogs pa de bzhin du ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyang 'dus pa rnam pa drug tu gsungs pa ste/ /zhes pa nas/ shes rab dang ni thabs rnams mtha' dag zhal gsum ro'i phyag ldan g.yas gyi zhal las spros pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gsungs pas/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo lho phyogs su 'god rigs la/ yang ji skad du/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dbye ba gsum ste zhal gsum ro yi phyag ni lha yi sku yi dbye ba las/ /rtog pa la sogs gang yin mtha' dag blun po'i sems kyi dbang gis g.yon gyi zhal nas spros pa'o/ /zhes pas sgyu dra'i gtso bo g.yon du bya/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa'i rgyud dang 'dir ni nyes 'gyur sdom pa chen po mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /'khor lo drug ni rigs drug rnams te mi bdag dur khrod sa —491—

rnams nub kyi zhal nas spros pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba la/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa'i dkyil 'khor dngos rgyud 'dir ma gsungs shing / sdom pa chen po nub kyi zhal nas spros par gsungs pas nub tu 'god rigs sam snyam na/ sdom pa chung ba dpal ldan rgyu skar la mi bgrong pa'i dbang du byas na/ shes rab rgyud kyi mngon par brjod pa srid pa gsum gyi bla mas shar gyi zhal nas spros pa'o/ /zhes 'byung ba sdom pa chung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs dang 'brel ba yin yang / sdom chen yang mngon brjod 'bum pa las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor du bshad pa'i phyir/ shes rab rgyud kyi nang tshan kho na yin pas shar du bkod na 'grel bar snang zhing / gsang 'dus gzhan dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gzhan mo rnams phyogs phyogs 'brel gang chags su 'god par bya'o/ /rgyu skar 'khor lo'i grangs las lhag par gyur kyang / rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag zlum pa'i dbang du byas na/ lho byang gi sngar dang 'dra ba las shar du sdom chung / nub tu sdom chen/ de dang nye bar rdo rje shugs rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bkod na/ dkyil 'khor 'god tshul legs shing / de rnams dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsres pa ma yin par so sor sgom pa yin pa'i phyir/ sdom chung rdo rje shugs gnyis kyis lhag pa'i skyon yang mi skyed do/ /khor yug chen po rnams kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang gcig gi nang du bshad tshod las lhag na skyon che ste/ 'dir brjod pa de la ni/ khor yug tha dad pa bcu gsum byung ba'i phyir skyon med do/ /'o na dpal ldan rgyu skar dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor gzhan sgom pa mi rigs so snyam na/ de tsam la mi rung ba ga la —492—

zhig ste/ rnal 'byor ba'i blo'i stobs kyis nus na/ rgyud sde bzhi po'i dkyil 'khor brgya stong du ma gcig car sgom thub na yang yud tsam zhig gis tshogs kyi sgo mtha' yas pa gsog nus pas ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor ba ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos yin gyi/ so so so so'i rang thad du rang rang gi cho ga tshang ba'i phyir/ 'dres pa'i skyon cung zad kyang med de/ sgrub pa po tha dad du mas so sor dkyil 'khor du ma dus gcig tu bsgoms pa bzhin no/ /yang de 'dra ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor bas yin gyi/ las dang po pa la min no snyam na ting nge 'dzin la dbang ma 'byor na/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor rang yang chabs cig tu sgom par mi nus te/ 'dir de'i dbang du byas so/ /gzhan yang 'di'i dkyil 'khor bcu gcig po phyogs gcig tu sgom pa zhig nges par yod pa ni yin te/ 'di'i lha grangs la dag sbyor mang du mdzad pa'i phyir te/ sgom pa'i don ma yin na dag sbyor gyi sde tshan phrugs gcig tu mdzad pa de la dgos pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang nang gi le'ur/ dus kyi lo ni me grangs lo yi nyin zhag tshogs kyis bsgyur te rigs drug bgrod pa'i yan lag gi /zhes sogs dag sbyor che thang du mdzad pa'i phyir dang / de dag rgyud 'dir gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso che ba mtha' dag gi dag sbyor tsam mo snyam na/ de ltar yang sgom pa'i don yin dgos la/ 'dir sdom pa chung ba sogs ma gsungs pas rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor kho na'i yin pa las/ de'i nang gi dkyil 'khor re re tsam las ma bsgoms na/ rgyu skar ci rigs pa'i chu tshod kyi dag pa las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ rgyu skar gyi chu tshod la dag pa mtha' dag phrugs gcig tu sbyar ba 'dis/—493—

dkyil 'khor bcu gcig kar chabs cig tu sgom pa'ang bstan pa yin no/ /de la rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor ni rgyud 'dir yang gsungs mod kyi/ rtsa rgyud las 'byung ba gtso che bar grags la/ bsdus rgyud 'di las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug ces bya ba/ sgrub ler rgyas bshad mdzad pa 'di kho na yin gyi/ 'di la nus ma bcu/ sangs rgyas yab yum nyi shu/byang sems yab yum nyer bzhi/ khro bo yab yum brgyad/ gzungs ma bcu gnyis te thugs dkyil la lha bdun bcu'o/ /ma mo brgyad/ de'i yab brgyad/ rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi/ 'dod ma so drug ste gsungs dkyil brgya dang bcu drug gi lha tshogs so// tshes lha sum brgya drug cu/ sgo skyong khro bo yab yum bcu gnyis/klu dang rab gtum ma phan tshun yab yum 'phyud pas bzhi bcu/ /phyir 'dod ma so drug ste/ sku dkyil la bzhi brgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad do/ /gsum ka bsdoms pas drug brgya sum cu so bzhi ste 'khor tshogs yin la/ kun khyab gtso bo yab yum bsnan pas drug brgya so drug gi lha tshogs so/ /'di dag tu chos kyi dung sogs nang gi rdo rje bzhi/ chos kyi 'khor lo sogs phyi'i rdo rje bzhi/ bum pa bcu rnams lha'i ngo bo yin yang / chos 'khor sogs zhar la bskyed pa yin zhing / de thams cad zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du med pas 'jig rten grags pa dang bstun te lha'i grangs su mi gzhug pa'o/ /ye shes nam mkha'i gshegs pa yab yum bzhi ni gtso bo yab yum la tshang ba tsam las dngos su med kyang dag sbyor gyi dbang gis bgrangs pa'o/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor ltar na padma'i lte ba la bzhugs pa'i lha brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug gsung dang sku'i pad 'dab kyi lha mo —494—

bzhi brgya bcu gnyis kyi steng du gzungs ma bcu gnyis bsnan te bzhi brgya nyer bzhi po la'ang rang rang gi thabs re re sbyar bas brgyad rgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad 'byung ba padma gdan can dang bsdoms pas stong dang bzhi 'byung la/ de rnams 'khor tshogs kho na yin/ de'i steng du gtso bo yab yum bsnan pas stong dang drug /de nas 'khor lo sdom chen gyi yab yum kha sbyor gyi lha rnams cig tu bgrangs pas zhe brgyad dang / lha mo rkyang pa nyer bzhi yod de dril bus bdun bcu rtsa gnyis/ sdom chen gtso bo yab yum gnyis dkyil 'khor kun la dgos pa'i rgyas 'debs kyi lha drug ste/ de rnams las 'khor tshogs kho na la stong dang brgyad cu ni/ lo gsum gyi nyin zhag gi tshogs pa rnam par dag pa yin la/gsang 'dus rigs drug bsdoms pas kha sbyor gyi lha brgya so gnyis/ sgyu dra rigs gsum bsdoms pas kha sbyor gyi lha brgya so bdun/ de gnyis bsdoms pas kha sbyor gyi lha nyis brgya drug cu re dgu/ yab yum so sor bgrangs pas lnga brgya sum cu so brgyad do/ /'dir lnga brgya so brgyad dang gong gi stong brgyad cu bsdoms pas stong dang drug brgya bco brgyad la gsung dbang dang sdom chen gyi gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum ngo bo gcig pa bsnan pas stong drug brgya nyi shu ste/ rgyu skar gyi chu tshod kyi grangs dang lha grangs mtshungs par dag sbyor byas pas/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya'o/ /sdom chen gyi lha'i tshab tu 'dod phyir 'dod bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'jug pa'ang sngon dus 'ga' zhig 'dod par grags te/ rgyud las/ mtha' dag bsdus par gyur pa mngon brjod rnams dang bcas pa nyi ma'i nyin zhag gsum 'gyur du ni 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i 'grel —495—

par/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la lo gsumyo/ gyi nyin zhag gi tshogs kyi lha dang lha mo rig par bya/ zhes gsungs shing / mngon brjod ces pa mngon brjod 'bum pa'i don du gsal ba'i phyir sdom chen nges par dgos pas/ rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor 'di la 'dod phyir 'dod dang steng 'og gi klu dang rab gtum ma rnams med par gsal lo/ /des na skabs 'di dag gi 'grel pas/ 'dus pas sgyu dra gnyis thabs rgyud dang / dus 'khor bde mchog gnyis shes rab kyi rgyud du yang gsungs shing / shes rab kyi rgyud shar gyi zhal nas gsungs shing sdom pa chen po nub zhal nas spros pas kyang rnal 'byor ma rgyud dngos thugs dang / ma rgyud khyad par can ye shes su bstan pas sdom pa thugs rdo rje dang / dus 'khor ye shes rdo rje gtso che bar bstan par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na dngos bstan dang 'gres sbyar ba sogs spyir bsdoms na/ gtso bo yab rkyang dang / kha sbyor gcig pu dang / lha lnga ma dang / dgu ma rigs gnyis dang / bcu gsum ma dang / bcu bdun ma dang / bcu dgu ma dang / nyer lnga ma dang / thugs dkyil rgyas pa dang / padma gdan can gyi dkyil 'khor dang / sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs dang / sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsum ste/ gtso bo dus 'khor nyid las phye ba'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga dang / sna tshogs yum lha nga drug pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / rdo rje shugs la srung ma drug cus bskor ba dang / khro bo bcus bskor ba dang / klu brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / khro bo bzhis bskor ba ste/ rdo rje shugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi/ phyi ma 'di la dpa' bo gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor zer ba yod de don ma go ba'o/ /rigs so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor yab yum gnyis/—496—

rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor mtshan ma so gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor sdom pa che chung gnyis/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rigs gsum ste nyi shu rtsa dgu dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'khor tshogs kyi lha re re bzhin gyi sgrub thabs la/ 'grel ba'i dngos bstan la de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ dur khrod kyi bar gyi gsal kha las ma byung yang nus ma bcu don gyis thob cing / dkyil 'khor dngos kyi phyi ru ma bkod kyang rdor sems yab yum dang mi bskyod pa yab yum nges par dgos pas 'dab ma'i lha mo dang 'dod phyir 'dod gzungs ma nus ma dang bcas pa la lnga brgya bcu drug lha mo rkyang pa dang / rigs drug yum drug sems dpa' sems ma bcu gnyis lha chen bcu gnyis/ khro bo klu dang rab gsum gsum la bcu bcu/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad de yab yum kha sbyor bdun cu don bzhi dkyil 'khor dngos la bkod pa yin la/ shugs la khro mo bcu gtso bor byas pa'ang 'byung bas kha spyor brgyad cu gya bzhi/ de sngar gyi yum rkyang lnga brgya bcu drug dang bsres pas drug brgya ste de ltar 'khor tshogs gcig pu'i dkyil 'khor de tsam yin la/ gsang 'dus rigs drug la gtso bo go 'phos pas brgya dang so gnyis/ gsung gi rnal 'byor ma 'khor bcas la dkyil 'khor brgyad dang / sku'i lha chen 'khor bcas la dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis te nyi shu/ de ltar na drug brgya dang / brgya so gnyis dang / nyi shu rtsa dgu dang / nyi shu rnams bsdoms pas/ bdun brgya dang brgyad cu gya gcig byung la/ dpal ldan rgyu skar nang gi dus 'khor rgyas pa dang / dkyil 'khor bcu gcig gam bcu gnyis bsdoms pa'i rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor nyid kyang bsnan na/ bdun brgya brgyad cu gya gsum mo/ /gtso bo dus 'khor gyi —497—

dkyil 'khor sngar bshad pa'i bco lnga dang / phyi ma 'di gnyis te dkyil 'khor bcu bdun la gtso bo'i zhal phyag mang nyung mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba dang / gtso bo dus 'khor nyid la rigs lnga go 'pho tshul dang / spyin sreg gi thab kyi dkyil 'khor bcu la sogs pa dang / sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rigs gsum la gtso bo go 'pho sbyar na/ da dung mang por 'gyur mod kyi re zhig de'i spros pa bzhug go /gong du bshad pa ltar gtso bo'i zhal phyag gi grangs kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang /zhal gnyis phyag bzhi pa dang / zhal gsum phyag drug sku mdog ljang sngo gnyis dang / zhal bzhi phyag brgyad pa dang / zhal bzhi phyag nyer bzhi pa dang / zhal bzhi phyag nyer drug pa dang / zhal lnga phyag bcu pa dang / zhal drug phyag drug pa dang / zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa dang / zhal bcu gnyis phyag nyer bzhi pa dang / de la yang don gyis thob pa'i nyer drug pa ste/ gsal bar go nus pa bcu gnyis po de dag yin no/ /gtso bo'i zhal phyag mi 'dra ba'i dbye ba 'di dag mos pa so so dang dbang po tha dad pa'i dbye bas nyer mkho che bar gtogs pa tsam yin zhing / bod kyi dus 'khor ba 'ga' zhig lus kyi dkyil 'khor yang bzhed de/ rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan ltar na/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams lus la dag sbyor du 4zhad pa yin gyi/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil ltar mtha' gzhan du dogs pa med pa'i rkang tshugs lus dkyil dag pa par gsungs pa ma yin la/ bla ma'i man ngag gi rgyun dang ldan pa yin na ni mi 'gal te/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor gyi lus dkyil lta bu rgya gzhung gi khungs can dang / kye rdor lus dkyil lta bu man ngag snyan brgyud du bzhed pa bzhin yin la/—498—

rang gi blos dpyad pa yin na ni snying po med do/ /yang de dag gi bsam pa/ rgyud 'dir lus dkyil ma bstan na lus dkyil ston pa'i rgyud gzhan las rgyud 'di mi zab par song dogs par snang ste/ de ltar ma yin/ spyir lus dkyil ni/bskyed rim la bltos nas cung zad gzhan las zab pa'i phyogs su bsngags pa'i skabs shig yong mod/ de 'dra las brgya stong gi zab pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gnad rgyud sde gzhan las mi gsal ba 'dir rgya cher bshad pas rgyud 'di'i che ba de phyogs nas bsams pas chog cing / gzhan yang zab khyad shin tu mang ba'i phyir lus dkyil gyi phyogs kho na la 'gram mchu ldang mi dgos so/ /gzhan yang phyis kyi dus 'khor ba kha cig rgyud 'grel las dngos su zin pa'i dkyil 'khor sum brgya bcu gcag shugs kyis bstan pa stong drug brgya sogs kyi rnam gzhag byed pa'ang ji ltar 'os pa rtag par bya'o/ /de la rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di las dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag mang zhing / bskyed rim gyi cho ga yang shin tu rgyas par gsungs na/ gzhan du bskyed rim la smad cing / rdzogs rim la bsngags pa dag shas che'o/ /'dus pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig rdzogs rim sbas shing bskyed rim rtsal du bton pa dang / dgyes rdor ltar bu rdzogs rim ma sbas kyang bskyed rim la bsngags pa ches che ba'ang yod do/ /de la 'dir bskyed rim smad pa ni nges don gyi lam ma yin pa dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yang ma yin zhing / bskyed rim grub pa tsam la sangs rgyas dngos su rlom pa sogs bkag pa yin la/ gzhan 'gar rdzogs rim sbas pa ni de'i skal ba med pa la dgongs pa dang / rang gar 'jug pa dgag pa'i don yin gyi/—499—

las dang po pa la mi 'kho ba dang / sangs rgyas la sgrib par 'chad pa ma yin la/bskyed rim la bsngags pa ni/ las dang po ba shas che zhig la dgos nges pa dang / dang po rdzogs rim gyi skal ba med pa rnams de goms na skal ldan du 'gyur ba dang / gnas skabs kyi phan yon ches mang bar yod pa dang / phra mo dang 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub grub na/ slar byang chub kyi rgyu tshogs khyad par can du'ang 'gyur bar dgongs pa yin gyi/ nges don gyi lam sogs su 'chad pa ma yin pas de rnams dgongs pa'i gnad la mi mthun pa ni med do/ /'on kyang phyogs gcig nas bsngags pa che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis gsang 'dus dgyes rdor sogs la 'jug pa rnams bskyed rim la gtso bor byed pa dang / rgyud 'di la zhugs pa rnams rdzogs rim la gtso bor byed pa 'byung ba ni/ rgyud de dang de las bstod pa dang smad pa mdzad pa'i rjes su zhugs pa yin pas tshul dang mi mthun pa ma yin zhing / rigs pa yang yin te de ltar bstod smad mdzad pa la/gnas skabs rjes 'jug rnams la 'jug tshul gyi dgos pa zhig 'byung dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na 'dus pa ba sogs bskyed rim kho na sgom par spro ba la da lta 'phral mar rdzogs rim ma byung na mi rung ba'i 'dod pa gshugs po'i nan chags kyang mi bya la/ dus kyi 'khor lor zhugs pa dag rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pa la las dang po pa la rdzogs rim mi 'byung zhes bshad cing / bskyed rim la nges par slob dgos par nan gyis 'chad pa 'di dag ni skal ba'i rim pa dang bstun nas skyong mi shes pa'i blun rtags la lam cha tshang ba gru bzhir 'byer ba yin no snyam pa'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyi gdon chen po zhugs pa mi gsal ba —500—

dang mi mkhas pa dang ma rig pa chen po'o/ /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo che ba dag la bshad sgom tsam byas pa'i yus kyis cho ga bsdus pa dang lha nyung ngu'i sgrub thabs la brnyas pa byed pa ni chos spangs pa yin zhing / de lta bu sangs rgyas kyis gsungs shing / grub pa rnams kyis kyang bshad pa la skur ba btab pas nyes pa'i khur chen po 'khur ba dag go /de bzhin du skad cig gis dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rdzogs rim thob pa la yin gyi/ gzhan la mi rung ngo zhes pa'ang de dang 'dra ste/ de dag gi 'thad pa dang rgal lan 'dir rgyas par ma smos so/ /zhes pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim rnam par bshad pa las/bsgom bya dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs bstan pa'i sde tshan te bcu gcig pa'o// //gsum pa rgyud 'di'i rim gnyis kyi go rim la g.yin gyis brtags pa'i mtha' dgag pa ni/ skabs 'dir mkhas par grags pa 'ga' drang don gyi lam la zhen pa thal ches pa'i 'dod tshul zhig la dpyad par bya ste/ de la kha ba can 'dir dus 'khor ba gong ma phal cher dang / bar skabs su byon pa rnams kyang ste/ bskyed rim mchog sgrub pa'i lam ma yin no zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ma yin no zhes sogs rags bshad du mdzad pa la/ phyis kyi 'ga' zhig zhe sdang khong nas 'khrugs pas tshig la 'khri ba'i tshul gyis dgag pa byed la/gzhan mang po dag kyang de la rjes su yi rang ba dag snang ngo / /dgag pa ji ltar brjod pa yang 'di skad du/ bskyed rim ma bsgoms na rdzogs rim kho na la 'bad kyang mchog mi thob ste/ de'i lhan cig byed rkyen dang bral ba'i phyir/dper na chu lud dang bral na myu gu mi skye ba bzhin no/ / zhes pa 'di ni rig pa —501—

dang po'o/ /yang thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab ji tsam bsgoms kyang mthar thug mi thob pa theg chen spyi'i lugs yin la/ sngags kyi skabs 'dir thabs ni bskyed rim yin pas bskyed rim nges pa'i lam mo snyam pa ni rig pa gnyis pa'o/ /gzugs sku thob pa'i ched du gzugs sku'i rnam pa can gyi lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos te/ chos sku thob pa'i phyir du chos sku'i rnam pa can gyi stong nyid bsgom dgos pa'i phyir/ des na bskyed rim bsgom dgos par 'grub po snyam pa ni rig pa gsum pa'o/ /yang sangs rgya ba la bskyed rim nges par dgos pa'i lam ma yin na/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la phar phyin theg pa dang thun mong ma yin pa'i zab khyad med par 'gyur snyam pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /bla med kyi rgyud gzhung phal cher las bskyed rim gsungs pas/ de mi sgom par smad na rgyud gzhung phal cher la skur ba 'debs par 'gyur snyam pa ni lnga pa'o/ sngags lam du bskyed rim la ma bltos par sangs rgyas thob pa'i lam yod na/ mdo lam du spyin sogs kyi spyod pa la ma bslabs par sangs rgya ba'i lam yod par thal lo snyam pa ni drug pa'o/ /de ltar na rigs pa'i gnod byed du rlom pa drug po de dag ni 'thad pa ma yin te rim pa bzhin du sbyar na/ dang po mi 'thad de bskyed rim med kyang 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi lhan cig byed rkyen med par mi 'gyur te/sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i lam bden gyi chos rnams kyi lhan cig byed rkyen ni/ rgyun mtha' dang rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi gzhan don gyi spyod pa rnams yin gyi/ bskyed rim ni de 'dra ma yin pa'i phyir dang / theg pa mchog 'dir nye rgyu'i dbang bskur ba ni/ de'i lhan cig byed rkyen gyi gtso bo yin pa'i phyir —502—

ro/ /bskyed rim ni sangs rgyas kyi lhan cig byed rkyen rang ma yin te/ yun ring 'das pa'i snga rol gyi rgyu'i tshogs pa la phan 'dogs byed tsam yin du chug kyang /sangs rgyas thob pa la nye ba'i dus su lta ci smos/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes skye ba'i snga rol nye ba na yang med pa'i phyir ro/ / gnyis pa mi rung ste/ shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs dang / thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab kyis sangs rgyas mi thob pa bden mod kyang / theg pa 'dir yang thabs yin na bskyed rim yin pas ta ga la khyab/ thabs kyi gtso bo mthar thug kyang min no/ /rdzogs rim ni shes rab rkyang pa ma yin te/ thabs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ mnyam gzhag tu spros bral gyi stong pa dang sbyor rgyu'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa ni zhu bde 'gyur med dang / mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang / rlung 'gog pa'i thabs dang / rtsa dag pa'i rnal 'byor sogs yin la/stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po yang spros bral dang sbyor rgyu'i thabs su 'gyur zhing /rjes thob kyi thabs thun mong ma yin pa mang po'ang yod/ mdo lam dang thun mong gi thabs mkhas kyi khyad par thams cad kyang rdzogs rim la tshang bar yod pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim med na thabs dang bral ba'o snyam du sems pa ni/ grong gang na gdol ba'i rigs med na mi med pa'i skyon du 'dzin pa dang 'dra'o/ /'dir thabs dang bral ba'i shes rab rkyang pa mi rung ba theg chen spyi lugs yin zer ba ltar na/ theg dman la thabs dang bral bas chog par sems pa 'dra ste ye mi chog go /theg dman rang nyid la bltos pa'i thabs nges par dgos la/ thabs nye tshe ba ni yin mod kyi/ theg dman du shes rab kyang nye tshe ba'o/ /—503—

gsum pa yang mi 'jug ste/ chos sku'i rnam pa yin na stong pa'i rnam pa tsam yin pas kyang ma khyab/ gzugs sku'i rnam pa lam du byed dgos na zhal phyag gi rnam pa yin pas kyang ma khyab cing / lha'i rnal 'byor yin na bskyed rim yin pas kyang ma khyab pa'i phyir/ cal col de lta bu mi 'tshal la/ rdzogs rim gyis lha sku de sngon bskyed rim bsgoms pa'i mthu las byung ba'o snyam na/ 'di ni drang don gtso che ba'i lam rim 'ga' zhig gi phyogs tsam mthong bas nges don mthar thug las phyir phyogs par zad de/ sngon rnam rtog gis bskyed pa'i lha sku bsgoms pa'i bag chags sad pa'i shugs las phyis lha sku'i gsal snang shar ba de ni man ngag pa 'ga' zhig rnam rtog sngon song gi drod ces bya bar ming 'dogs pa don la nyams snang tsam yin pas/ rgyu'i dbang gis bskyed rim du gtogs su ni rung la/ rdzogs rim gyi lha sku'i phyogs tsam yang ma yin no/ /'o na 'phags skor las de 'dra de lus dben gyi lha skur bshad pas ci'i phyir rdzogs rim min snyam na/ nges don sbas te bshad pa na de 'dra rung du yod kyang /dgongs don mthar thug thog mar dge ba'i dus kyi stong gzugs la lus dben du dgongs so/ /des na sngon lha sku'i rnam rtog goms pa'i bag chags yod pa de/rtsa rlung gi man ngag gis rig pa cung zad dwangs pa na rkyen de las skabs der rtog pas ched gtad ma bsgoms kyang / lha skur shar ba de ni don dam gyi lha sku rang shar ma yin te/ de nyid rang la brtan pa ma thob na 'phral 'phral du nyams par yang 'gyur zhing / de rang la bltos pa'i brtan pa thob tu chug kyang lus brjes pa'i 'og tu rjes su mi 'brang ngo / /gdod ma'i lha sku sems kyi chos nyid —504—

du gnas pa de rkyen rtog bcas ma yin pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rlung sems dbu mar 'gags pa'i ye shes skyes pas mthong ba'i stong gzugs kyi longs spyod rdzogs sku de ni rdzogs rim pa'i lha yin no/ /'di la bskyed rim sngon du 'gro mi dgos/ 'di bskyed rim las byung ba yang ma yin te/de dang 'di rgyu 'bras kyi 'gros tha dad pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ shar phyogs su khre rgod gyi zhing la chu drangs pas nub phyogs su 'bras kyi lo thog smin pa la mi phan pa bzhin no/ /bzhi pa yang legs par ma smras te/ bla med kyi lam du bskyed rim mi dgos na/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la phar phyin theg pa las lhag pa'i khyad cho lo med par 'gyur zer ba ni/ 'brel med byung rgyal du smra ba yin te/ tshig 'di'i shugs la rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la bskyed rim yod ces par 'gyur na/ de ni khyed nyid kyang mi 'dod do/ /bskyed rim sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu nges pa can ma yin par kho bo cag 'dod kyi/ bskyed rim mdo dang thun mong pa'am/ legs pa'i chos ma yin par mi 'dod pas/ bla med 'dir bshad pa'i bskyed rim de mdo la med pa'i zab khyad kyi rnam grangs tsam yin pa ta 'dod la/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum kyi lha'i rnal 'byor yang mdo la med pa'i zab khyad tsam yin mod/zab khyad de tsam kho nas zad pa ma yin te/ rgyud sde 'og ma la rig sngags kyi bzlas pa dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i rim pa dang / lha la mchod pa dang rdzas kyi sbyor ba la sogs pa/ mdor na lha'i rnal 'byor ma yin pa'i khyad chos gzhan du mas kyang mdo las zab par 'jog thub pa'i phyir ro/ /—505—

lnga pa yang byung rgyal du smra ba ste/ bskyed rim sangs rgyas kyi nges pa'i rgyu ma yin na/ rgyud phal cher las bskyed rim bshad pas rgyud de thams cad la skur pa btab par 'gyur zhes pa 'di tshig gi hang rdeg ma gtogs don gyis stongs te/ 'o na rgyud mang po zhig las sprul gyis zin pa'i dug gso ba bshad na/sbrul dug gso ba de sangs rgyas thob pa la nges par dgos pa'i lam yin nam ci/ de min zhes smra na rgyud phal cher la skur ba btab par 'gyur ba sogs ha cang thal ches so/ /de bzhin du char 'bebs la sogs pa phra mo thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o/ /des na bskyed rim lar ma bshad pa'i yang bla med kyi rgyud yod la/ phal cher na bshad mod kyang sangs rgyas thob pa la med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yin par bshad pa mi snang bas ci'i phyir skur pa btab par 'gyur/ yang 'di skad ces bya ste/ grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog pa de sangs rgyas sgrub pa la nges par dgos sam mi dgos/ dgos na gsang sngags kyi myur lam med par 'gyur la/ mi dgos na mdo sde phal cher la skur ba btab par 'gyur te/ mdo sde rnams las grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags nas sangs rgyas par bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes khyab mtshungs su brjod na lan ci smra/drug pa ni/ 'dra mtshungs brjod pa tsam du zad pas snying po med de/ bskyed rim la ma bltos par sangs rgya ba yod na/ spyin sogs ma spyad par de yod par 'phen pa 'di ni/ sbyin sogs dang bskyed rim ngo bo gcig pa yang ma yin/ rnam pa 'dra ba yang ma nges/ dod thub kyi rgyu mtshan yang med pas 'brel med yin la/lar nas mdo lam kho nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa med pa'i phyir dang /—506—

nyid kyang don de 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ phar phyin theg pa la sbyin sogs spyod pa dang stong nyid sgom pa kho nas sangs rgya ba'i lam yod par thal/sngags kyi theg pa la rim pa gnyis sgom pa kho nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i lam yod pa'i phyir/ khyab sgrigs 'di khyed la nges par 'jug pa yin te/spyin sogs kyi dod bskyed rim gyis thub pa dang / sher phyin gyi dod rdzogs rim gyis thub pa'i stobs mnyam par khyod kyis smras pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mdo sngags gnyis lam gyi rkang so so yin zhing / de dang de'i dod thub tsam yin du chug kyang / dngos po de tha dad pa'i khyad chos dod thub so so la bya byed thams cad kyang 'dra bar brtsi dgos pa ma yin te/ dper na mkhar shin tu mthon po la sgo yod pa'i dod shod khang la yang de nyid rang gi sgo yod pa de yin mod kyi/de sgo ma brgyud par ltag sgor te 'jug nus kyang / mkhar la de ltar mi nus pa'i khyad par yod pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang khyed kyi de la kha cig 'di skad ces/phar phyin theg pa'i gdul bya rab sangs rgya ba la/ nyan rang gi lam nges par sngon du gtong dgos par thal/ gsang sngags kyi gdul bya rab sangs rgya ba la bskyed rim nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba dag kyang yod de/ khyed kyi khyab mtshungs de la khyab mtshungs kyi lan de yang 'jug par ni snang ngo / / yang lung gi gnod byed du bsam nas 'di skad ces/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs le'u'i ming don 'brel med du thal ba dang / le'u lnga'i go rim nges pa'i rgyu mtshan 'brel med du thal ba dang / de bzhin du dgos sogs chos bzhi'i rnam gzhag dang 'gal ba dang / dbang bdun gyi 'bras bu gsungs tshul —507—

dang 'gal ba dang / rdo rje 'chang gi rgyur tshogs gsum kar la bslab dgos par 'gal ba dang / bskyed rim gyi phyi nang gi sbyang gzhi sbyong ba'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa dang 'gal ba dang / mngon rtogs kyi thog mtha'i sems bskyed smon lam dang 'gal ba'i phyir bskyed rim sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu nges pa can yin no/ /zhes sems shing yi ger 'bri ste/ de dag kyang don ma rtogs pa'am/ g.yo sgyu'i sgo nas tshig gis snyad 'tshol ba tsam las/ don thog tu phebs pa'i nges bzung gi tshig gcig kyang mi snang ngo / /de ltar rtsod pa don tshan bdun gyi dang po ni/ 'grel chen las de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pas dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'jam dpal gyis gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs pas/bskyed rim dus 'khor gyi sgrub thabs ma yin na tshig de 'brel med du 'gyur snyam pa'o// 'di la sgrub thabs le'u'i don gyi gtso bo yang bskyed rim ma yin te/le'u der rdzogs rim gyi rnam gzhag gal che ba thams cad gsal la rdzogs par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs zhes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi gtso bo ni rdzogs rim yin no/ /de lta mod kyi bskyed rim kyang sgrub thabs kyi rnam grangs yin la/ sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa ches mang po zhig la nye bar mkho zhing legs pa'i cha lag ni yin par cig kyang 'dod de/ 'di la ni rang gzhan gnyis ka rtsod pa med mod/ 'on kyang sgrub thabs zhes pa'i ming kho nas de dang de'i go 'phang thob byed yin mi dgos te/ klu'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes sogs sam 'jig rten lha'i sgrub thabs mtha' yas pa yod pa bzhin no/ /'dir yang de dag dang mtshungs te/ dper na 'byung po'i sgrub thabs kyis —508—

'byung po bsgrubs shing 'grub na/ rang nyid 'byung po der 'gyur ba ma yin gyi/'byung po de dang spyod yul mthun par gyur te/ dngos su mthong zhing gtam yang 'grel/ rang gi dgos pa 'ga' zhig des sgrub par byed do/ /de bzhin du bskyed rim gyi sgo nas yi dam de dang de 'grub pa zhes pa'ang yi dam gyi lha de dang de'i zhal mthong ba dang gsung thos pa dang zhi sogs phra mo'i las sam/ grub pa'i khyad par ci rigs pa'i bka' drin thob pa la zer gyi/ skabs der yi dam gyi lha'i go 'phang thob pa ma yin no/ /sgrub thabs zhes pa kho nas go 'phang thob byed kyi rgyu yin par 'gro na/ khyed nyid la'ang bskyed rim sgrub thabs ma yin par 'gyur te/ des de mi thob pa'i phyir/ ma tshad ba'i rgyu ni 'bras bu skyed pa la nus pa med pa'o/ /des der gal te mi 'gro na khyed kyis lung 'gal du smras pa de 'grel med do/ /des na khyed dag las kha cig 'di skad du bskyed rim sangs rgyas kyis rgyu ma yin zhes zer ba ni/ sgrub thabs zhes pa'i ming don tsam la yang go ba ma rnyed pa'o/ /zhes spre'u'i 'bag gyon pa ltar 'khyab par byed de/ phyogs 'dzin phrag dog gis gdon gyis bslad pas rang gis sgrub thabs zhes pa'i tshig don tsam yang ma go bzhin du mkhas pa la skur ba 'debs pa ngo tsha med cing bag med par gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'grel chen las/ mngon par dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro ba ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa goms pas 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sngon du 'gro ba ni/ bsod nams dang ye shes —509—

kyi tshogs dag ste/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje kun rdzob dang / dmigs pa med pa'i bag chags kyi stobs kyis rdul phra rab 'dus pa las 'das shing / dkyil 'khor la sogs pa rnam par rtog pa'i sgom pa dang bral ba phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'o zhes/ sgrub le dang ye shes le'u'i go rim ston pa ste/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje zhes pa'i rdzogs rim de ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgom pa zhes pa'i bskyed rim sngon du 'gro dgos pa yin pas/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa la bskyed rim mi dgos na/ rdzogs rim gyi sngon du bskyed rim 'gro dgos pa dang 'gal te/ sangs rgyas rdzogs rim las byung la/ de bskyed rim las byung bas so snyam pa'o/ /gzhan yang 'dis skabs 'di dag tu gzhan gyi 'dod pa rtags su bkod pa yin pa'i khungs su log par rloms te/ bskyed rim mchog gi rgyur 'gyur ba mi srid pa'i phyir mi rung ba'i phyir zhes yang yang smra ba ni/rang gi thal 'gyur bkod pa de dag gi khyab pa sgrub byed la bsam par 'dug kyang / phyogs snga mas khas len med pa kho na rtags su bkod 'dug pas thal 'gyur yang dag tu 'gyur ba la rtags khas blangs dang ldan pa dgos pa ma dran pa'am/ phyogs snga ma rnams mi zer ba la zer ba ltar bcos nas dgag pa byed par brdzus pa rang gi 'khor tshogs bslu ba'i tshig tsam du zad do/ /de yang ci yis shes zhe na/ snga ma rnams bskyed rim mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyu'i rigs su 'gro ba mi srid ces pa'am/ rgyu'i rnam grangs su yang mi rung ba zhes zhe phugs su yang mi 'dod la ngag nas kyang ma smras so/ /rgyu ma yin zhes gsungs mod kyi/ de ni med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu ma yin pa'i don te/ rgyu'i rnam gzhag g.yin rnams ni —510—

rgyu'i rnam grangs kyi dbye ba tsam du zad la/ yid brtan thub pa dang brtags dpyad thub nges shes pa nges pa can gyi rgyu ni/ med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na khyed dag gis mchog gi dngos grub kyi rgyur bskyed rim dgos pa'i sgrub byed dang / mi dgos par 'dod pa la gnod byed du rlom pa tshig gi 'phreng ba rgyud ring po dag glegs bam so so tha dad pa rnams su yang yang skyor zlos kyi tshul gyis yi ger byas mod/ med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yin min dpyad pa las brtsams te/ yang dag pa'i dgag sgrub kyi rig pa spro rgyu ni gcig kyang med do/ /de'i phyir khyed rin po che lta bu'i gang zag tu rlom yang / rtsa ba med par mang du smra zhes bya ba'i don de khyed dag rang la tshang 'dug pa ngo shes par mdzad 'tshal lo/ /skabs kyi lan ni/ 'o na khyed ltar na rdzogs rim sgom pa'i sngon du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub grub pa dgos par 'gyur te/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sngon du 'gro ba ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dag ste/ zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir 'dir sngon du 'gro ba zhes gsungs pa ni/ gang ci yang rung ba bskyed rim dang thun mong gi dngos grub kyang sgrub pa dang / rdzogs rim dang mchog gi dngos grub kyang sgrub par byed pa zhig yod na/ de la rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skyes zin pa'i rjes su bskyed rim sgom pa don med pa dang /mchog thob pa'i rjes su thun mong sgrub mi dgos pa'i phyir/ thog ma bskyed rim bsgoms nas/ phyis rdzogs rim sgom pa dang / thun mong thog mar bsgrubs nas phyis mchog sgrub pa las 'os med pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim mthar phyin pa zhig —511—

sgom phyin chad rdzogs rim gyi ye shes ma thob pa'i sngon du sgom dgos so/ /des na bskyed rim zhig sgom phyin chad dmigs gsal ma gtogs/ rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gror gtong dgos pas khyab kyang rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro yin na bskyed rim yin pas ma khyab pas/ rdzogs rim sgom na bskyed rim sngon du 'gro dgos pas ma khyab bo/ /le'u'i go rim 'chad pa 'di kun la khyab mtha' rtsir med de/rdzogs rim gyi sngon du bskyed rim bsgoms pa ci rigs par 'byung la/ rdzogs rim gyi rjes su bskyed rim sgom pa mang po mi 'gyung na/ rgyu mtshan de tsam gyi sgo nas gnyis po'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa'i tshe/ sngon du bskyed rim dang phyis rdzogs rim bshad na/ 'chad tshul gyi go rim de tshul dang mthun par yod ces pa'i don yin pas so// dper na sems bskyed dang gdams ngag gi go rim 'chad pa'i tshe/ sems bskyed pa rnams gdams ngag 'tshol bar 'gyur bas/ gzhung du rnam gzhag 'chad pa'i tshe yang / sems bskyed kyi rjes su gdams ngag bstan/ zhes pa yang / sems bskyed nyi shu rtsa gnyis kar rgyud la skyes zin pa'i rjes su gzhi nas gdams ngag 'tshol ba'i don ma yin gyi/ dang por sems gcig bskyed nas de rjes gdams ngag 'tshol ba mang du 'byung ba tsam la dgongs nas go rim de ltar bstan to/ /phyis ni sems bskyed la rtag tu gnas bzhin pas gdams ngag rgyun chags su 'tshol ba'i phyir snga phyi'i go rim med de mnyam par 'jug go /gzhan yang mdo sde rgyan gyi le'u'i go rim dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i go rim la sogs pas mtshon te/ gzhung rnams kyi le'u'i go rim phal cher de 'dra ba mang pas 'dir le'u lnga'i go rim la brten nas rtsod pa 'di —512—

ni smra rgyu zad pa'i 'brel med kho na'o/ /des na sgrub thabs le'u las/ rdzogs rim dang mchog gi dngos grub kyang bshad mod kyi/ de'i rnam gzhag ye shes le'u na rgyas la/ bskyed rim kyang ye ler mang du bshad mod kyi/ rgyud 'di'i bskyed rim gyi gtso bo yin pas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo chos dbyings gsungs dbang gi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba/ sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi khrigs chags can de sgrub len yod pa/bskyed rim zhig sgom phyin rdzogs rim gyi sngon du yod pas bskyed rim rgyas bshad 'chad pa'i le'u de/ rdzogs rim rgyas bshad kyi le'u'i sngon du 'don zhes pa'i don tsam zhig yin pas/ nyams myong rgyud la skyed pa'i skabs su khyab ma khyab rtsi ba'i dgag sgrub kyi rgyab rten du yod pa'i go skabs nam yang ga la zhig/gsum pa ni/ brjod bya rjod byed dgos pa nying dgos rnams ston pa'i skabs/ 'grel chen las/ de nas dkyil 'khor ra du zhugs pa las 'jig rten pa'i dbang sbyin pas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis don byed pa ni dgos pa'o/ khres rab chen po 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa sbyin pas/ris med pa phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis don byed pa ni dgos pa'i dgos pa ste/ zhes gsungs pas/bskyed rim dgos pa dang / rdzogs rim las mchog 'grub pa nying dgos su gsungs na/ bskyed rim mchog gi rgyu ma yin par 'dod pa la tshig de 'bre'amed du 'gyur te/ nying dgos dgos pa la bltos shing 'brel ba'i phyir ro snyam du bsam pa'o// 'di ni phyis bod na grags che ba'i mdo gzhung gi 'grel pa phal—513—

cher na/ dgos pa'i dgos pa la nying dgos zhes zer ba dang / nying dgos dgos pa la 'brel/ de yang rjod byed la 'brel/ de yang brjod bya la 'brel/zhes 'brel ba'i rnam gzhag byed pa de la byis pa'i dus nas bag chags brtas pas shes pa had por song ste/ dus 'khor lugs kyi dgos sogs chos bzhi la gzhig pa ma chug cing / 'brel pa'i sa mtshams ngos ma zin pa'i 'chal gtam ste/ dus 'khor 'dir ni 'grel chen las/ le'u lnga'i ngo bo nyid kyi gnas pa'i bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo ni brjod par bya ba'o/ /'di ston par byed pa'i lewo tshogs rgyud kyi rgyal po ni rjod par byed pa'o/ /brjod bya rjod byed 'di dag phan tshun brjod bya rjod byed kyi mtshan nyid ni 'brel ba ste/ zhes brjod bya dang rjod byed la 'brel ba gsungs kyi/ rjod byed dang dgos pa la dang dgos pa dang nying dgos la 'brel ba ma bshad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / bde blag tu ni rtogs pa zhes bya ba rtsom pa'i dgos pa yin/ zhes pa ltar/ brjod bya'i don bde blag tu rtogs pa dgos par 'jog na/ de rjod byed kyi gzhung la rag las pas/ dgos pa rjod byed la 'brel dgos pa yin yang / 'dir bskyed rim bsgoms pas thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub pa dgos par bshad pa/ de na res 'ga' gzhung tshig la bltos pa'i gnas skabs kyang yod mod kyi/ mtha' gcig tu bltos pa'ang min pas/ gzhung dang de la 'brel ba'i rnam gzhag ma mdzad la/nying dgos dang rjod byed kyang de dang 'dra/ skabs 'di'i nying dgos ni dgos pa la shin tu mi 'brel te/ rdzogs rim bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub thob pa nying dgos yin par gsungs la/ de la 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sngon du 'gro —514—

ba lta ci smos/ de sngon song rgyud 'di'i lugs la mang po'ang me de nyung ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te mang po yod du chug kyang de la bltos pa ni ma yin no/ /ci ste lugs 'dir yang phyogs re'i sgo nas 'brel ba'i rnam gzhag byed na ni/ dngos su ma gsungs kyang nying dgos rjod byed la 'brel/ dgos pa yang rjod byed la 'brel/ zhes brjod na rung ba tsam yin gyi/ nying dgos dang dgos pa la 'brel ba ye mi 'thad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang nying dgos dngos ni mchog gi dngos grub yin la/ rdzogs rim sgom pa de'i zhor byung sgrub pa tsam du gsungs kyi/nying dgos dngos su ston pa min no/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa ni dgos pa yin la/ bskyed rim sgom pa ni de'i zhar byung rgyu tshogs tsam du bstan pa yin pas/ bskyed rim ni dgos pa dngos ma yin no/ /dper na zas kyi rgyu mang po bsags pa'i dgos pa ni/ kha zas bzang po zos pas lus brtas par byed pa'o zhes zer na/ lus brtan pa ni dgos pa yin gyi/ zas za ba tsam dgos pa ma yin te/ dgos pa de sgrub byed kyi thabs tsam du zhor ram shugs la bstan pa ni yin no/ /'o na lus brtas pa ni dgos pa'o zhes brjod rigs kyi/ zab smos pa ni lhag brjod do snyam na/zas kyi rgyu 'khru sogs mang po gsog par byed pa la/ bsags pa'i dgos pa ci/lus brtas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes brjod na 'di rnams bsags pas 'khyud spyad kyi tshul gyis lus stobs rgyas par 'gyur ba yin nam ci snyam du dgos nas nges pa mi rnyed pa la/ de rnams kha zas su bsgrubs te zos pa zhes brjod pas/ lus brtas byed kyi thabs la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 'dir yang —515—

sbyar te/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhung 'di'i dgos pa ni thun mong gi dngos grub bo/ /nying dgos ni mchog gi dngos grub bo/ /zhes brjod na/ de ni de ltar yin du chug kyang / de'i thabs gang yin ma shes te/ glegs bam la mchod pas sam/kha 'don du byas pas sam/ don bshad pas yin zhes sogs the tshom du 'gyur ro// de la 'di skad ces/ de dag las ma yin gyi/ gzhung 'di las bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis bstan la/ bskyed rim bsgoms pas dgos pa de 'grub cing / rdzogs rim bsgoms pas nying dgos 'grub ste/ dgos pa nying dgos de dag sgrub pa'i thabs ni de'o zhes nges pa ston par byed pa'o/ /des na gzhung 'dir ni nying dgos ces pa shin tu dgos pa'am/ dgos pa chen po'i don yin gyi/ dgos sogs chos bzhi'i nang gi dgos pa gcig thog mar ngos bzung nas/ de'i yang dgos don grub 'bras tsam nying dgos yin par ni mi 'chad la/spyir nas dgos pa bla na med pa yin pa'i phyir/ dgos pa'i dgos pa zhes ming 'jog tu ni rung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa la lha'i lha zhes zer ba dang / gzhan yang mkhas pa'i mkhas pa dang rgyal po'i rgyal po bzhin no/ /gzhan yang sgra dang min dpyad la sogs pa'i gzhus 'ga' las/ rnyed pa dang grags pa dgos pa dang / bsod nams nying dgos su 'dod pa dang / rig byed dang 'brel bar rtog ge'i gzhung 'ga' zhig las/ pha rol sun 'byin cing rang gzhung 'dzugs pa dgos pa dang / grol ba nying dgos su 'chad pa sogs yod pas/ de dag dang mtshungs par bstan pas 'dul ba'i dgos pa'ang yod de/ mdor na 'grel chen gyi dgos sogs chos bzhi ston byed kyi skabs 'di dag la go ba 'khrul med —516—

'di ltar shar na/ za zi langs pa'i rtsod pa de 'dra thog ma nyid nas yod don med pa lags na/ slob dpon med par gsang sngags la rang gar zhugs pa'am/rig pa glegs bam las bklags pas nyes so/ /gzhan yang khyed kyi brjod tshul 'di la 'grel tshig ma go ba'am/ ngan g.yor smra ba'i skyon zhig kyang snang ste/'grel par bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis don byed pa zhes pa la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs zhes pa spyir brjod pas/ bye brag bskyed rim la yang go nus pa/ re zhig de ltar yin du chug kyang don byed pa zhes pa'i go ba sbas te bskyed rim grub pa dgos pa dang / zhes 'chad cing / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs kyis don byed pa zhes pa/ rdzogs rim bsod nams dang ye shes gnyis ka'i rang bzhin yin pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub 'grub pa zhes 'chad pa de yang zol 'jog tu snang ngo / /don byed pa zhes pa sgom pa tsam ma yin te/ de las sems can gyi don byed pa nyid la 'jog dgos pa la/ bskyed rim gyi sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa ni las tshogs dang / thun mong gi dngos grub kyi sgo nas yin na/ rdzogs rim sgom pa'i sngon du thun mong gi dngos grub bam/ las tshogs sgrub dgos so zhes par song bas/ rang la skyon zhugs kyi dogs nas de'i don gsal por ma smras pas so/ /des na nying dgos la rang don phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa dang / gzhan don tshogs gnyis kar gyi sgo nas spyod la/ de'i shugs la dgos pa'i skabs su/ rang don thun mong gi dngos grub dang /gzhan don bsod nams kyi tshogs kho nas spyod pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa ni/ rgyud las/ dbang bdun gyis ni mngon par dbang bskur —517—

yon tan dbang gis sa bdun gyi ni dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes dang / de'i 'grel bar yang / gal te dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du byed na/ tshe 'di nyid kyis sa bdun gyi dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur ro/ /'es gsungs te/bskyed rim mchog gi rgyur mi rung na/ sa bdun gyi rgyur gsungs pa dang 'gal lo snyam pa'o/ /skyon de ni 'jug pa ma yin mod/ khyed kyis ni byis 'jug gi dbang don bskyed rim yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum zhes pa yang / bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag de tshe 'dir sa bdun pa nges par thob ces par go 'dug ste/ de ni nyid cag rang gi lugs la yang mi rung ste/rdzogs rim gyi 'dzin pa tsam thob kyang / rjes dran ma thob na tshe 'dir sangs rgyas mi thob ces khyed rang bzhed pa dang ni 'gal ba chen po 'ong la/ byis dbang thob pas sa bdun gyi dbang phyug tu dag pa byed pa'i rgyu mtshan bskyed rim brtan na tshe 'dir sa bdun pa'i bar du ni thob nges la/ de las lhag pa ma nges so/ /zhes bsam par 'dug ste/ de ltar na dbang gong ma dang sa sbyar ba rnams la'ang rigs bsgres pas/ sher dbang sa bcu pa la 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan rjes dran sngon du gyur pas tshe 'dir sa bcu pa ni thob pa ra nges la/ de bas lhag pa ma nges pa'i rgyu mtshan du byed dgos so/ /de yang 'dod na rjes dran thob na tshe de la 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas thob nges par rang 'dod pa dang 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang bskyed rim brtan pa'i gang zag de tshe de la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob nges par thal bar 'gyur te/ de 'dra de tshe de la sngags lam gyi sa bdun pa ni thob des/ sa bdun pa de yang khyed kyi lugs la ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag yin par —518—

—'dod mod/ rjes dran thob phyin ma thi ba'i sngon rol tu nges par 'tshang rgya ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i skyon 'di ya nga rejug go /des na byis 'jug gi dbang bdun bskur bas ma 'ongs pa na 7 bdun thob pa'i rten 'bre' sgrig pa yin zhing / sngar sngags lam gyis rgyung myo sbyangs pa zhig la byis 'jug gi dbang bdun bskur ba'i tshe/ slob dpon gyi skyu ma'i rig sngags la sogs pas sprul pa ma yin par slob ma nyid kyi dge ba'i mthu las lha ngo bstan pa sogs la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du smu/thong bar gyur na/ sgrub pa po des tshe de la sa bdun pa thob par 'gyur ba'i lta sa so/ /zhes nga/ ni 'grel tshig gi don yin rgode'i sa bdun pa ni/ kho bo cag ting nge 'dzin gyi rim par 'dod kyang de bas kyang bzang ba 'phags sa bdun pa yi na zhing / nged kyi lugs la mchog gi dngos grub ni thob zin pas/ tshe 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang thob par 'gyur ba la the tshom med mod kyi/ byis dbang gi skabs su sa brgyad pa yan chad thob par 'gyur ba'i ltas mi 'char bas/ skabs der dkyil 'khor dngos su mthong ba de sa bdun gyi ltas yin gyi/ gong ma rnams kyi ltas ma yin pa'i don sgo /de lta bu ma mthong yang dbang bdun nga/skur bas ma 'ongs pa na sa bdun thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grig par byed mod kyi// sa bdun thob byed kyi rgyu yin na/ dbang bdun bskyed rim dang bcas pa yin chi/ dgos pas/ rtsod pa de yang don dang bral ba yin te/ mdo sde rnams las sa ngas rgyas la la'i mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par bshad na/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyur de med du mi rung ba ma yin pa bzhin sna sto /—519—

lnga pa ni/ 'grel chen du/ de'i phyir bsod nams dang tshul khrims kyi tshogs dag las ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /de ltar tshogs gsum gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i bsod nams kyi tshogs ni bskyed rim la yang yang du gsungs pas/de sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ma yin pa 'gal snyam myo// tshogs gsum kar rdzogs rim kho na las 'grub pa yod la/ bskyed rim rang nyid bsod nams kyi tshogs shas che ba tsam yin du chug kyang / bsod nams kyi tshogs la bskyed rim du ma nges pas rtsod pa 'di yang don las phyir phyogs pa'o/ /des na bskyed rim gyi skabs su bsod nams zhes gsungs pa tsam dang / rdzogs rim gyi skabs su ye shes kho na'i nges bzung mi mdzad par tshogs gnyis kar smos pas kyang phyogs lhung spangs pa'i yid can gyis bltas na go bar nus la/ gzhan yang mi 'byung ba'i bde ba tshogs gsum yongs su rdzogs pa'i bdag nyid du gsungs te/ srung ba 'di nyid kho na yis/ /skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid/ /tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ /bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan/ pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug /ces gsungs pa dang /bskyed rim la yang bsod nams kho nas ma khyab ste/ ye shes tshogs kyi cha shas yod par ye shes tshogs gsog rang gis kyang shes la/ thig le dang phra mo'i rnal 'byor yang tshul khrims dang ye shes kyi tshogs su shin tu gsal ba'i phyir/bsod nams la bskyed rim du ga las kyang nges te/ bskyed rim yang bsod nams kyi tshogs kho nar ma nges la/ 'on kyang bsod nams shas che ba tsam yin —520—

pas/ bskyed rim bsod nams kyi tshogs so zhes 'jog pa ni legs pa yin yang / lugs 'di'i bsod nams kyi tshogs la bskyed rim gyis khyab pa nam yang gtan nas min yang / der ma zad bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi gtso bo yang bskyed rim min te/ bskyed rim ni las dang po pa rnams kyis bsgom bya yin pas/ rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor dngos su rgyud la skyes pa yan chad la mi dgos shing / sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i bso da nam/sa kyi gtso bo rnams ni/ spyir rdzogs rim dang sgos su 'phags lam du sgrub cing / yang sgos su sa gong ma gong ma rnams su gtso bor 'grub pa yin pas/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bskyed rim thams cad gcig car bsdoms kyang / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ba sbu'i khung bu gcig 'grub pa'i bsod nams tshogs kyi cha shas su yang mi sleb bo/ /'o na bsod nams kyi gtso bo gang zhe na/ 'grel chen las/ de'i phyir bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi don du sems can la phan par bya'o/ /ye shes kyi tshogs kyi don du mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes bsgom par bya'o/ /sems can gyi don ma gtogs par bsod nams kyi tshogs dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes sgom par ma gtogs par ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rnam pa kun ldan du shar ba na/sems can dpag tu med pa smin grol du byed pa nyid bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi gtso bo yin no/ /de yang dpyad na bskyed rim bsod nams su 'jog pa'i skabs su kyang / bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyu dang cha shas dang / bsag par bya rgyu'i yan lag tsam yin gyi/ tshogs dngos su mi 'gyur te/ mchog mi 'gyur —521—

las/ goms pa'i dbang gis phung ngo dang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam nga ra 'gyur te/ de nyid kyis na sangs rgyas nyid du yang de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs snyam pa de ni ma yin te/ gang gi phyir bsod ma/mas dang ye shes kyi tshogs med pa'i phyir go /zhes gsungs na bskyed rim kho na bsod nams tshogs pyi tā/rma/ cha tshang ba ji ltar yin/ gzhan don sems can gyi don spyod pa yang bskye ‘nga/ ci re ma pas nye tshe tsam zhig go /drug pa ni/ sgrub ler phyi nang gi sbyang gzhi rnams bskyed rim gyis sbyong ba'i rnam gzhag rgyas par gsu nga klo / pa mi 'thad par 'gyu/ra te/ bskyed rim sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ma yin na/ des de dag sbyong mi nus pa'i phyir ro snyam pa ste/ de ya nga skyes bu zhig gis bskyed rim bsgoms na/ des sangs rgyas thob pa la cha tsam yang mi phan par khas blangs pa yin na skyon de 'ju/ga kyang / de ni mkhas pa su yang 'dod ma/ban med de/ dung 'gro la zas kham gcig byin pa yang sangs rgyas sgrub pa la phan pa'i phyogs ci kho na yin sgo /sangs rgyas kyi rgyur nges par dgos pa'i yan lag min zhes smras pa la thal 'gyur de 'phen na ni/ shin tu khyab pa ma nges so /dper na sems bskyed kyis zin pas bram ze drag po'i bu la ba lang byin la/ rjes byang chub chen por bsngo bas rgyas thebs pa'i sbyin pa de sangs rgyas kyi rgyu tshogs yin yang sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la de nges par dgos pa ma yin pa bzhin mo/ /des na bskyed rim bsgoms pas sbyang bya srid pa skye ba'i rim pa de dag gi sgrib pa mgo non gyi tshul gyis sbyong zhing / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje bzhi thob pa la cung zad nye bar byed pa sogs kyi sgo nas/—522—

sbyang bya dang sbyangs 'bras de dag sbyor ba yin gyi/ spyir srid nga/ skye rim gyi sgrib pa mgo gnon pa dang / rdo rje bzhi dang cung zad nye bar byed pa la/ de dag bsgom dgas/ pas khyab pa ga la yin/ /bdun pa ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir du bskyed rim sgom par dam 'cha' ba dang / bskyed rim bsgoms pa'i dge ba las sangs rgyas thob par smon la che/ 'debs pa mi rung bar 'gyur te/ bskyed rim sangs rgyas kyi rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zer go /de ni dgag pa'i rnam grangs mang po dgos pa byung bas tshig gi dpung bskyed pa'i phyir du dran dgu smra bar zad de/ shin tu mi brling bas mi/ 'thad par rtogs par bla'o/ /'on kyang 'di skad ces bya ste/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur khyim gyi yang thog tu bud med dang khyi la zan kham phyed gshags su bgos te ster dgos pa yin par thal/ de ltar byin pa'i dge ba de sangs rgyas kyi rgyur sems bskyed du yang rung sangs rgyas su bsngo bar yang rung ba'i phyir zhes pa dang bye brag med do/ /yang kha cig bskyed rim sangs rgyas kyi rgyu min zhes pa la sngar bshad pa de dag dang mtshungs rung du 'gog pa'i lugs byas nas//dngos rgyu ma yin pas sangs rgyas thob pa la mi dgos na/ rdzegs rim gyi yan lag dang po lnga dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi yang skad cig ma tha ma ma gtogs thams cad mi dgos par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smra ba ni khas len med pa'i thal 'gyur te/dngos rgyu ma yin pa'i phyir mi dgos so zhes snga phyi su yang mi smra 'o/ /des na gong du bshad pa ltar/ bskyed rim gyi sangs rgyas thob pa la geg ba/ byed do zhes kyang ye mi smra la/ sangs rgyas thob pa la phan 'dogs nga/ra mi/ byed rdo zhes kyang rmi —523—

'dod do/ /las dang po pa'i gang zag shas che ba zhig gis bsgom dgos pa tsam du ma zad phan yon yang ches che zhing / de bsgoms pas rnal 'byor ba mang po zhig la rdzogs rim gyi nyams rtogs kyang skye bla la/ gegs med skye phul che ba sogs mchog dang 'brel ba'i phan yon mang po yod cing / rdzogs rim la ma brten par yang las tshogs dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnams dngos gnas la 'grub cing 'grub par kho bo cag kyang 'dod pas kho bo cag kyang bskyed rim gus pas len par byed do/ /'on kyang dmigs gsal ma gtogs rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa skyes phyin chad bdud rtsi rnyed na kha zas gzhan 'dor ba'i dpes bskyed rim dor bya yin pa dang / sngags kyi ched du bya ba'i gang zag dbang po rab la bskyed rim mi dgos pa dang / ched du bya ba'i gdul byar gtogs pa dbang po 'bring dang dman pa la yang dbang po'i khyad par gyis rdzogs rim kho nas khrid chog pa yang srid pa dang / bskyed rim sangs rgyas thob pa la med na mi 'byung gi rgyu ma yin no zhes ni smra ste/ de nyid don la gnas pa'ang yin pas bskyed rim la kho bo cag skur ba 'debs pa ma yin no/ 'di las zlog ste smra na chung ngu la chen por sgro 'dogs smra ba'o/ /bskyed rim mchog gi rgyu min zhes smras pa la nyes pa chen po mi bzad par rtsi ba ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la skur pa 'debs pa yin te/ mchog mi 'gyur las/ de'i phyir rnal 'byor pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub gyi don du rnam par rtog pa'i sgom pa mi bya'o/ /zhes dang /gzugs la sogs pa rtog pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'khor lo sgom pa —524—

goms par gyur pas ni/ /grub pa 'jig rten pa dag 'grub 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub chen po ga la zhig /zhes gsungs shing / sems 'grel skor gsum ni 'de lta bu'i tshig rigs shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /yang rig pa'i snying po 'di yin te/ sangs rgyas thob pa la bskyed rim med na mi 'byung gi rgyu ma yin te/ bskyed rim ma bsgoms par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa dpag tu med pa yod pa'i phyir ma grub na/ de yod te sbyor lam bzod pa man chad mdo lugs kyis bgrod nas/ theg pa bla na med pa la zhugs te/ sangs rgyas thob par byed pa thams cad kyis bskyed rim lan cig kyang sgom mi dgos pa'i phyir te/ dper na sa bcu'i tha mar sngags la 'jug pa bzhin no/ /yang dbang po rnon pos las dang po pa nyid nas bskyed rim spangs kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku mngon du byed nus pa yin te/ sku de 'grub pa la nges par dgos pa med na mi 'byung gi rgyu tshogs gsum po grangs tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa'o/ /des na bskyed rim mchog sgrub pa la nges par dgos par 'dod pa'i rgal lan 'di dag spyi ldog nas gnad chung ba lta bur 'dug cing / skabs 'dir ha cang spros rnga/ thal ches ba ltar gyur mod kyi/ dus 'khor ba snga rabs mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor shes bya rab 'byams su shar zhing / mngon par rtogs pa'i go 'phang shin tu mtho bar gshegs pa dag mgrin gcig tu bzhed pa dang /rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa dol po pa sogs rang lugs kyi bla ma rnams kyang de kho na ltar bzhed pa la/ slob dpon gzhon blo phyin chad byung ba'i mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis chos dang gang zag la sdang shugs —525—

kyis kun nas blangs te skyon med pa la skyon du 'dogs tshul rnam grangs mang mang 'dra ba bkod pa na/ mkhas rlom rnams kyang mgo 'khor bar 'gyur ba dang /skye bo mang po chos dang gang zag la skur pa 'debs pa'i sdig pa sgo chen 'byed par 'gyur ba mthong nas/ de dag la phan pa'i phyir rtsod pa ltar snang gi 'chang rnams cung zad bsgrags pa yin gyi/ zhib mor na mtha' yas pa dngu/da du yod do/ /'on kyang / skye bo phal cher phal la chags shing shes rab rtsal med pas na legs bshad/ rnams/ /don du mi gnyer kho nar ma zad phrag dog dri ma/ dag gis sdang bar yang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ ga the lta/ dag la phan nga dal 'a yang / rang lugs 'dzin pa rnams bla ma gong ma'i grub mtha' 'a the tshom mi skye zhing / nges pa rnyed pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod do/ /zhes pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bskyed rim rnam par bshad pa las/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa go rim la log rtog dgag pa'i sde tshan te bcu gnyis pa'o// //de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa rtogs par byas nas/ de'i rjes su nges pa'i lam mchog gi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnam gzhag legs par rtogs dgos te/ de ni gzhan du zugad zin to/ /rtsa ba'i bzhi pa de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu la/ dngos 'bras thun mong gi 'byor ba dang / brgyud 'bras phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub la sbyor ba'o/ /dang po la/ sgrub po rnal 'byor pa'i khyad par dang / des ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ khyab bdag gi ni dpal ldan sngags dang sangs rgyas gzugs dang rnal 'byor pa yis dang por bsgrub pa bya/ /phyi nas nyi ma'i dbye ba rnams kyis gnas 4—526

pa yon tan dpag tu med pa'i las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags dang gzugs brnyan ma grub par ni srid gsum gnas su ci ya nga 'grub par 'gyur ba nyid ma yin/ /de phyir rgyal po rang sems dri ma rnam par bral ba dag la sngags dang gzugs ni bsgrub par bya/ /zhes pa dang / dang por dang/la ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang ni srid gsum skyed ma 'bad pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /de nas sa gzhi'i gnas dag tu ni gang zhig zhi ba la sogs las rnams dag kyang bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la gzhung gi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa ltar na sngags kyi nus pa las su rung ba dang / lha'i gzugs brnyan gyi gsal snang la brtan pa thob na/ rim pas dngos grub rnam pa gsum yang 'grub par 'gyur na/phra mo las bcu gnyis sogs thogs pa med pa 'grub pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/de gnyis ma grub na dngos grub nam yang mi 'grub cing / las tshogs rnams kyang ji bzhin du mi 'grub ces pa'o/ /lha dang sngags kyi rnal 'byor yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum gyi de dag 'grub na/ phra mo dang grub pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur gyi/ lha gzhan rnams kyis ni phyogs re las mi 'grub pa'am/de yang shin tu dka' tshegs dang bcas pa 'grub pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin la 'grel chen gyis bkral ba ltar sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa ni/ sngags ni rlung dbu mar chug cing srog thur 'dres pa dang / sangs rgyas gzugs ni stong gzugs la brtan pa thob pa ste/ de gnyis bsdoms nas srog gzugs grub na/ las dang dngos grub de thams cad 'bad rtsol med par 'grub cing / gzhan du na mi 'grub pa dang / yang dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo zhes pa 'gyur med bde ba ste/—527—

de'i rgyu zhu bde 'gyur med du 'ching thub pa zhig dang / srid gsum skyed ma sna tshogs yum ni/ 'od gsal rnam kun mchog ldan gyi sku yin par bshad de/ de gnyis las dang dngos grub thams cad kyi pha ma lta bur gsungs te don gzhan rnams sngar bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /'o na bskyed rim kho nas las tshogs kyang mi 'grub par thal bar 'gyur snyam na/ ma yin te/ bskyed rim gyi gsal snang mthar byed pa bas kyang lam zab mo sbyor ba yan lag drug pa nyams su blangs na srog gzugs sgrub pa dka' ba ma yin la/ srog gzugs grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas rdzas sngags 'khrul zhes ji gang la yang ma brten par phra mo las thams cad bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub cing / de grub pa nas rjes dran gyi rim pa la gnas pa'i bar du thun mong gi dngos grub 'dod pa yang srid la gal te 'dod na dka' ba med par myur du 'grub po// ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyor ba la zhugs nas ni 'dod par mi byed mod/ gzhan don du zhor byung gi tshul gyis de dag mi 'byung bar nges pa yang ma yin no/ /srog gzugs grub pa la brten nas de rnams 'grub tshul la dpags na/ bskyed rim kho na'i sgo nas de dag sgrub pa ni tshegs che zhing 'grub tshul zhan par dgongs nas/ 'grel pas de ltar bkral ba yin la/ bskyed rim nyid kyis sgrub par byed pa la yang rags pa'i rlung khams lnga'i mtshan nyid can bcings pa'i bum can brtan pas zhu bde'i 'gyur ba khegs nus pa dang / lha sku dang sngags kyi sgra gzugs la gsal snang brtan po grub na srog gzugs grub pa rjes mthun pa tsam yin pas/ rdzas 'khrul 'khor spyin sreg dang bzlas sogs la ma bltos par bsam gtan kho nas las thams cad 'grub cing / dngos —528—

— —rtsegrub kyang 'a krub nga/'i skal ba can yin gyi/ de ma thob na dngos grub che 'bring gnyis mi re grub cing / mig sman sogs dngos grub chung ngu la grub tsam srid kyang dbang mi 'byor ba dang / phra mo bsam gto gyi las kyang thogs med du mi 'grub bo/ /de'i phyir rgyud tshig i/ don sgra ji bzhin pa de ltar yin la/ skal ba dman pas de yang ma grub na/ dam tshig la gnas shing brtul ba drag pos sems rnam g.yeng gi dbang du ma btang bar rnam rtog rgyun chas sa kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / bzlas pa bye ba sogs bzlas nas/ sgyin sreg dang rdzas dang 'khrul 'khor sogs las kyi yan lag ma nyams par bsgrubs na/ phra mo rnams ni mi ring bar nges par 'grub la/ ring du 'bad na mig sman la sogs pa cung zad 'grub pa'ang yod do/ /de ltar dngos grub kyi gzhi ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par shes par byas nas/ de dang mthun par bsgrub par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul la gnyis te/ phra mo las sna tshogs kyi 'byor ba dang / chen po bde ba rnam gsum gyi dngos grub bo/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ rengs pa dang ni zhi dang dbang dang srid pa 'jig pa dag ni zhal gyis dbye ba rnams kyis byed/ /'byung ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor ra la gnas lha min lag 'gro'i rigs 'di bsgoms pa yis ni bsgrub par bya/ /dkar po yis ni zhi dang rgyas pa byed de rang gi yid la dmar po yis ni dgug dang dbang / /ser pos rengs dang rmongs pa dag ste nag po'i sprin dang mtshungs pas bsad pa dang ni bskrad pa'o/ /zhes gtso bo nyid kyi sku gcig las/ mdun zhal nag pos bsad bskrad/ g.yas zhal dmar pos dbang dgug g.yon zhal dkar pos zhi rgyas/—529—

rgyab zhal ser pos rmongs rengs lta bu rnam pa ma bsgyur ba'i lhi rtswa rkyi gcig nyidakyis las thams cad sgrub pa'am/ rtsa zhal dang sku lus kha dog rnga/nyu ra skyo༈marang rang gi phyogs su zhal phyogs te/ las rnams sgrub par yang sa/sungs rtse/nga / yang zhi rgyas gzhil gsum/ da/ bang dgug bskyo da gsum ste 'jam po drug /phyag nyer bzhi pa'i rnal 'byor gyis sgrub pa dang / bsad bskra/da dbye gsum/ rmongs rengs gdab gsum ste rtsub po drug phyag nyer drug pa'i rnal 'byor gyis byed pa'ang yod la / yang gtso bo dus kyi 'khor lo la las byed rnal 'byor ma sum cu so drug gis bskor ba kho nas las thams cad sgrub pa'ang yod do/ /yang / zhi ba la ni bsam gtan dag kyang zhi ba ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar lha ni zhi ba'i gzugs/ zhes sogs lha re re nyid sa bon dang / sku mdog dang gdan dang nyams tha dad du bsgyur nas las tha dad 'grub tshul yang bshad cing / yang na/rgyal po zhi dang rgyas pa dag kyang sras bcas rgyal ba'i rigs dang lha mo rnams kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs kyi don ni/ gshegs pa yab yum dang sem/sa dang/'a yab yum gyis zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dus med pa dang /rims zhi ba rnams sgrub par byed la/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyi bsad bskrad kyi las dang / tsar tsi kā la sogs pa rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis dbang dgug gi las dang / rab gtum ma rnams kyis rmongs rengs gdab gsum gyi las dang /dbyings phyug ma dang sher phyin mas las thams cad 'grub bo/ /de la rang dus kyi 'bor lo dpa' bo gcig par bsgoms nas/ thugs kar chu'i dkyil 'khor la u yig las byung ba'i lha dkar pos rgyas pa dang / zhi ba sgrub pa bsngags de —530—

bzhin du gzhan rnams kyang rigs 'gre ste/ dmar pos dbang dgug dang / nag pos dbye bskrad dang / sngon pos bsad pa dang / ljang khus slar gso bar gsungs so/ /yang / gtso bo'i thugs kar padma'i dbus su ri bong can dang nyi ma me yi steng du rdo rje ni/ zhes sogs sho lo ka bco lngas las tshogs kyi dmigs pa rgyas par gsungs te/ de yang zhi ba la mtshon na rang nyid dus kyi 'khor lo yum can gyi thugs kar padma zla nyi sgra gcan la/ hū las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga 'od lnga 'phro ba'i lte bar dza las lcags kyu'o/ /de'i 'ong/ kyi 'phro 'du dang / byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas lha so so'i sa kyi bon du gyur pa rnams lhar sgom pa yin te/ yum gyi padma ra zla nyi'i dbus su wa yig dang pad dkar las pho nya mchog spyin dang pad dkar 'dzin pa'am/ pho nya mo skyabs spyin dang utpal 'dzin pa rgyan dang na bza' dang sku mdog dkar po glang chen dkar po la zhon pa/ bsgrub bya'i khyim du pho nyar gtong ngo / /des bsgrub bya dkyil 'khor du bkug /gtso bos bka' stsal te/ yum rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas de la khrus byed cing / nus ma rnams kyis mchod/ sems ma drug gis nyam pa gso ba dang / gzungs ma bcu gnyis kyis tshim par byed pa dang / rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis 'jigs pa med par byed pa dang / khro mo bcus skyong bar byed pa dang / klu mo rnams kyis 'o dag byed pa dang / lha chen gyi btsun mo bcu gnyis po rnams kyis 'byud par byeng/ pa dang / rab gtum ma rnams kyis srung ba byed par bsam shing / ngag bzlas sam/ 'gog bzlas kyis bskul bas zhi rgyas kyi las thams cad 'khru/ba par 'gyur te/ las gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /de bzhin du 'byung ba drug —531—

gi sa bon gyi las dang / zad par rnams kyi las dang / glang po che dang / sbrul dang / rta dang / ma he dang / bse dang / seṅge la sogs pa srog chags gdug pa can gzhom pa sogs las kyi dbye ba mtha' dag bsgrub par bya'o// yang gsal snang dang rlung gi sbyor ba ma grub na/ bsam gtan sngar dang mthun pa'i steng du sbyin sreg gi sgo nas las rnams 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te de tsam gyis kyang 'grub par dka' na de dag gi steng du 'khrul 'khor gyis 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de yang / rig byed dang ni 'dab brgyad nyid dang mi yi bdag po so dang chu gter drug dang gnyis skyes la/ zhes mtshan brjod kyi'am/ 'jam dpal gyi 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa dang / rtsibs brgyad la ni phyogs dang phyogs bral du gnas bcu gnyis rtsibs dang bcu drug rtsibs la bar du yang / zhes sogs kyi gshin rje gshed kyi 'khor lo yi ge 'pho ba'i nges pa dang bcas pa dang / yi ge rnams kyi yan lag mchog las mdun du dbyangs kyis 'byud pa dag ni ma ru rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes sogs 'jam dpal gyi 'khrul 'khor dngos rnams gsungs te/ de dag ni las thams cad byed pa'o/ /las sna tshogs kyi rnam pa'i rab dbye rgyas pa ni/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga nang gi mun sel dang / spyi chings nor bu chu dwangs las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs kun mkhyen chen pos bsdu bar mdzad pa ltar shes par bya zhing / rtsa ba'i 'khrul 'khor sogs kyi dbye ba rnams ni/ phan gnod sum cur grags pa'i bstan bcos rnying pa logs su yod pa dang / lag len gnad rnams bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa chen po bde ba rnam gsum gyi dngos grub ni/ 'byor pa sna —532—

tshogs kyi bde ba rdzas kyi grub pa dang / 'dod pa sna tshogs kyi bde ba lus kyi grub pa dang / rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyi bde ba sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i grub pa'o/ /dang po ni rgyud las/ grub pa lcags gsum gyis bcings mkha' la 'gro ba'i sha yi ril lus mkha' la spyod pa nyid dag ster/ zhes sogs ril lu dang mig sman gyi dngos grub sgrub tshul gsal bar gsungs shing / grub pa brgyad kar ster ba'i ro langs sgrub tshul rgyas par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang / ral gyi reg pa bcud kyi dbang po bdud rtsi'i 'bras bu ril lu ro tsa na dang mig sman dang / rkang pa byug dang shing lham dag dang 'jig rten pa yi dngos grub brgyad po khyod kyis bdag la stsol/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi dngos grub brgyad dang /g.yin yang rgyud dang rgyud du 'byung ba'i dngos grub sna tshogs pa dag rnal 'byor pas sgrub par byed de/ de yang gcig la mtshon na sngags dang gzugs brnyan grub pa'i rnal 'byor pas sbyin sreg mchod sbyin bzlas pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas/dngos grub kyi don du rang 'dod pa'i lha la ring du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa la drod thob na/ grub pa brgyad rnams 'grub pa la dka' ba med la/ drod ji bzhin ma thob kyang gnyid dang bkres skom la sogs pas mi gnod cing / ting nge 'dzin brten na 'grub tu rung ste/ gsol ba btab pas ji zhig ltar na lhas snang ba stsol bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te des ril bu 'grub par 'gyur zhes gsungs na/ sgron me lnga'i ril bu byas te/ lcags gsum gyis dkris nas/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'am maṇḍal sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su bzhag nas/ de sngags kyi yig 'bru'i rang bzhin du mos —533—

shing / sngags kyi yig 'khru'i ye shes pa rgyun mi 'chad par bsdim pa dang lhan cig tu tse( kā la tsakra ā dzñā sidha gu li kā sā dha ya swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas/ 'bar ba dang 'od dang du ba 'thul ba sogs byung na grub pa ste/ rang ri gi khar bcug pa sogs kyis mkha' la 'gro ba dang mi snang ba sogs ji ltar 'os pa 'grub po/ /mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs la brten nas kyang lha dang 'byung po mngag gzhug tu sgrub pa'i dngos grub sogs bshad do/ /dngos grub ('di rnams sngags mthus sgrub pa yin na/ gong du bstan pa ltar rlung dang gzugs brnyan la rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob cing / stong pa nyid la gsa'/ snang cung zad thob pas sngags kyi nus pa rnyed pa rnams tshang ba dgos la/ sngo na gyi las 'phro ba brten nas lha dang sgrub pa po bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis 'grub pa la ni nges pa med do/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i dngos grub 'chad par 'gyur ba phyi ma gnyis ni/ drod thob pa sogs sgrub pa po rang nyid la smu /tshan nyid rdzogs par med na/ las 'phro'am gzhan gyi byin rlabs kho nas 'grub pa ni med do/ /gnyis pa 'dod pa sna tshogs kyi bde ba lus kyis don grub par bshad par bya ste/ de la tshe 'dir sngags kyi spyod pa spyad pas tshe de 'ing/ la lus 'di gnas gyur te/ de dang de'i dngos grub thob na ni/ rnal 'byor pa/ de dang de lus kyi dngos grub 'grub pa zhes bya yi/ shi ba'i 'og tu bar rdo/'am rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas su skyes nas dngos grub de 'dra ba thob pa la ni/ dngos grub de'i ngo bo lus kyi dngos grub yin du chug kyang / rnal 'byor pa de dang de'i lus kyi dngos grub thob ces pa'i tha snyad mi 'jog go /g.yin yang lus gnas gyur pa'i grub —534—

pa ni/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal por nges pa yin la/ skye ba 'phos nas rig 'dzin gyi sa thob pa la/ de'i rgyal por gyur pa'ang srid mod kyi phal cher phal ba nyid do/ /de la rlung dang gzugs brnyan dang phra mo dang thig le la brtan pa thob pa phyi rol kyi don sgyu ma lta bur rig pa zhig gis goms pa brtan par byas pa na/rdzas dang sngags sogs la ma bltos par ting nge 'dzin kho na'i stobs kyis dug la sogs pa bdud rtsir bsgyur ba dang / 'byung ba bzhi dang srog chags sogs kyis gnod par mi 'gyur ba sogs ting nge 'dzin gyi drod rnyed pa na/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya'o/ /de yang rgyud 'di las/ a wa dhwa tī dang kun bzang dang phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs gsungs pa phal cher ni༄/ rdzogs rim gyi spyod pa yin pas 'dir mi 'chad la/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa gsum po 'di/ rdzogs rim du ma zad bskyed rim gyi skabs su yang nges par 'jug cing / spros bcas sogs kyi tha snyad rgyud 'grel dngos las ha cang gsal bar ma gsungs kyang / don ni gsal zhing rgyas par bstan la rgya bod kyi mkhas pa'i gsung sgros dang man ngag las kyang 'byung ba yin no/ /de la dang por dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su mtshan mo rgyu zhing brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la yongs su zhugs pa na/ sems brtan nam mi brtan brtags te/ brtan na gsang ba'i spyod pa ji ltar 'os pa spyad de/ de'i tshe mngon shes thob cing 'gro ba phal pa la lkog tu gyur pa lha la sogs pa rnams kyang ci rigs par rnal 'byor pa de la mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas des rgyud 'dir gsungs pa'i nges pa la brten te/ yul 'khor chen po re re na yang yum chen —535—

bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad tshang bar yod pas de tsam du rgyu bas kyang chog la/ mos pa'i dbang gis kā ma rū pa la sogs pa yul bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad po dngos su yang rgyu bar bya ste/ de dag tu rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi 'du ba thob par 'gyur zhing / de thob na de dang lhan cig rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad pas dngos grub thob po/ /de la dbang ler gsungs pa'i brda dang brda'i lan rnams kyang zhing dngos sam rjes mthun par rgyu ba'i skabs der dgos pa yin la/ rig brtul dngos gzhi'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i skabs su'ang dgos so/ /de la spros bcas dang spros med kyi spyod pa gang rung gis 'dod pa sna tshogs pa'i bde ba ste/ 'dod khams kyi rig 'dzin 'grub pa yin zhing / de yang dang por ril lu mig sman la sogs pa'i dngos grub chung ngu rnams bsgrubs nas/ de rjes rig pa'i brtul zhugs la brten te/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi lus kyi dngos grub sgrub pa'ang yod/yang phal cher de 'dra de dag sngon du 'gro dgos pa'ang ma yin te/ drod thob pa nyid nas dngos grub gzhan mi sgrub par rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad pa kho nas 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa 'grub po/ /de grub na 'dod pa'i lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa zhes bya ste/ skal mnyam gyi don 'dra ba yin la/ de yang dngos rang min pa'i don dang lus dang longs spyod dang rdzu 'phrul dang tshe rnams 'dod lha rigs drug po gang rung gi gtso bo gtso bo rnams las ngan pa ni nam yang ma yin la/ mnyam pa kho na'am 'dra mtshungs kyis lhag pa'o/ /sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi 'dod pas ni nges pa med pas 'dod khams kyi lha zhes pa gtso bo smos pa'i tshig ste/ klu dang lha min gnod sbyin la sogs pa sa 'og steng sa bla gsum kar gyi —536—

rig 'dzin yod la/ de dag kyang rnal 'byor ba'i 'dod pas gtso bor bzhag pa yin pas/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi rig 'dzin la bzang ngan gyi khyad par dbye ba'ang dka'o/ /des na ting nge 'dzin/ la khyad par med kyang 'dod pa'i stobs kyis gnas gzhan mtho dman so sor song ste der gnas pa'ang yod do/ /yang sgrub pa pos 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha spyi la dmigs kyang bsod nams kyi dbang gis gnas mtho dman so sor song ba'ang yod/ de gnyis kar la 'dug gnas gzhan du ma song bar 'di nyid du 'dug bzhin du gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi 'dod yon nyams su myong ba lta bu steng mkha' spyod 'dod lha rigs drug dang / sa steng gi gnod sbyin 'byung po'i gnas dang / sa 'og gi klu dang lha min sogs kyi lus dang tshe dang longs spyod dang / gnas dang 'khor gyi bde ba thams cad gnas 'di nyid du myong ba yang yod do/ /gang ltar yang zhing gi rnal 'byor ma bsgrubs te/ dngos su de dang lhan cig spyod pa yin na/ des bstan pa'i cho gas dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur la/ zhing sna tshogs su mi rgyu bar gnas gcig tu 'dug pa la ni/ spros bcas spros ci med kyi skabs su tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nges can du bya ste/ de la lha mang ba'i phyogs su sna tshogs zhig 'byung cho da kyang / gtso bor rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor lta bu bya ste/ de yang rigs sum cu rtsa bdun nam/ lo bcu gcig ma nas bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du rigs dang mthun pa'i lo grangs can nam/ yang rang rigs ma sring la sogs pa nye du'i ming gis rnam par btags pa rang rigs dang mthun pa rnams te/gsum po de dag gang rung las/ dngos sam/ rjes mthun nam/ de dang der —537—

mos pas kyang rung ste/ dbus kyi gtso bo yab yum gnyis med kyi dbang du byas nas/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor yin la/ 'bring po ni lha dgu'am bcu la sogs pa'o// nyung ba'i phyogs ni 'grel chen las/ phyi rol tu yang de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i rigs can gyi bud med rnams 'dzin pa ni/ bud med kyi spyod pa ste zhes gsungs pas/ lha lnga la sogs pa yang drang ngo / /'phrul dang ldan pa yin na ma gtogs gcig gam gnyis kyis spros bcas kyi bya ba me 'grub pas/ rig ma bzhi ni nyung mtha' la dgos so/ /de lta bu'i rig ma'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yid kyis sprul te/ rig ma rnams kyi 'dod yon lnga la spyod bzhin pas nang du lhan cig skyes pa'i bde stong sgom pa'i mnyam bzhag dang / thun mtshams rnams su tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rol pa sngags dang phyag rgya dang brda dang glu dang gar la sogs pa'i spros pa rgya chen po spyod cing /'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dang bde sdug sogs snang ba sna tshogs dang nyon mongs sogs rnam rtog thams cad spros bral gyi rnam nga/ can gyi zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i dbyings der ro mnyam du byed pa nyid yin no/ /rlung dang gzugs brnyan rjes mthun pa de'i mthu las bde ba nyid kyi rang snang ba las gzugs snang rnams lha sku dang / sgra snang rnams sngags dang / ji lta ba nga/nga ji snyed pa'i phyogs la rjes su 'jug pa'i gsal snang gi shes nga/ rtag tu skye bar 'gyur ro// 'dod yon bzang ngan thams cad la lha snang gi 'dod pa lnga pos rgyas btab pas/ de dag thams cad de'i ngo bor snang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhu bde g.yo ba med par thig le shin tu 'gags pa de dang lhar snang gnyis rlung dang 'dres pa de srog rtsol —538—

———sprobakag pa'i sbyor bas/ rtsa dang thig le sogs rags pa'i lus kun la yang yang 'dres pa'i tshu' gyis zhugs pa na/ thog mar lus kyi khams phra rim nas dwangs ma/ra 'gyur zhing / gzhan rnams dwangs mar gyur pa na/ rags shos de yang rim pas dwangs ma'i nang du bag la zha zhing zad par 'gyur te/ lus gnas gyur nas sngon ji ltar bsgoms pa goms pa'i rnam pa can gyi lha'i sku 'dod dgur gyur pa'i gzugs 'dod khams kyi lha rnams dang skal ba mnyam pa phra yang gi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa thob par 'gyur zhing / gnas dang longs spyod dang 'khor rnam/sa sngags kyis sprul pa'am lha rdzas kyi rang bzhin de yang rang la ji ltar snang ba de tsam khyab par 'gyur te/ lus kyi rig pa 'dzin pa grub pa zhes bya'o/ /gal te spros med kyi spyod pa byed na/ sngags dang phyag rgya sogs rol pa nyung zad tsam las mi byed pa yin la/ 'kho ra tshogs mang nyung la ni nges pa med de/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha bzhi lnga sogs nyung ngus kyang 'grub cing / mang po'i kyang phan 'dogs pa kho na las skyon du mi 'gyur la/ rig ma gcig kho nas kyang spros med kyi bya ba bde blas/ tu 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /spros bcas spros med kyi spyod pa'i skabs 'jir zhi ba la sogs pa las kyi rab 'byams rgya chen pos 'gro ba'i don spyod rnga ra ya/nga bshad la/ de'i phyir sgrub pa po'i 'dod pa yod na shin tu spros med kyis kyang 'grub par the tshom med mod/ kha cig de lta bu'i g.yin don sgrub pa la spros bcas bsngags kyi/ spros med stobs chung ngo zer ba ni/ spyod pa gsum po mos skal so so'i ngor zab mi zab 'dra la/ ngo bo'i steng nas phyi ma phyi ma mchog yin par gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur te/ gang rjes thob tu —539—

gzhan don spyod pa la mthu che ba de/ mnyam bzhag gi ye shes kyang bzang bar grub pa'i phyir ro// //gsum pa rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyi bde ba sngags kyi rig 'dzin grub pa bshad na/ 'di ni gzugs khams kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i rig 'dzin zhes bya ste/ 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ces bya ba de yin no/ /de yang sngar bshad ma thag pa ltar gyi 'dod khams kyi rig pa 'dzin pa de grub nas/ bskyed rim pa nyid la bltos pa'i shin tu spros med kyi spyod pas rig 'dzin 'di sgrub par byed pa'am/ yang na sngar gyi spros bcas spros med gang rung gi spyod pa de spyad pas khams dwangs ma rnams lha rdzas kyi lus su gyur zhing / rags pa yongs rdzogs gnas ma gyur tsam rang nyid 'dod khams kyi lhar 'gyur tshad pa'i skabs der/ sngar gyi spyod pa'i 'phro btul nas shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas gzugs kyi rig pa 'dzin pa 'di thob par 'gyur ro/ /de yang 'di lus gnas gyur pa'i phyir/ lus kyi rig 'dzin yin par ma zad snga ma las kyang lus lhag go /snga ma ni mi la bltos na ches phra mod kyi/ lha rdzas nyid la bltos pa'i lus rags pa yin pas/ sngags dang lus gnyis las lus stobs che ba'i phyir lus kyi rig 'dzin zhes spyi ming bye brag la 'dogs pa'i skabs yod pa dang / 'di ni sngags te rlung gi rang bzhin 'od lus kho na yin pas lha rdzas kyi nang nas kyang phra ba'i lus te/ lus las kyang sngags stobs che ba'i phyir sngags kyi rig 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de la mi'i rten can rags pa'i lus 'dod lhar sgyur ba'i phrugs cig dang / de gzugs kyi lhar sgyur ba'i —540—

phrugs cig ste/ lus gnas sgyur ba'i phrugs gnyis brgyud dgos pa ni cung zad dbang po brtul ba yin la/ spyod pa dang po gnyis kyis dwangs ma rgyas par byas pa'i mtshams su spyod pa phyi mas snyigs ma zad par byed pa 'dod lha'i lus brgyud ma dgos par mi lus gnas bsgyur ba'i phrugs gcig po de la gzugs khams kyi dngos grub 'grub pa ni/ skabs 'di'i dbang po rnon po'o/ /de la gong du bshad pa dang mtshungs par dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus ni 'di la yang gdam ka yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang lha mo klu mo mi mo la sogs pa las kyi phyag rgya spangs shing / ye shes kyi phyag rgya kho na yin la/ phra mo'i rnal 'ebyor grub pas bskyed rim phra rags thams cad mthar phyin pa'i phyir/ rang gi mos nga/sa nyung ba la dga' na ma gtogs/ lha tshogs mangs nyung la sgrub dka' sla'i khyad par med do/ /ye shes kyi phyag rgya de yang bskyed rim pa gsal snang thob ma thag pa'i skabs kyi de dang mi 'dra ste/ 'dir sngags kyi sprul pa'i lha sku la ye shes kyi lhas dngos su byin gyis brlabs pas/ lha'i gtso bo ches rdzu 'phrul che ba gcig dang khyad par med pa'i bya ba byed do/ /lus rten dang ting nge 'dzin bzang ngan gyi khyad par ma gtogs/ sgom tshul ni sngar zugad pa'i spyod pa'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni mas brtan gyi dus lte bar dga' ba'i ye shes dang sa rlung gi dwangs ma 'dres pa'i rdo rje spro ba bsgoms pas/ rtsa sogs lus thams cad khyab cing brtan pa nyid gtso bor bsgoms na/ bsam gtan dang po'i lha dang skal ba mnyam pa dang / de'i steng du snying gar mchog dga' chu rlung bsnan na bsam gtan gnyis pa dang / de'i steng du mgrin par khyad dga' me rlung bsnan na —541—

bsam gtan gsum pa dang / de'i yang steng du dpral bar lhan skyes rlung gi rlung dang 'dres pas rtsa rlung thig le thams cad dbang du byas na bsam gtan bzhi pa dang skal ba mnyam pa'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur te/ de dag la yang nang tshan du mos pa dang bsod nams kyi dbang gis gnas gzhan mtho dman du 'gro ba sogs gsum ni sngar bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /de la sngar 'dod lha'i rig 'dzin grub zin pa ni/ 'dod khams kyis bsdus pa'i lha'i lus rags pa de bde ba sogs kyis rgyas btab pa'i mi'i lus dang mi 'dra ste/ dka' tshegs chung ngus je dwangs je dwangs su song ba kho na las/ gzugs khams kyi lha rdzas su 'gyur ba yin la/ gnas gyur rim pa gcig kho na la ni/ spyod pa phyed spyad pas mi'i rten las byung ba'i dwangs ma shin tu rgyas pa rnams 'dod khams kyi lha rdzas su 'gyur/rags pa mi'i rdzas su yod pa'i skabs der shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa phyed spyad pas 'dod pa'i lha rdzas de gzugs kyi lha rdzas su 'gyur zhing de'i nang du rags pa bag la zha ba'i tshul du thim zhing zad par 'gyur ro/ /shin tu spros med kyi skabs 'dir ye shes kyi phyag rgya nyid kyi rang snang la/ sngags dang phyag rgya sogs rol pa'i bkod pa rgya chen po 'byung ba'ang yin mod kyi/ 'di la rtsol ba yang mi dgos shing / phyi rol gzhan rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i mi dang lha sogs kyi 'gro ba'i byed pa med la/ de la der ma zad rang lus tsam ma gtogs/ gzugs can gyi dngos po'i byed pa med pa'i phyir spros bcas sogs su mi 'gyur ro/ /'dir gzugs med pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa yod dam med ce na/ cung zad ni yod de sngar bshad pa dang 'dra ba las gtsug tor nam mkha'i rlung kho nas dbang byas pa'i —542—
